jobs.title: Analyste marketing, Attribution - ShareGate
jobs.excerpt: À propos de Workleap Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006.
jobs.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

ShareGate, c'est une business de près de 100 M$ d'ARR qui croît grâce à deux moteurs bien différents : l'inbound et le canal partenaires. On vient de terminer notre migration CRM et de verrouiller notre architecture de revenus, ce qui veut dire que, pour la première fois, les données sont assez propres pour répondre à la question qu'on n'a jamais pu trancher correctement : quel marketing génère réellement du revenu, et où devrait aller le prochain dollar ? Ce rôle existe pour porter cette réponse. Tu seras le pendant analytique de notre responsable des opérations marketing, en travaillant côte à côte avec la directrice marketing de ShareGate pour transformer les données de campagnes et d'attribution en décisions sur lesquelles l'équipe marketing et la direction peuvent agir.

Ton impact:

  • Prendre en charge l'architecture d'attribution marketing de ShareGate, entre HubSpot et HockeyStack, et traduire les données du funnel en récits prêts pour la direction, pour que les questions d'attribution obtiennent une seule réponse claire ;
  • Propulser la performance marketing en diagnostiquant ce qui fonctionne et ce qui ne fonctionne pas, en inbound comme en canal, pour que le budget se déplace vers les programmes au meilleur rendement chaque trimestre plutôt qu'une fois par année financière ;
  • Construire la couche de reporting et de diagnostic du marketing ShareGate — performance des campagnes, conversion du funnel, qualité des sources — pour que l'équipe planifie à partir de taux de conversion mesurés, pas d'hypothèses ;
  • Intégrer l'IA à ton flux d'analyse — on carbure à Claude — pour faire passer le délai entre la question et la réponse de quelques jours à quelques heures, et faire de l'analyse en profondeur une habitude hebdomadaire plutôt qu'un projet trimestriel.

Ton équipe

Les 6 à 12 prochains mois, c'est de la construction. Ce rôle n'a jamais existé chez Workleap, et tu hérites d'une business qui vient tout juste de finir de nettoyer ses fondations : la migration CRM est terminée, l'architecture de revenus est fixée, et la visibilité sur l'attribution est encore éparpillée entre deux systèmes. Ton premier mandat : rendre cette architecture cohérente et lisible — puis t'en servir pour dire à l'équipe marketing de ShareGate où investir et où lever le pied.

Le RevOps chez Workleap se divise en deux volets. Le premier, Systems & Operations, possède l'automatisation, l'architecture CRM et l'outillage IA pour le GTM. Le second — le tien — regroupe des partenaires d'affaires GTM intégré.es aux unités qu'ils.elles servent, imputables de la performance de leurs parties prenantes : prévisions, conversion du funnel, atteinte des quotas, vélocité. Tu relèveras du directeur RevOps et tu feras équipe serrée avec notre gestionnaire des opérations marketing, qui possède les systèmes et l'exécution des campagnes, pendant que toi, tu possèdes les données et leur interprétation.

Ce que tu apportes

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français ;
  • 3 ans et plus en opérations marketing ou en analytique marketing dans une entreprise SaaS B2B, logicielle ou fintech ;
  • Une expertise HubSpot pratique et approfondie — non négociable. Tu y as bâti, cassé et rebâti des logiques de campagnes, de cycle de vie et de reporting ;
  • Une vraie maîtrise des modèles d'attribution — premier touchpoint, dernier touchpoint, multi-touch — et le jugement de savoir lequel répond à quelle question ;
  • De l'aisance avec la mécanique en dessous : gouvernance des UTM, routage des leads et round robins, étapes de cycle de vie, taxonomie des sources et des canaux ;
  • Un instinct d'analyste : tu cherches le « pourquoi » derrière un chiffre avant même qu'on te le demande ;
  • La capacité de prendre un jeu de données brouillon et d'en tirer une réponse en deux diapositives sur laquelle un.e CRO peut agir ;
  • Un usage quotidien et délibéré de l'IA pour accélérer tes propres analyses — pas seulement pour rédiger du texte ;
  • Atout : expérience avec HockeyStack ou une plateforme d'attribution comparable.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 100 000$ à 130 000$ / OTE : 110 000$ – 140 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Note: Le titre interne de ce poste est Partenaire d'affaires, opérations de revenus.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

jobs.title: Finance Executive Director
jobs.excerpt: Ready to lead the financial future of a brand with heart and purpose?
jobs.description:
Ready to lead the financial future of a brand with heart and purpose?

At Hadley Designs, we believe every product should fill homes with beauty, learning, and inspiration. We design screen-free learning tools that help children fall in love with learning and help parents feel proud of how they nurture that growth.

As our Finance Executive Director, you’ll be the architect of scalable systems that fuel that mission. You’ll bring precision, foresight, and strategic clarity to every financial decision, guiding the company’s growth toward $100M and beyond with confidence and discipline.

You won’t just manage numbers. You’ll empower a purpose-driven team to think bigger, move faster, and build a lasting legacy.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is a family-founded brand redefining early education through creativity, beauty, and connection. We design screen-free learning tools that spark curiosity and confidence in children while giving parents peace of mind.

We believe learning should be fun and engaging. Beautiful design creates better learning. We don’t just sell products. We shape futures.

About the Role

Your Core Focus

You’ll own the full finance function, building scalable systems, managing cash flow, driving profitability, and leading financial strategy to support Hadley Designs’ next era of growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver accurate, audit-ready financials by the 20th of each month with full account reconciliation and zero material errors
  • Build and maintain a 12-month rolling cash forecast, updated weekly, ensuring perfect liquidity and visibility
  • Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process across all departments with ≤10% variance between forecast and actual results
  • Develop automated systems and workflows that reduce manual reporting time by at least 25% within your first year
  • Partner with leadership to implement initiatives that increase profitability and improve EBITDA by 2 percentage points in your first 12 months
  • Create and document SOPs for close, forecasting, cash flow, and reporting processes
  • Implement new systems for expense management, travel, and purchasing by Month 6
  • Produce insightful financial dashboards and KPIs that drive better decision-making
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Operations to align growth, cash flow, and inventory planning
  • Evaluate technology solutions (ERP, reporting tools) that prepare the company for scale

How Success Is Measured

  • 100% of monthly financials delivered on time and error-free
  • 0 overdrafts, late fees, or missed payments
  • ≤10% variance between forecasted and actual EBITDA
  • 12-month rolling cash forecast maintained weekly
  • SOPs for all finance processes documented within 3 months
  • System improvements reducing manual work by 25% in Year 1
  • Trailing-12-month EBITDA margin up 2 points within first year

Who You Are

You’re a strategic, detail-oriented leader who thrives on clarity, accuracy, and impact. You know how to scale systems, guide teams through growth, and communicate financial insight in plain English. You’re not just reporting numbers, you’re building the foundation for smart, sustainable expansion.

Requirements

You bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance (MBA or CPA strongly preferred)
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in finance or accounting, including 3+ years in leadership
  • Proven success in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling
  • Experience implementing scalable systems and automation in growing organizations
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, compliance, and tax standards
  • Proficiency with tools such as Xero, QuickBooks, or advanced Excel/Google Sheets
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills; you turn complexity into clarity
  • Experience in e-commerce or multi-channel retail (preferred)
  • Collaborative mindset and the confidence to influence executive-level decisions

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Hadley Designs, your work has purpose. You’ll join a small but mighty remote-first team where financial excellence and creativity go hand in hand. You’ll have the freedom to build, lead, and innovate, without red tape.

Here’s what you can expect:

    • Remote-first environment with flexible hours
    • Direct collaboration with the CEO and leadership team
    • Autonomy and trust in how you structure your work
    • Paid time off and holidays
    • Learning opportunities and leadership development support
    • Access to Hadley Designs products for your family
    • A decade of stability and growth as a family-founded, purpose-driven brand

Hadley Designs is built on creativity, integrity, and excellence. We believe in balancing high performance with flexibility, purpose, and joy.

Apply today and help us build a brighter, more beautiful future, one where learning and growth never stop.

jobs.title: Data Operations Lead, B2B
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Vertical Data Operations Lead (B2B & Lead Gen) is a senior individual contributor embedded at the intersection of new business, marketing measurement, and complex pipeline data delivery. This role serves three distinct functions: supporting the pre-sales process on large B2B and Lead Gen engagements, contributing to Power Digital's marketing measurement programs, and owning the data onboarding and integration experience for B2B and Lead Gen clients post-signature.

You are a B2B and Lead Gen data specialist. You understand the full pipeline data landscape, CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), marketing automation tools (Marketo, Pardot), demand generation platforms (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase), call tracking and form capture tools (CallRail, Unbounce), and the messy reality of lead data that arrives in every format imaginable: CSV dumps, screenshot imports, manual spreadsheets, and custom-built ingress pipelines. You know how to bring structure to unstructured data, where pipeline attribution breaks down, and what it takes to connect marketing activity to revenue outcomes for clients where the sales cycle is long and the data is rarely clean.

This role reports to the Director of Data Operations & Enablement and works closely with the Appraisal team, the Measurement team, Analytics Engineering, and client account leads.

Responsibilities:

B2B & Lead Gen Vertical Client Delivery:
- Own the end-to-end data onboarding experience for B2B and Lead Gen clients post-signature — from scoping through integration validation and measurement readiness
- Lead structured data intake sessions to document lead definitions, pipeline stage mapping, CRM field configuration, conversion logic, and any known attribution nuances
- Coordinate standup of B2B and Lead Gen data pipelines — CRM connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot), MAP integrations (Marketo, Pardot), demand gen platforms (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase), and call/form tracking tools (CallRail, Unbounce)
- Own the ingestion and normalization of unstructured lead data sources — CSV imports, manual spreadsheets, screenshot-based reporting, and custom ingress tooling — leveraging AI-assisted schema mapping and data extraction where applicable
- Validate integrations are live and pipeline data is landing correctly before handing off to analytics engineering for modeling
- Maintain living integration documentation per client, usable by any team member

Pre-Sales Support:
- Join sales calls and pitch meetings for large B2B and Lead Gen prospects — speak credibly to Power Digital's data capabilities, CRM integration experience, and onboarding process
- Conduct pre-signature data audits: assess the prospect's CRM setup, lead data quality, attribution methodology, and integration complexity — flag custom data requirements and surface red flags before contract
- Partner with the Appraisal team to scope data complexity into deal pricing — translate CRM fragmentation, unstructured data ingress, and pipeline attribution requirements into effort estimates
- Produce pre-sales data profiles that set accurate expectations for what onboarding will require and what measurement programs are viable

Measurement & Meridian Support:
- Support the Measurement team's data readiness requirements for MMM programs, with specific focus on B2B and Lead Gen clients where offline conversion data and long sales cycles create unique modeling challenges
- Own data input preparation for pipeline-focused measurement models — ensuring lead volume, qualified pipeline, and closed revenue data are reconciled, validated, and delivered to spec
- Serve as the B2B and Lead Gen data subject matter expert for incrementality and attribution programs that require clean mapping of marketing touchpoints to pipeline and revenue outcomes
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • 4+ years in data operations, marketing analytics, or marketing technology with direct client or stakeholder-facing responsibilities
  • Deep hands-on experience with B2B and Lead Gen data ecosystems — CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), marketing automation (Marketo, Pardot), and demand generation tools (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase)
  • Proven experience handling unstructured and non-standard lead data ingestion — CSV imports, manual data entry reconciliation, screenshot-to-data workflows, and custom ingress pipelines
  • Solid SQL skills and hands-on Snowflake experience — you can write queries, validate data, and troubleshoot without engineering support for day-to-day tasks
  • Comfort in client-facing settings: you can speak to data capabilities in a sales conversation and gather requirements from a non-technical marketing stakeholder in the same day
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted data tooling for unstructured data extraction, schema mapping, or data normalization
  • Familiarity with ETL tools (Fivetran, Funnel) and data pipeline concepts

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

B2B/CSV client data coverage:
- Target: ≥70% at 6 months → 100% at 12 months
- Measurement: % of active B2B/Lead Gen clients with validated data landing in novaCloud / Omega

Data onboarding SLA:
- Target: 95% of onboardings completed within 3 weeks of start date
- Measurement: Tracked from contract-sign or kickoff date; exceptions logged with root cause

Unstructured data ingestion success rate:
- Target: ≥ 90% of non-standard sources (CSV, screenshot, manual) normalized, validated, and confirmed landing in novaCloud / Omega within 5 business days of receipt
- Measurement: Tracked per-source, per client; re-submissions count against first-pass rate

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Data Depth: Be the go-to for any question about how B2B and Lead Gen pipeline data is structured, where it breaks, and how to make it usable — across clean CRM exports and messy unstructured ingress
  • Unstructured Data Ingestion: Own the hardest part of B2B data onboarding — bringing structure to data that arrives in every format imaginable, using AI-assisted tooling where applicable
  • Pre-Sales Credibility: Show up in sales conversations as a data expert who builds prospect confidence and sets accurate onboarding expectations

jobs.title: Show Producer
jobs.excerpt: RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands.
jobs.description:
RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

About Evo

For more than 20 years, the Evolution Championship Series (Evo) has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are gathering points where players, fans, publishers, developers, creators, and brands come together to celebrate fighting games and the communities that make them thrive.

Beyond our flagship live events, Evo continues to expand how we create, celebrate, and grow fighting game fandom around the world.

Role Overview

As one of Evo’s Show Producers, you will be responsible for the production of various Evo livestreams. You will be the day-to-day lead from pre-production through wrap, covering the world’s largest fighting game tournaments.

You will also produce live-to-tape, long-form video content throughout the year.

This role sits within the Evo Production team and works closely with the Head of Production, Director of Programming, and key production partners and vendors.

The ideal candidate has experience owning esports livestream productions from ideation through the final “thanks for watching” screen.

Reporting Structure

You will report to Evo’s Head of Production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own assigned Evo livestream productions from pre-production through final delivery.
  • Develop run of show, production schedules, scripts, camera plans, graphics requirements, music, and partner integrations.
  • Lead production meetings, rehearsals, and live control room execution, ensuring teams are aligned and prepared for each broadcast.
  • Coordinate talent, crews, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage real-time production issues and make decisions during live broadcasts to keep the show on track.
  • Deliver productions on schedule and within approved budgets.
  • Lead production wrap and post-show debriefs, documenting key learnings and opportunities to improve future productions.
  • Produce long-form and live-to-tape content from concept through post-production.
  • Manage locations, crews, editors, graphics, talent, schedules, and final approvals.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience leading the execution of esports livestreams.
  • 5+ years of experience producing long-form, live-to-tape programming.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, shifting priorities, and live-production deadlines.
  • Ability to remain calm, make sound decisions, and solve problems quickly in high-pressure live production environments.
  • Ability to travel at least one week per month, including occasional international travel.
  • Ability to work weekends.
Bonus Points
  • Passion for fighting games, esports, gaming communities, and the people who make them thrive.
  • Experience working directly within the fighting game community.
  • Experience working on coverage of fighting game tournaments.
  • Existing relationships with tournament organizers, community leaders, creators, publishers, on-camera talent and other key figures within the fighting game landscape.
Compensation

The salary for this role is $70,000 to $90,000, based on experience and qualifications.

Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  • 401k plan available for employee contributions
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
  • Remote-first culture

jobs.excerpt: Product Manager_We connect marketing data from 300+ sources (Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, BigQuery, Snowflake, ChatGPT, Claude) for 6,000+ customers worldwide.
jobs.description:
Product Manager_

We connect marketing data from 300+ sources (Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, BigQuery, Snowflake, ChatGPT, Claude) for 6,000+ customers worldwide. Lean team, real revenue, no fluff.

This is our first Product Manager hire, no team to inherit, no roadmap to plug into. You're building the function from scratch. Some of what you try first won't work. That's expected, not a red flag.

We're not looking for someone's first product job. You've shipped before, more than once, and you know what "good" looks like because you've built it.

What you'll do

  • Decide what gets built and say no to more than you say yes. Windsor has 300+ integrations already live and constant pressure to add "just one more" the job is cutting that list down, not growing it blindly.

  • Turn customer feedback, usage data, and competitive gaps into a short list of things worth doing.

  • Work close enough to engineering to sanity-check your own estimates, not relay someone else's.

  • Use data to decide, even when it's incomplete which it usually will be.

  • Ship. A roadmap nobody ships is a document, not a product function.

What you need

  • Shipped a SaaS product customers actually paid for and used more than once, not a one-off.

  • Comfortable pulling and reading your own data (usage, funnel, retention) without waiting on an analyst.

  • Can cut a long list of good ideas down to the few that matter, and explain what you dropped and why.

  • Real engineering background, or close enough to engineers that you have a genuine gut sense of what's a week of work versus a quarter.

  • Comfortable working async, we're a distributed, mostly-Europe team with no daily standups holding your hand.

Bonus: experience in data integration, analytics, or martech. Familiarity with ETL/APIs. Zero-to-one experience building a function from nothing.

The offer

Competitive pay, on par with a well-funded Series A/B SaaS company, with upside tied to outcomes. Real ownership, you're the first PM here, not the fifth one fighting for scope.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

About the Role

As an LLM Application Engineer, you will build the intelligence layer that powers ActAI's AI experiences.

You will work at the intersection of LLMs, software engineering, and product - designing agent workflows, improving model behaviour, and turning AI capabilities into reliable user experiences.

You will own problems end-to-end, from understanding user needs, designing Agentic workflows, integrating models and tools, building evaluation system and continuously improving AI behaviour in production.

Focus

  • Build and ship LLM-powered applications and AI agent workflows

  • Design systems for reasoning, planning, memory, tool uuse and multi-step execution

  • Build reliable orchestration pipelines that turn probabilistic model outputs into predictable, observable, and safe actions

  • Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, search, internal services, and external tools.

  • Develop prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool-calling, and other techniques to improve model behaviour

  • Build evaluation frameworks and datasets to measure AI quality, reliability, and regressions

  • Debug AI systems across the entire stack—from model behaviour and prompts to orchestration, backend services, and product UX

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to turn ambiguous product problems into working AI solutions

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

  • Growth Marketing

  • Product Development

  • AI & Automation

  • Strategic Partnerships

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

  • No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.

  • No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.

  • Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

  • Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

  • Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

  • Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Who You Are

  • First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

  • Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

  • Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

  • Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

Our Tools

jobs.description:
Mid Weight Video Editor & Producer (AI & Performance Ads)

Core Compensation: $58,000–$70,000 (Base and Bonus)

Location: Remote in USA

About the Role

PetLab Co. is a leader in the DTC pet supplement market, with 9-figure revenue. We're profitable and growing fast around the world.

In performance marketing, a Video Editor does more than make things look good. Every cut, hook and caption you make exists to stop the scroll, hold attention and drive a purchase. You'll be judged on how your ads perform, not on how cinematic they are.

This is a Mid weight, editing-led role for someone with a proven track record of AI-powered performance ads. You'll produce high volumes of ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube that are built to convert. You'll mix UGC, creator footage, stock, and AI-generated video, avatars and voiceovers.

You'll work closely with our Creative Strategists, Paid Media, Video Producers, Organic Social and Influencer teams. This isn't a cut-to-brief role. You'll bring your own ideas, write scripts and hooks, and help shape the creative strategy behind ads that scale customer acquisition and revenue.

Who Will You Report Into?

Hi, I'm Michael, Head of Innovation. We're looking for an experienced, fast editor who's obsessed with direct response and has already built a career on AI-powered ads. You'll be a core part of our in-house creative engine, working day to day with industry-leading creative strategists. You'll see exactly how your ads perform, and you'll have a direct impact on how we acquire customers. If you've made hundreds of AI ads that convert and want to do your best work at a 9-figure DTC brand, let's talk.

What You'll be Responsible For:

1. Performance Video Editing – You'll spend most of your week in the timeline, turning briefs and raw footage into ads that convert. This will include:

  • Editing short-form video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube from briefs supplied by our Creative Strategists
  • Writing hooks for the first 3 seconds, keeping the pacing tight, and making sure something visual changes every 2–3 seconds to hold attention
  • Adding captions, text overlays, sound design, music and clear calls-to-action that suit each platform
  • Cutting UGC, creator, influencer, studio and stock footage into native-feeling ads
  • Exporting in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9, with files named and organized so media buyers can launch right away
  • Testing new AI tools to give you that extra edge!

The goal: ads that stop the scroll and drive purchases.

2. Creative Strategy & Scripting – You won't just execute briefs. You'll help come up with the ideas behind them. This will include:

  • Writing direct-response scripts, hooks and CTAs for UGC, creator, AI-avatar and product ads
  • Pitching new concepts and angles based on performance data, customer pain points and trending formats
  • Working with our Creative Strategists to turn insights into briefs, storyboards and shot lists
  • Adapting winning scripts into new angles, personas and hook variations for testing
  • Bringing an editor's eye to strategy: spotting what will hold attention before it's made

The goal: ideas and scripts that are built to convert from the first frame.

3. AI Video Production – AI is already part of how we make ads, and it should be part of how you work every day. This will include:

  • Generating AI video, AI avatars/spokespeople, product B-roll and lifestyle scenes with tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen and Arcads
  • Creating AI voiceovers and localized versions with tools such as ElevenLabs
  • Fixing AI outputs so they hold up as real ads: character consistency, product accuracy and overall realism
  • Using AI to speed up editing, such as auto-captions, transcript-based editing, upscaling and cleanup
  • Building repeatable AI workflows and templates, and sharing what works with the team

The goal: more high-quality ads, made faster, at lower cost.

4. Iteration & Testing – You'll help our strategists find winning ads and scale them through fast variations. This will include:

  • Producing many versions of winning ads with new hooks, intros, avatars, lengths and messaging
  • Building versions that change one variable at a time for structured A/B tests (for example, Hook A vs Hook B)
  • Reviewing performance data (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and drop-off points with the team, then re-editing to fix weak spots
  • Studying competitor and trending ads so PetLab's creative stays native to each platform

The goal: keep improving creative performance by testing at volume.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like:

  • 60% Editing & AI production: performance video editing and AI video generation
  • 25% Creative & scripting: ideation, scriptwriting and briefing with strategists
  • 15% Iteration & analysis: building test variations and reviewing performance data

Requirements

We're looking for someone with deep editing craft, a direct-response mindset and a proven track record with AI ads.

You must have:

  • 4+ years of video editing experience, including at least 2 years focused on paid social ads for DTC or eCommerce brands
  • Proven experience creating AI-powered ads and creative. Your portfolio must include AI-generated ads you made, with the tools you used and your role in each
  • Hundreds, ideally thousands, of paid social ads produced across your career, with measurable results (e.g. ROAS, CPA, scaled spend)
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the confidence to present ideas, take feedback and work with a global team
  • AI video tools as part of your daily workflow, not something you're still learning (e.g. Veo, Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Arcads, ElevenLabs)

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Regional Retail Operations Team Lead to join our Retail Team as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


Role Overview

As Regional Retail Operations Team Lead, you'll oversee retail operations across Anambra - managing stock reconciliation, inventory allocation, phone repairs, reverse logistics, and shop assistant support across multiple retail points. You'll manage stock shortage mitigation, DSR holding levels, aged stock returns, cancellations, and payment collections. You'll coach shop assistants on processes and systems, develop retail strategies that support business objectives, train new Stock Controllers, and create virtual depot operations. You'll resolve operational issues as they arise and track shop assistant performance.

About Us

M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit to underserved customers across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. We now serve 10 million customers and have extended $2B+ in credit, backed by 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents. 86% of our customers are satisfied, and 55% are first-time users of formal financial services.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our office in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Manager, Retail Operation.

What makes this different

In most retail jobs, stock is a cost line. Here, it is the product that carries a customer’s credit journey. If a device is missing, a repair runs late or a DSR is out of stock, someone’s access to finance stalls. You will see the effect of your work in customer satisfaction, not just in a stock report.

Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help optimize the web experiences that connect customers around the world with Keeper’s cybersecurity solutions.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

As a Technical SEO/GEO Developer, you will combine hands-on web development expertise with technical SEO knowledge to improve Keeper’s global websites across search visibility, crawlability, site performance and user experience.

You will work closely with Search Optimization, Product Marketing and Engineering to identify technical issues, implement fixes and ensure new and existing web experiences follow SEO best practices. This includes areas such as canonicalization, internationalization, indexing, structured data, redirects, metadata, internal linking and site performance.

  • Strong proficiency with HTML, CSS and JavaScript

jobs.description:
Position Title: Senior Security Engineer

Reports to: VP Engineering

Location: UK, Remote

Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About BibliU

BibliU is an award-winning, technology-led B2B company transforming the $65bn educational content industry. With a 90% CAGR the past 5 years, we are just getting started. We've cracked the code on Day 1 access to affordable digital course materials for students, while delivering comprehensive campus store solutions that foster human relationships, and increase our stickiness in the world of AI.

The result? Measurable impact: 10% higher student retention, 1-point GPA increases, and partnerships with 170 universities serving 600,000 students each year.

We've fundamentally changed how universities procure, distribute, and manage learning content. We partner with 4,000+ publishers, including Pearson, Oxford University Press, and Wiley to deliver content to universities, and provide rich engagement data and interactive tools like quizzes that help students actually learn.

Here's what makes our story compelling:

Founded in late 2015 as an Oxford University spin out, we've grown explosively with 90% CAGR over the last five years, including 65% in FY25, reaching $100m in annual revenue. Our Series B raised $23m led by Nesta Impact Investments (with Guinness Asset Management, Stonehage Fleming, and Oxford Sciences Enterprises). In late 2023, we acquired Texas Book Company (now 'BibliU Campus') to become the only fully vertically integrated player in the market, driving US organic growth which now represents 90% of our business.

We're hungry for more. We're actively building our M&A pipeline as we compete head-to-head against legacy bricks-and-mortar providers to improve the faculty and student experience while boosting the financial sustainability of universities.

Our culture is collaborative, high-growth, and agile. You’ll join an experienced and motivated executive team with backgrounds from Instructure (Canvas) and other successful edtech companies with exit experience. We operate as a distributed team across the UK and US, with offices in London.

Position Overview

We're hiring a Security Engineer to own the security posture of our platform and production workloads. This is a hands-on engineering role sitting at the intersection of architecture, engineering and security. You’ll make sure security is designed into systems rather than bolted on afterwards, test whether our security assumptions and controls actually work, and help teams build systems that remain secure and resilient when things go wrong. Your role will include running offensive testing against our own infrastructure.

A significant part of the role is securing how we build and ship AI products. As teams move faster with AI-assisted development, you'll define the sandboxing, isolation, permissions and guardrail patterns that let that happen safely, and tune them as the tooling and threat landscape change.

You'll work in close partnership with Engineering and our AI practice, embedded in design reviews and delivery work rather than reviewing from the outside. Our IT function leads compliance administration, you’ll provide the engineering expertise and technical controls needed to support SOC 2, GDPR and PCI DSS obligations. We value evidence over assumptions - we want to know whether security measures work in practice, not simply whether they exist.

What you will be doing:

  • Own the engineering implementation and continuous improvement of security controls supporting SOC 2 Type II, working with IT on evidence collection and external audits
  • Act as the security partner in architecture and design reviews, setting secure-by-default patterns for new services, data flows, and integrations, while making pragmatic trade-offs between risk and delivery
  • Design, propose, and tune sandboxing and isolation models for AI-assisted and AI-generated code, including execution boundaries, secrets handling, permissions, dependency controls, and output validation
  • Own our offensive security testing, combining internal application, cloud and infrastructure testing with third-party penetration testing where useful; test whether important security assumptions actually hold, and verify remediation
  • Maintain and extend our GDPR and PCI DSS control posture, working with Legal, Finance, and Engineering on data mapping, retention, cardholder-data scope, and DPIAs
  • Work with Platform Engineering to tune security tooling and automation across the SDLC: SAST, DAST, dependency and container scanning, IaC policy checks, and CI/CD gates - focussing on high-signal, actionable checks and removing controls or gates that create friction without materially reducing risk
  • Lead threat modelling for high-risk services and AI features, and translate findings into prioritised, actionable engineering work
  • Work with Engineering to improve detection and response capability: logging coverage, alerting quality, runbooks, and participation in incident response
  • Support customer and prospect security reviews, questionnaires, and due diligence with accurate, evidence-backed responses
  • Raise the security baseline across engineering through guidance, tooling, and enablement rather than gatekeeping

What we are looking for

Must have:

  • 5+ years in a security engineering, application security, or cloud security role, with meaningful time spent hands-on rather than purely advisory
  • Direct experience operating or contributing to SOC 2 Type II controls in a live environment, not just preparing for an initial audit, but sustaining and evidencing controls over time
  • Practical penetration testing skills: web application, API, and cloud infrastructure testing, with the ability to run assessments internally and validate third-party findings
  • Strong cloud security background (AWS): IAM design, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, and workload isolation
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS requirements and how to scope, segment, and evidence a cardholder-data environment
  • Solid grasp of GDPR as it applies to engineering: lawful basis, data minimisation, retention, subject rights, cross-border transfers, and sub-processor management
  • Secure architecture and threat modelling experience across distributed, service-based systems
  • Strong hands-on engineering ability: able to read and reason about application code, write scripts and automation, and integrate security checks into CI/CD
  • Experience securing containerised workloads and infrastructure-as-code (Kubernetes, OpenTofu, or equivalents)
  • Ability to influence engineers and product teams without authority, make pragmatic risk trade-offs rather than absolutist ones, and challenge security controls that create cost or friction without proportionate benefit
  • Clear written communication: you'll be producing control documentation, findings, and customer-facing security responses
  • Experience securing AI/LLM systems: prompt injection, tool-use and agent permissions, model and data exfiltration risks, RAG pipeline security, and evaluation of AI-generated code

Good to have:

  • Exposure to ISO 27001, or experience running a multi-framework compliance programme
  • Offensive security certifications (OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT) or equivalent demonstrable experience
  • Detection engineering and SIEM experience, including writing and tuning detections
  • Familiarity with AI security frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, or ISO/IEC 42001
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment, particularly one handling sensitive personal data at scale
  • Background in EdTech, or experience with sector-specific requirements such as accessibility, student data privacy (FERPA), or institutional procurement security reviews
  • Experience using controlled security experiments, incident simulations, chaos engineering, or similar techniques to test how systems behave when assumptions or safeguards fail
  • Prior involvement in incident response for a real production incident, including post-incident review

Benefits

Our benefits are all aimed at supporting a healthy work-life balance and cultivating a company culture where you can bring your whole, human self to work.

Here's what we offer:

  • 🌴 35 days holiday per year (excluding public holidays!) - yep, that’s not a typo!
  • 🎂 Your birthday off
  • 🌱 12 scheduled company wellness Fridays off per year
  • ❤️ Enhanced maternity & paternity allowance
  • ⏰ Flexible working hours - we’re a remote team spread across the US and UK
  • 💻 Work-from-home allowance to help you set up your dream WFH station
  • 🚴 Cycle-to-work scheme (UK)
  • 🛟 Life Insurance up to 4 x salary
  • ❤️ Private health insurance
  • 👁️ Annual eye test and up to £100 towards frames for glasses required for DSE work

We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds, experiences and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective and BibliU is committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone can do rewarding work.

Please note: We do not work with external recruiters/recruitment agencies. This position will be filled directly by BibliU and we kindly request that external recruiters/recruitment agencies refrain from submitting candidates for this role.

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is looking for a dynamic individual to serve as Clinical Admissions Therapist. The Clinical Admissions Therapist will be responsible for meeting with clients upon admission, building rapport, completing biopsychosocial assessments, and establishing treatment needs.

We’re a mission-driven team working to expand access to life-saving behavioral healthcare for people who need it most. Across all departments, we collaborate to deliver meaningful outcomes and build a more connected, effective model of care. Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

Job Title: Hybrid Cloud Architect
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Experience: 8+ years
Salary - $100K – $150K
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.

For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Hybrid Cloud Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers — AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI — for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define multi-cloud strategy, target-state architecture, and adoption guardrails across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI as relevant.
  • Design federated identity, SSO, and cross-cloud authorization patterns that let workloads and engineers move between providers without compromising on least-privilege, auditability, or operational simplicity.
  • Architect cross-cloud networking including transit hubs, private connectivity, and zero-trust patterns.
  • Establish reusable infrastructure-as-code patterns that abstract cloud-specific implementations where appropriate.
  • Define container, Kubernetes, and serverless strategies that work consistently across providers.
  • Design data architecture strategies for cross-cloud data movement, residency, and analytics.
  • Drive multi-cloud observability, security monitoring, and unified policy enforcement, designing approaches that work consistently across providers and avoid the complexity of fragmented per-cloud tooling stacks.
  • Establish FinOps practices that operate consistently across multiple cloud providers.
  • Lead disaster recovery and business continuity strategies that span clouds.
  • Partner with security architects on multi-cloud security models, KMS strategies, and key management.
  • Provide guidance to engineering teams on when to use cloud-agnostic versus cloud-native patterns.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Engage with cloud providers and partners to evaluate roadmap alignment.
  • Stay current with multi-cloud platform and tooling developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in cloud architecture roles.
  • Hands-on architecture experience across at least two major cloud providers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security across multiple providers.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code across clouds.
  • Experience designing federated identity and SSO across cloud platforms.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container platforms, and managed cloud services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Multiple cloud certifications across providers.
  • Track record of leading multi-cloud architecture initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with abstraction platforms (Crossplane, Pulumi, Terraform CDK).
  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic observability platforms.
  • Experience driving large-scale cloud-to-cloud migrations.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with multi-cloud mandates.
  • Public talks or writing on multi-cloud architecture.

jobs.description:
Risk Model Engineer — Pipeline Integrity (Transmission)

Location: Remote (US or Canada)
Department: Insights (AI/ML)
Reports to: Data Science Team Lead

About the Role

Irth is building a new AI-driven threat and risk management platform for pipeline asset integrity. The platform brings together three capabilities that have never previously lived in one place at Irth:

  • A governed, cross-product data platform built on Databricks and Azure.
  • An AI-powered ingestion layer that normalizes, repairs, and enriches customer data without services-heavy onboarding.
  • A reusable analytical layer that runs industry-standard, Irth-developed, and customer-built risk models against that data.

We are hiring a Risk Model Engineer to own the transmission risk models within this analytical layer.

Operators already run our probabilistic threat models in production inside the application. In this role, you will translate those models to the new platform, extend coverage across the transmission threat set, and build Irth’s own model library alongside our existing model suite.

Your work will produce risk outputs that pipeline operators need to understand, defend, and stand behind with regulators. The role spans physics-based probabilistic models and machine learning, feeding reliability calculations that remain explainable and defensible.

You will own the model content: what it computes, why it computes it, and the evidence that demonstrates it is correct.

Productionization—including serving, pipelines, deployment, and monitoring infrastructure—is owned by dedicated ML Ops and data engineering teams that you will work with closely every day.

Key Responsibilities

Model Migration & Integration

  • Migrate existing probabilistic model code to the risk management platform and validate results against the current implementation.
  • Integrate model inputs from diverse datasets sourced across Irth’s product offerings.

Model Development

  • Extend threat coverage across domains including:
    • Corrosion
    • Cracking
    • Third-party damage
    • Outside forces
    • Other transmission pipeline threats
  • Design and build time-series, anomaly detection, and geospatial models applied to inspection, sensor, and maintenance data.
  • Implement industry-standard probabilist

Requirements

Skills We’re Hiring For

We’re hiring for the capabilities below, but we do not expect a single candidate to have all of them. Deep expertise in one or more areas, combined with the ability to learn and collaborate across the others, is what matters.

  • Experience building or validating quantitative risk, reliability, or failure models for physical infrastructure. Pipeline experience is ideal; experience with rail, structural, water, electric, or other utility assets transfers well.
  • Familiarity with pipeline integrity standards and regulations, such as ASME B31.8S, 49 CFR 192, CSA Z662, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Experience with fitness-for-service and remaining-strength assessment, corrosion growth modeling, or fracture mechanics.
  • Experience working with inline inspection (ILI) data, including vendor formats, data alignment, anomaly classification, and feature disposition.
  • Experience with Monte Carlo simulation, structural reliability, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Experience applying machine learning to physical asset data, including time-series, survival, anomaly detection, and classification models trained and validated against sparse or imbalanced events.
  • Experience with consequence-area and class-location analysis.
  • Geospatial analysis experience, including tools and technologies such as ArcGIS, PostGIS, or linear referencing.
  • Experience producing model validation evidence suitable for regulatory, audit, customer, or other formal review.
  • Strong software engineering practices, including testing, code review, reproducibility, and disciplined use of AI-assisted development tools.

Success Metrics

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • Existing models are running on the new platform with validated parity against the current implementation.
  • New threat models take advantage of the integration of Irth datasets to produce meaningful analytical capabilities.
  • Customer-built models are successfully implemented, validated, and supported on the platform.
  • Validation evidence stands up to design-partner and regulatory review, with every model output reproducible and traceable.
  • You collaborate effectively with data engineering, ML Ops, data science, and subject-matter experts to move models from concept through validated implementation.

Location: Remote within the US or Canada

  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match.

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

About the Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how some of the world's largest retailers manage and grow their digital businesses on Instacart.

You'll own Retailer App as a platform, building a consumer-grade experience where retailers can easily manage their storefronts, discover and adopt new capabilities, and take greater control of their businesses. You'll also build the foundations that enable product teams across Instacart to deliver great retailer experiences quickly, consistently, and safely.

In parallel, you'll own Analytics & Insights, one of Retailer App's core products, transforming retailer data into actionable insights that help retailers grow.

Across both areas, you'll set a compelling multi-half product vision and strategy, translating customer needs into differentiated products and measurable outcomes. You'll be expected to operate with exceptional ownership and velocity, driving complex initiatives from ambiguity to launch, aligning teams across Product, Design, Engineering, and Data, and working directly with leading enterprise retailers to uncover needs and deliver scalable solutions.

This role offers a unique combination of platform-wide influence, end-to-end product ownership, and direct business impact — with the opportunity to define the next generation of retailer tools.

About the Team - Instacart’s Enterprise Platform team is responsible for the white-label product that enables retailers of all sizes to compete online through their own ecommerce experiences. The team is focused on platform growth and long-term retailer success — from onboarding new partners to helping them acquire, serve, and retain their end customers in ways that align with their unique brand and strategy.

About the Job

Retailer App Platform — Build a consumer-grade retailer experience

  • Build a consumer-grade experience: Make Retailer App intuitive, cohesive, and delightful, with seamless navigation, personalized homepages, and end-to-end workflows that make it effortless for retailers to get their jobs done.
  • Drive feature discovery and adoption: Surface and merchandise the growing suite of Storefront Pro capabilities so retailers can easily discover valuable features, understand their benefits, and adopt or upgrade to unlock more value.
  • Empower retailers through self-service: Build intuitive self-service experiences that allow retailers to explore, configure, and manage their storefront capabilities with greater flexibility, transparency, and control.
  • Enable teams to build fast and safely: Establish reusable components, templates, common UX patterns, and governance frameworks that help product teams ship high-quality, consistent retailer experiences with speed and confidence.
  • Own the end-to-end experience: Set the vision and standards for Retailer App across product teams, ensuring individual features come together into one coherent, exceptional experience rather than a collection of disconnected tools.

Analytics & Insights — Turn retailer data into growth

  • Make performance understandable: Build intuitive analytics experiences that give retailers visibility into their commerce, content, and product performance, helping them understand what's happening and why.
  • Turn data into actionable insights: Move beyond traditional dashboards to deliver personalized, data-backed recommendations that surface the most valuable opportunities to grow.
  • Connect insights to action: Enable retailers to act directly on recommendations through streamlined workflows, automation, and AI-powered capabilities.
  • Shape the future of retailer intelligence: Build toward a proactive, intelligent experience that continuously helps retailers identify opportunities, optimize their businesses, and measure impact.

Product Leadership, Execution & Collaboration

  • Set product direction: Define a compelling multi-half vision and strategy, translating customer needs and emerging technologies into a pragmatic roadmap with measurable outcomes.
  • Execute with speed and ownership: Independently drive complex initiatives from ambiguity to launch, making smart tradeoffs and delivering high-quality products with exceptional throughput.
  • Lead across teams: Influence and align a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, navigating competing priorities and driving decisions without direct authority.
  • Build in deep partnership: Work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and other product teams to deliver cohesive experiences across a complex platform.
  • Stay close to customers: Engage directly with leading enterprise retailers to uncover needs, validate solutions, and turn complex requirements into scalable products.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B product management experience, including 2+ years building platform products.
  • Exceptional product craft and UX judgment: Strong intuition for creating intuitive, elegant experiences that simplify complex customer workflows.
  • Strong platform product thinking: Experience building scalable platforms, shared capabilities, and frameworks that enable multiple teams to deliver products efficiently and consistently.
  • Exceptional ownership and execution: Proven ability to independently set direction, navigate ambiguity, make high-quality decisions, and ship complex products at high velocity.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Ability to influence teams without direct authority, align stakeholders with competing priorities, and drive decisions across a broad product surface.
  • Customer-centric product strategy: Ability to deeply understand customer problems and translate them into differentiated, scalable solutions.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills: Fluent in quantitative and qualitative decision-making, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies and build trust with senior leaders and enterprise customers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building B2B SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, or products used to manage complex business workflows.
  • Experience with e-commerce, retail technology, content management systems, or site-building platforms.
  • Experience building analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven recommendation products.
  • Experience using AI to create more intelligent, proactive, or automated product experiences.
  • Experience with configuration platforms, developer enablement, or B2B self-service tools.

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

Group Facilitator - SUD JD

Why Charlie Health?Young people across the nation are grappling with a mental health crisis characterized by escalating rates of depression, anxiety, trauma, substance use disorders, and suicide. Individuals who seek support are met by geographical and financial barriers, driving increased urgency for a new approach to behavioral health treatment.

At Charlie Health, our mission is to connect the world to life-saving mental health treatment. Our treatment programs combine curated peer groups, individual therapy, and family therapy into personalized, evidence-based treatment plans to provide long-term healing from home. By prioritizing connections among young people with shared mental health experiences and goals, Charlie Health fosters sustainable healing and achieves industry-leading clinical outcomes, with over 90% of our clients seeing improvement in their most severe mental health symptoms.

Every member of the Charlie Health team is fueled by an unwavering passion for our mission. If you share this commitment, we invite you to join us in making a tangible impact on the mental health landscape.

About the Role Charlie Health is hiring exceptional candidates with a Masters degree in mental health and previous work experience facilitating groups to provide remote, telehealth services to our adolescent and young adult clients. We’re eager to work with forward-thinking mental health professionals to enhance our programming and provide the best possible care to our clients.

People know Charlie Health for our warm and empathetic clinical team. While each individual clinician has their own interests, expertise, and style, we require all team members to be well versed in a variety of modalities. Our clients are struggling to cope with underlying mental health issues and benefit from therapists that are sophisticated and relational. Successful candidates are committed to bettering the mental health of their clients, along with being adept at self-care, ensuring they are prepared to give their best every day to address the youth mental health crisis.

Responsibilities

  • Complete all Onboarding requirements within 2 weeks of start date
  • Meet with your assigned Charlie Health Group Quality Supervisor or Group Quality Director at a minimum of 1x/month for required check-in
  • Respond to all email and Slack communication promptly (within 48 hours of receiving a communication)
  • Review the curriculum aligned to group assignment before group start time
  • Arrive ~10 minutes early to scheduled group time and facilitate all groups for the entirety of the hour
  • Facilitate groups following Charlie Health best practices and using assigned and most up to date Charlie Health curriculum
  • Foster a supportive environment and guide clients in activities to develop skills for long-term recovery.
  • Facilitate groups across age groups and cohorts, including Integrative curriculum, Support Staffing and Wellness Hour as needed
  • Foster client engagement and group cohesion throughout the session, encouraging client participation and fostering camera-on culture
  • Following all operational policies and procedures as indicated by Charlie Health best practices
  • Participate in collaborative Treatment Team (Tuesdays) and Group Supervision (every other Friday) with your assigned Charlie Health Group Quality Supervisor or Group Quality Director, peers and other Clinical Leadership team members
  • Work collaboratively and respectfully across the care team including with Primary Therapists, Care Experience Specialists and Care Coaches
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and promptly with all clients, staff, families, agencies, and referents
  • Monitor your treatment documentation to ensure all of your notes are completed within required 24 hour timeframe and meet agency and professional standards per DHCS and The Joint Commission standards
  • Maintain and model professional ethics, including appropriate boundaries and confidentiality
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Required candidates will have addiction credentials (CADC-I, CADC-II, CADC-III, CATC I, II, III, IV, V, SUD-CC, RAS, RAS-i, MATS, APCC, ASW, AMFT, LCSW, LPCC, LMFT)
  • Must be available during late afternoons and evenings on weekdays (3-8pm MT on Monday to Thursday) and on Saturdays to meet the schedules of our adolescent and young adult clients
