Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Product Operations team is looking for a hands-on builder to join our Platform team and help accelerate our enterprise-ready roadmap. You will support the Billing, Org & Auth, and Security product teams, working closely with R&D leaders to turn ambiguous questions into rigorous analyses, repeatable workflows, and internal tools used across our Product and Engineering organization.

You move ARR. Not "contribute to." Revenue (or an equivalent business result) grows because of decisions you made. You might investigate why enterprise customers stall on a security or permissions requirement, combine signals from thousands of support tickets and customer conversations to find what's blocking expansion, or build a dashboard that helps hundreds of product managers and engineers see how platform gaps translate into pipeline and retention risk.

This is an individual-contributor role for someone who has already shown they can build and ship. You do not need a technical background. However, you do need to use modern AI and development tools to move beyond a prototype: work with data, write and debug code using AI, validate the results, put a useful tool in front of users, and improve it until people trust and rely on it.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States and Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and, most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set you up for success and have built a culture of rapid career development, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: Our vision to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that encourages you to do your best.
  • You measure yourself by revenue outcomes: You want your work tied directly to ARR, and you're accountable for the result, not just the activity.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive ARR through platform decisions. Identify the enterprise-readiness gaps that most limit new business, expansion, and retention, and shape prioritization so that fixing them measurably moves ARR.
  • Accelerate enterprise-ready delivery by partnering with the Billing, Org & Auth, and Security product teams to define priorities, remove blockers, and track progress against the commitments customers and Sales are waiting on.
  • Build and ship internal data and AI products that help Product and Engineering teams understand platform usage, customer friction, and the highest-impact opportunities to improve.
  • Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data, including product telemetry, support tickets, customer conversations, feature requests, surveys, and product metadata, to find patterns that would be difficult to see manually.
  • Turn one-time analyses into reliable, repeatable tools and workflows with clear data definitions, quality checks, documentation, and feedback loops.
  • Translate complex findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for R&D leadership, while preserving the evidence and methodology behind them.
  • Quantify the revenue impact of platform investments and report on it, so every roadmap bet has a clear, defensible ARR case before and after launch.
  • Own projects end to end: scope the problem, identify and connect the right data, build the first version, launch it, measure adoption and business impact, and continue improving it.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully, checking outputs, debugging failures, and applying sound judgment rather than treating generated work as automatically correct.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in a role such as product operations, data or product analytics, business operations, consulting, technical product management, or another environment where you solved ambiguous problems with data and technology.
  • A demonstrated record of building and shipping something useful for real users, such as an internal tool, application, dashboard, automation, data product, or repeatable analytical workflow.
  • A track record of connecting your work to revenue or an equivalent business result (ARR, retention, expansion, cost), and the ability to show how your decisions caused it.
  • Experience structuring and analyzing messy or large datasets, validating the results, and explaining what the analysis does and does not prove.
  • Strong product and customer judgment: you start with the user problem and business outcome, not the technology.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain technical or analytical work to non-technical partners and executives without losing the important details.
  • High ownership, curiosity, and attention to detail. You are comfortable learning quickly, asking sharp questions, forming a point of view, and iterating through ambiguity.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in a B2B technology company or working closely with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience in Product Operations functions: defining and tracking product roadmaps and feature requests, and bringing the voice of the customer to every product conversation.
  • Familiarity with enterprise platform domains such as billing and monetization, identity, access, and org management, or security and compliance, and with what enterprise buyers require in each.

Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$126,000—$202,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

About the role

We are looking for a fullstack engineer with a strong backend center of gravity who enjoys designing reliable systems, thinking rigorously about correctness, and applying strong software fundamentals to real-world operational problems.

Platform touches both client facing features as well as internal tooling. The capabilities we own are the ones our users touch most often: how workflows and dashboards are configured, how fast a screen full of exceptions loads, how consistently permissions behave, how reliably a release reaches production. When the platform is right, every product team ships better software faster, and that lands directly with the tens of thousands of people who use blp every day. Platform decisions here are judged by what they do for our users, not by internal elegance.

What you'll do

  • Build the Foundation: Design and develop the shared backend services and APIs that our product teams depend on, with clear contracts and abstractions that fit how they actually work.

  • Drive User Impact: Work with product teams and business stakeholders to understand where the platform is holding them back, communicate trade-offs openly, and turn that into concrete improvements our users feel.

  • Own Reliability and Correctness: Build and operate systems with a strong focus on robustness, and improve them continuously through careful analysis and iteration. Managing entropy in a complex system is part of the job, and we expect you to adapt accordingly.

  • Build Great Software: Write clean, maintainable, high-quality code across the stack. Conduct code reviews and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.

  • Shape Architecture: Collaborate on system design, tech stack decisions, and platform boundaries, optimizing for scalability, performance, and maintainability.

  • Lead and Influence: Guide technical direction on major initiatives such as migrations and platform capabilities, and mentor team members along the way.

  • Promote Innovation and Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues to continuously improve processes, tools, and team practices, fostering a culture of learning and growth.

The tech stack includes Golang, React/TypeScript, Python, various ML models, MySQL, F#, Docker images deployed on a Kubernetes cluster in our cloud infrastructure (GCS, AWS, or Azure), and GitHub CI/CD.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role, with a clear backend focus.

  • Genuine fullstack capability: comfortable working in a modern React/TypeScript codebase, even if backend is where you do your deepest work.

  • Experience with functional programming concepts or languages.

  • Passionate about software craftsmanship: strong understanding of core engineering principles including type systems, composition, testing, Clean Code, and Clean Architecture.

  • Product thinking: ability to translate business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately into code.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: link your daily work to team and company goals, balance cost and benefit, deliver high-quality solutions efficiently.

  • Ownership: take responsibility for your technical work, for the platform we build, and for the team we shape.

  • Abstraction and efficient communication: simplify complex systems, identify core concepts, and communicate complex ideas clearly.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with ERP systems, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes.

  • Background in a platform, infrastructure, or developer experience team.

  • Experience with large-scale migrations or incremental modernization of an existing codebase.

  • German language skills.

What we value

We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building a platform that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable. Because our work sits underneath every product team, we also value people who can hold both perspectives at once: the rigor to get the foundation right, and the product sense to know which foundation is worth building.

What you'll get

  • Ownership of the platform layer. Every product team builds on it, and you have real influence over how it's defined.

  • Work that reaches real scale. It lands directly with the tens of thousands of people who use blp every day, not just internal elegance.

  • A high-caliber engineering culture. Collaborative, and one that values correctness and craftsmanship.

  • Structured onboarding. Continuous learning follows as the platform's scope grows.

This role is available on-site in Zurich, London, Barcelona or remotely within Europe.

jobs.description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together

Our Meaningful Mission
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech.Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money: we're building a world that truly recognizes and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

Our Core Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity:We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performanceOur remote-first culture means you have the flexibility to work in your employing country wherever you feel the most focused and productive. This freedom comes with wonderful tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. Think flexible annual leave, great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

About the role
We are changing the way people send money. We’re building digital services that allow people to send and receive money easily. Most of our customers are hard-working migrants from Africa, Asia and Latin America. We’re always seeking to better serve our customers and find ways to improve our product — this role is to help us deliver important new features and innovation in a highly efficient and fast-paced way.

We hire bright people who can work autonomously and make the right decisions. We are looking for an ambitious, results-driven and industry-experienced Senior Product Manager to help drive the business forward. If you are a perceptive leader, enthusiastic problem-solver and strong communicator we look forward to meeting you!

To support Zepz growth strategy and drive maximum impact we are looking for support to drive forward key FinCrime product management strategy and deliveries in the fraud prevention, scams, and payment risk. This will involve applying a cohesive approach to solve different groups of customer needs and ensure a compliant, effective, and efficient set-up and best-in-class customer experience across the platform in a scalable and streamlined manner.

We are looking for a professional that’s comfortable driving change in a dynamic environment across various levels of senior stakeholders. The ideal candidate is an individual with previous experience in delivering complex digital initiatives that span multiple departments. You will be comfortable owning the full digital product life cycle and have a natural drive to deliver exceptional end-to-end experiences.The successful applicant will likely also have previous experience in core fraud-prevention functions, including advanced analytics, reporting, and financial modelling; machine learning and AI; and vendor management. The role is heavily data driven and hands on; and requires someone analytical and hands-on to drive the strategy. Experience implementing stablecoin, working with on-chain analysis vendors, and experience working with AI vendors to optimise processes is also hugely desirable.

What you will own:

As a member of our team reporting to the Product Director - FinCrime, you will:
  • Build and manage stakeholder relationships to gather needs across multiple countries.
  • Help shape the strategy across the FinCrime (Financial-Crime Prevention) domain across both ZEPZ remittance brands supporting fraud prevention, payments risk, vendor roadmap, cryptocurrency-product roadmap (specifically the FinCrime elements).
  • Manage vendor relationships and integrations for telemetric and consortium data, workflow management, and more.
  • Scope, plan, and deliver global feature rollouts in the domain.
  • Develop a clear and coherent product strategy within your area that aligns with the company's vision.
  • Maintain a strong focus on delivering business and user value.
  • Play a crucial role in supporting the growth and scalability of the business.
  • Take ownership and drive the metrics within your area, helping define success and the path to achieve it.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders (and in particular Compliance, Finance, and other Product teams) throughout the organization to deeply understand problems, identify opportunities, and explore potential solutions.
  • Effectively manage stakeholders, knowing when to listen and when to deliver challenging messages.
  • Monitor market trends, regulations, card-network rules, competitor activities, and emerging technologies to drive product decisions and features.

What you bring to the table
You’ll be an experienced Product Manager in the digital Financial-Crime Prevention space
  • Have strong knowledge in the Finance/FinTech and FinCrime space - experience in stablecoin and AI is desirable
  • You are a creative thinker, problem-solver, strong communicator across various levels of stakeholders, you are driven and are thriving when taking full ownership for your product area
  • You are data driven and comfortable working with models, ideally with experience in prediction of fraud, risk modelling, and financial modelling
  • You are hands-on, enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are a natural self-starter
  • You can demonstrate ownership of the product,own the end-to-end process including communication, training, release plan, and continuously improve the product
  • You build strong relationships with your development team, work according to good Agile practices and collaborate effectively with product design.
  • You’re a natural leader. You lead initiatives from ideas to delivery. You help the team deliver with an MVP mindset, but still build towards and share longer term visions.
  • You have a good understanding of relevant technology, how it applies to our business. You use this information when making trade-off and priority decisions.
  • You have strong experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • You have a proven track record of being a great communicator, working with different stakeholders from across the business.
  • You are not afraid of taking on ambiguous initiatives and turning them into a set of clear goals and tangible outcomes
  • You are knowledgeable about Agile / Lean software delivery methodologies and deliverables throughout the product life cycle
  • You have experience in gathering functional and nonfunctional requirements, writing user stories and mapping out processes
  • You are a team player with the commercial mindset to drive tech work for highest business impact
  • Good technical and business understanding based on previous experience in financial services/compliance
  • A strong understanding of current regulations and best practices in fraud prevention and card-payment and bank-transfer arrangements, including ACH
  • Manage the integration work with technology partners (workflows, APIs, error scenarios and management) from ideation to delivery on production and beyond
  • Work against tight regulatory and company deadlines

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work, from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context, whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy. An understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

If you want to join us in our journey to help break barriers in financial access and improve lives globally, there's no better place or time to join.

Our global team of 800+ peopleis spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.

Ready to Apply? Let’s Go.

This isn't an advisory role. You'll be hands-on with the teams you support, building tools that solve real problems and helping people develop new skills they'll carry forward. The scope is company-wide — Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Legal, Customer Success, and beyond. You'll have the autonomy to prioritize where your time creates the most value, and the backing of IT leadership to get things done.

If you've already done this kind of work — transforming how people and teams operate through AI — and you're looking for an environment where you can do it at scale with real ownership, this is the role.

What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences.   • We’re looking for an experienced, commercially-minded Senior Partner Manager to build and own Contentstack’s global agency partner motion.

  • Own the agency go-to-market strategy end to end — including target partner profile, messaging, offerings, and growth plans — across a portfolio of global agencies such as Code & Theory, Omnicom, WPP, Dentsu/Merkle, Razorfish, and Monks.

  • Build the agency go-to-market messaging and offering, positioning Contentstack for marketing leaders and CMOs and helping agencies see where we can compete alongside — and against — enterprise suites like Adobe and Optimizely.
  • Partner with key ISVs to create a compelling better-together story and establish a mutual playbook around the Content Lifecycle demo and vision.
  • Represent Contentstack with agency leadership and their clients through joint activations, executive briefings, live demos, ContentCon, and other market-facing opportunities.
  • Help shape the broader partner organization by serving as a strategic resource on agency motions, messaging, and best practices.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You?

  • 8-12 years of experience in partner, alliances, or channel roles within enterprise SaaS, including at least 4 years working directly with global agencies or agency holding companies. Deep agency experience is critical.
  • Demonstrated experience selling with global agencies, not simply alongside them, and building agency-specific go-to-market motions. You understand why agency partnerships require a different play than GSI partnerships.
  • Proven experience turning opportunistic, project-by-project partner relationships into strategic, agreement-backed partnerships.
  • A balance of partner sales, product marketing, and strategy. You can build the relationship, develop the approach with the resources available, and articulate what we need next.
  • The ability to present a partner go-to-market plan and pitch Contentstack live and unscripted without relying on a Sales Engineer. This will be part of the interview process.
  • A track record of selling to and influencing CMOs and marketing leaders, not only technical buyers.
  • Experience positioning against enterprise suite incumbents such as Adobe and Optimizely, with the ability to apply lessons from both wins and losses.
  • Comfort operating without a finished playbook. You’ve built partner programs, messaging, and enablement from the ground up.
  • Strong communication, executive presence, and influence skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders across Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, and the executive team.
  • Additional experience with headless CMS, DXP, DAM, retail/commerce, content operations, or partner marketing is a plus.
  • You’re comfortable with occasional travel.
  • You value a collaborative, innovative, and fun culture!

Salary for this role ranges between $145,000-165,000 based on skill set and experience

jobs.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. Work directly with engineers on system design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users. You work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application.

What You'll be Doing

  • Research and define end-to-end AI system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact

  • Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions

  • Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback

  • Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization

  • Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops

  • Own product quality end-to-end - correctness, predictability, and user trust

What You Will Need

Technical foundation

  • Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design.

  • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and how modern AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents.

AI & ML experience

  • Hands-on exposure to AI-powered products, including LLM-based systems.

  • Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, bias, and drift.

Product leadership

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Proven ability to work closely with senior engineers and ML teams.

  • Strong judgment and decision-making ability in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Ability to balance ambition with technical and operational reality.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, sequence diagrams, and decision records.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams during solution delivery.
  • Engage with cloud providers and platform partners to evaluate roadmap fit.
  • Track emerging cloud capabilities and ecosystem developments, assessing relevance to current and planned workloads, and recommend strategic adoption based on demonstrated value and operational maturity.
  • Maintain alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security policies, and regulatory obligations, ensuring that cloud designs satisfy both engineering goals and the broader compliance posture of the organization.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in software engineering or solution architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise designing cloud-native solutions on at least one major cloud platform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and platform consolidation programs.
  • Strong understanding of containerization, serverless, and managed data services.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Evaluates medical records, provides clinical and surgical abstraction and assigns appropriate clinical diagnosis and procedure codes in accordance with nationally recognized coding guidelines.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Analyzes medical information from medical records. Accurately codes diagnostic and procedural information in accordance with national coding guidelines and appropriate reimbursement requirements. Consults with medical providers to clarify missing or inadequate record information and to determine appropriate diagnostic and procedure codes. Provides thorough, timely and accurate
2. Abstracts clinical diagnoses, procedure codes and documents other pertinent information obtained from the medical record into the electronic medical records. Seeks out missing information and creates complete records, including items such as disease and procedure codes, discharge disposition, date of surgery, attending physician, consulting physicians, surgeons and anesthesiologists, and appropriate signatures/authorizations. Refers inconsistent patient treatment information/documentation to coding quality analysts, supervisor or individual department for clarification/additional information for accurate code assignment.

3. Provides quality assurance for medical records. For all assigned records and/or areas assures compliance with coding rules and regulations according to regulatory agencies for state Medicaid plans, Center for Medicare Services (CMS), Office of the Inspector General (OIG) and the Health Care Financing Administration (HCFA), as well as company and applicable professional standards.

4. As assigned, compiles daily and monthly reports; tabulates data from medical records for research or analysis purposes.

5. Works independently under regular supervision. Uses specialized knowledge for accurate assignment of ICD/CPT codes according to national guidelines. May seek guidance for correct interpretation of coding guidelines and LCDs (Local Coverage Determinations).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge and specialized formal training equivalent to the two year certification course in medical record keeping principles and practices, anatomy, physiology, pathology, medical terminology, standard nomenclature, and classification of diagnoses and operations, or an Associate’s degree in a related health care field.

Requires at least one of the following: Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist – Physician (CCS-P), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), Certified Professional Coder – Apprentice (CPC-A), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), in an active status with the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) or American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC). Certification may also include a general area of specialty.

Six months providing professional coding services or other related healthcare experience within a broad range of health care facilities.

Must demonstrate a level of knowledge and understanding of ICD and CPT coding principles as recommended by the American Health Information Management Association coding competencies, and as normally demonstrated by certification by the American Academy of Professional Coders.

Must be able to work effectively and efficiently in a remote setting, utilizing common office programs, coding software and abstracting systems.

Specialty Certification.

Job Title: Embedded Linux EngineerJob Category: EngineeringTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

In this position, you will be an Embedded Linux Software Developer supporting the current IRD embedded retransmission device and its next‑generation replacement platform.


The current IRD solution is a customized OpenWrt‑based embedded Linux device that provides networking and retransmission capabilities. It includes firmware image integration, custom OpenWrt packages and feeds, networking and security services, device configuration, and an administrative user interface. The next‑generation effort is migrating the solution to new embedded hardware while evolving the platform toward a Linux‑based solution.


This is an individual‑contributor role. You will primarily execute assigned development, integration, sustainment, and defect‑resolution work while collaborating with senior engineers and cross‑functional teammates on technical direction, platform architecture, hardware integration, cybersecurity, and release planning.

Responsibilities:

  • Be part of an awesome team working with cutting‑edge embedded Linux, networking, and device‑management technologies.
  • Contribute directly to the development, sustainment, and modernization of a mission‑critical embedded retransmission device that is a cornerstone of our product portfolio.
  • Work across the embedded software lifecycle from Linux image creation and platform integration through networking services, device configuration, web‑based administration, testing, and release support.
  • Collaborate with software, hardware, cybersecurity, test, systems engineering, and product teams to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable capabilities.
  • Help migrate an existing OpenWrt‑based device solution to next‑generation embedded hardware and an Alma Linux‑based architecture.
  • Design, develop, integrate, test, debug, and maintain Linux‑based software for embedded networking and retransmission devices.
  • Sustain and enhance the current OpenWrt‑based IRD firmware solution, including image configuration, custom package feeds, services, first‑boot behavior, device configuration, and firmware build integration.
  • Develop and maintain software in Python, Bash or shell scripting, C or C++, and other languages as needed for embedded applications, automation, tooling, and platform integration.
  • Execute development tickets supporting migration of existing IRD capabilities to next‑generation ARM‑based hardware.
  • Assist with bootloader, kernel, board‑support, cross‑compilation, device configuration, and embedded Linux image‑development activities under established technical direction.
  • Develop and maintain Buildroot‑ and Linux‑based image creation, packaging, provisioning, release, update, and deployment workflows.
  • Contribute to the evolution of a Linux or RHEL‑based management architecture.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs and device‑management user‑interface capabilities used to configure networking and device behavior.
  • Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot networking capabilities, including interface configuration, routing, DNS, Wi‑Fi, cellular or modem integration, and secure communications.
  • Create and maintain unit, integration, system, simulation, and hardware‑connected test capabilities.
  • Participate in GitLab merge‑request reviews, CI or CD pipeline maintenance, build validation, release engineering, and reproducible‑build practices.
  • Support secure software development activities, including vulnerability remediation, certificate handling, authentication and authorization, software‑update integrity, dependency management, and CVE analysis.
  • Create and maintain design, build, API, test, and operational documentation.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers, systems engineers, cybersecurity personnel, quality assurance, and product management to implement and validate product requirements.To be successful in this position, you will enjoy solving moderately to highly complex problems that cross embedded Linux, networking, device configuration, platform integration, testing, and security domains.
  • Daily work may include OpenWrt, Alma Linux, ARM‑based devices, API or UI development, image builds, CI or CD, hardware‑connected testing, and secure software sustainment.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of relevant professional software‑development experience.
  • At least five years of experience developing, integrating, testing, or sustaining software for Linux‑based systems, including embedded Linux, Linux platform software, networking appliances, device‑management software, or comparable systems.
  • Experience developing software using Python, Bash or shell scripting, and C or C++.
  • Experience working with Linux system configuration, debugging, networking, package management, and software deployment.
  • Experience developing, integrating, and debugging software for ARM‑ and/or Intel or x86‑based devices.
  • Experience with embedded Linux build systems or distributions such as OpenWrt, Buildroot, Yocto, Embedded Linux, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with cross‑compilation, embedded Linux image creation, software packaging, and deployment to embedded targets.
  • Experience with Linux networking, including network‑interface configuration, routing, DNS, DHCP, firewalling, Wi‑Fi, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience developing and debugging REST APIs, device‑management applications, or web‑based configuration interfaces.
  • Experience with Git and GitLab‑based development practices, including merge requests, code review, and branching strategies.
  • At least two years of experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting automated CI or CD pipelines.
  • Experience creating unit, integration, system, or hardware‑in‑the‑loop tests for software deployed to Linux‑based systems or embedded devices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create and maintain technical documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote, cross‑functional development environment.

Desired:


  • Experience with NXP i.MX8, ARM64 or AArch64, U‑Boot, Linux kernel configuration, device trees, boot flows, or board‑support packages.
  • Experience porting an embedded Linux solution to a new hardware platform or Linux distribution.
  • Experience with OpenWrt buildroots, feeds, package Makefiles, and custom OpenWrt package development.
  • Experience with Alma Linux, RHEL, RPM or DNF, Kickstart, OSTree, SELinux, or RHEL Cockpit.
  • Experience developing Python or Flask applications, OpenAPI or Swagger‑documented APIs, or embedded device‑management UIs.
  • Experience with embedded networking products, retransmission devices, routers, cellular or modem integration, Wi‑Fi, 802.1X, routing, or secure network configuration.
  • Experience with device provisioning, firmware or image installation, update mechanisms, or field‑device sustainment.
  • Experience with secure software‑development practices, certificate or PKI integration, vulnerability scanning, SBOMs, CVE remediation, or tools such as Trivy.
  • Experience with containerized builds, simulated device environments, or hardware‑in‑the‑loop testing.
  • Experience supporting DoD, mission, tactical‑edge, disconnected, or regulated embedded‑device

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

jobs.excerpt: About Creator Accountability NetworkCreator Accountability Network (CAN) is a growing nonprofit organization working to make online communities safer and more ethically accountable.
jobs.description:
About Creator Accountability Network

Creator Accountability Network (CAN) is a growing nonprofit organization working to make online communities safer and more ethically accountable.

CAN operates a training and credentialing program for content creators and supports systems for accountability, victim advocacy, investigation, mediation, and community safety when problematic behavior occurs. Our work is supported by a small staff and an international network of dedicated volunteers.

CAN is entering an important period of growth. With a new strategic plan, an evolving staffing structure, and plans to expand our reach and organizational capacity, we are building the systems and team needed to move from an early-stage organization into its next phase.

We are looking for a Program Director to lead the day-to-day execution of CAN's programs and ensure that strategy becomes action.

About the Role

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the Program Director is CAN's senior leader responsible for program execution, operational coordination, and volunteer-team leadership.

Working closely with the CEO and other team members, the Program Director will translate organizational priorities into clear work plans, effective programs, consistent processes, engaged and supported volunteer teams, and measurable results.

This is a hands-on leadership role. CAN remains a relatively small organization, so the Program Director must be equally comfortable developing systems, leading people, solving problems, and stepping directly into the work when needed.

The role currently oversees volunteer teams supporting Victim Advocacy, Investigations, and Credentialing and will help shape CAN's program structure as the organization grows.

What You'll Do

Lead program execution and operations. Translate CAN's strategic priorities into actionable program plans, milestones, workflows, and measurable outcomes. Oversee core program functions including credentialing, reporting, investigations, victim advocacy, and mediation coordination. Maintain clear documentation, systems, and processes and identify opportunities to improve effectiveness.

Lead and support CAN's volunteer teams. Oversee volunteer recruitment, onboarding, role clarity, engagement, supervision, and retention in alignment with organizational needs. Build and maintain a volunteer structure that supports both strong program delivery and sustainable participation. Regularly assess workload, capacity, and burnout risk; address areas of overextension; and develop practical approaches to improve support, recognition, role clarity, and retention, while maintaining appropriate quality control and risk awareness. Foster a volunteer environment that recognizes the emotional demands of CAN's work and incorporates appropriate trauma-informed practices, boundaries, and support.

Grow CAN’s membership and creator community. Develop and implement CAN’s target-market and membership outreach strategy, including identifying priority communities, platforms, networks, and aligned organizations. Establish and track annual membership growth goals, launch targeted outreach efforts, and create meaningful touchpoints that strengthen engagement among credentialed creators.

Strengthen and evolve CAN’s program model. Help assess CAN’s programs for alignment with audience needs, organizational standards, and available capacity. Lead practical testing of workflows and protocols, including tabletop exercises and scenario-based reviews, and use what is learned to identify gaps, improve processes, and strengthen program readiness.

Measure and improve program performance. Establish and monitor meaningful program metrics, track progress toward work-plan and strategic-plan goals, identify areas that are off track, and regularly communicate results, challenges, and resource needs to the CEO.

Strengthen organizational systems. Help CAN continue its evolution from early-stage processes toward repeatable, sustainable systems. Facilitate coordination across programs and volunteer functions and ensure consistent application of organizational policies and standards.

Support organizational growth. Partner with the CEO and other team members on development, partnerships, grant-related program information, stakeholder engagement, and other initiatives connected to CAN's growth. Represent CAN professionally with external partners when appropriate.

Steward resources responsibly. Manage program activities within approved budgets, identify capacity and resource constraints, and recommend prioritization or structural changes when needed.

Who We're Looking For

We are less interested in finding someone who checks every conventional box than in finding someone who can lead people, build systems, exercise judgment, and move work forward in an evolving organization.

Strong candidates will bring many of the following:

  • Significant experience leading programs, operations, or related work in a nonprofit, mission-driven organization, community setting, or similarly complex environment.
  • Experience in human services, restorative justice, victim advocacy, trauma-informed practice, community safety, mediation, investigations, or related fields is a strong plus.
  • Experience supervising, coordinating, or developing employees and/or volunteers.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn organizational strategy into actionable plans, priorities, and workflows.
  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to manage multiple interconnected areas of work.
  • Experience establishing processes, documentation, metrics, and systems in an organization that is growing or changing.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, and developing people, including employees and/or volunteers, and creating the structure and support they need to succeed.
  • Strong communication skills and sound judgment, including knowing when to solve a problem independently and when an issue should be elevated.
  • Comfort working with sensitive situations and maintaining appropriate confidentiality, boundaries, and discretion.
  • A collaborative leadership style that combines accountability with respect, clarity, and trust.
  • Comfort working remotely with substantial autonomy and collaborating with colleagues and volunteers located across the country.

Please note: At CAN, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace - so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!

How We Work

CAN is building an intentional workplace alongside an intentional organization.

We value people who:

  • Take accountability seriously. We believe accountability includes clarity, follow-through, learning, and a willingness to address difficult issues.
  • Collaborate without avoiding ownership. We value input and shared thinking, while also expecting people to make decisions and move work forward within their responsibilities.
  • Can build while doing. Not every process at CAN is fully developed yet. The right person will see that as an opportunity to help create thoughtful, sustainable systems.
  • Communicate openly. In a fully remote organization, proactive communication, transparency about capacity, and early identification of problems matter.
  • Respect both people and process. CAN's work often involves complicated circumstances and competing perspectives. We value empathy, fairness, discretion, and consistency.
  • Are comfortable with change. CAN is moving from a small, volunteer-heavy organization into a more fully staffed nonprofit. Roles, systems, and priorities will continue to evolve as we grow.

Compensation & Benefits

The anticipated salary range for this full-time position is $75,000-$90,000, depending on experience and qualifications. CAN is developing an expanded employee benefits package as part of its organizational growth. Details will be provided as part of the interview process.

Location

CAN is a fully remote organization, and this position may be performed from anywhere in the United States. While work schedules are flexible and CAN operates across multiple time zones, this role requires meaningful, consistent overlap with Eastern Time business hours to support close coordination with the CEO and other organizational needs. Some travel may be required for organizational meetings, conferences, or stakeholder engagement as CAN grows.

Salary: $75,000-$90,000 per year

Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Risk Management

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Role

Marketing Operations & Data Manager

Payments infrastructure · Full-time · Remote-first

Role Overview

There are a million stablecoin companies. No one is the best at everything. Cyclops offers all the benefits of other leading stablecoin platforms (by fully integrating them), while complementing their weaknesses (each of which have many). This only matters if the leaders in the payments industry understand this.

We are hiring a Marketing Operations & Data Manager to drive improved execution and outcomes across the marketing function — digital presence, every conference, and every interaction with the payments ecosystem. You will play a key role in getting Cyclops to the #1 position when payments companies work on stablecoin solutions.

To be qualified, you must be a payments industry pro, who understands how these companies operate inside and out, from their partnerships and geographic foci, to their internal processes for decision-making and product development.

You will be responsible for looking at the marketing function holistically and ensuring that strategy and execution are always aligned with the mission and delivered on time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Marketing analytics and reporting — build and maintain dashboards that track pipeline contribution, CAC, LTV, conversion rates, campaign performance, and channel attribution. Make the data easy to read and impossible to ignore.
  • Event and field marketing analytics — build the measurement framework for our conference and event investments. Cost per meeting, pipeline generated per event, sponsor ROI, and post-event attribution. You will have a view on which payments conferences deliver and which do not, grounded in data.
  • Marketing tech stack — own the selection, implementation, and integration of marketing tools. CRM hygiene, MAP configuration, attribution modeling, and lead routing all live here.
  • Digital presence and SEO — own the data layer of our organic search strategy. Keyword tracking, content performance, backlink analysis, technical SEO auditing, and ranking monitoring. You understand how search is evolving with AI and you have opinions about what Cyclops should do about it.
  • AIO and GEO tracking — monitor and measure how Cyclops appears in AI-generated search results (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.). Build a framework for tracking AI citation frequency and develop playbooks to improve our presence in these surfaces.
  • Partner campaign operations — own the operations of marketing campaigns with clients and partners
  • Account-based marketing (ABM) infrastructure — build and maintain target account lists, intent signal monitoring, and ABM measurement specific to the payments infrastructure buyer.
  • Competitive and market intelligence — track competitor digital presence, search share, and content performance. Produce regular intelligence briefings for the marketing and leadership team.

The Payments Industry Knowledge We Expect

You do not need to be a payments engineer. But you need to understand the industry well enough to know who our buyers are, how they search, what they read, and what conferences they attend. Specifically:

  • You know the difference between a PSP, an orchestrator, an acquirer, a PayFac, and an ISO — and you understand how their marketing and buying behavior differs.
  • You understand the B2B payments conference ecosystem. You know which events matter (Money20/20, ETA TRANSACT, MPE, Sibos, Nacha, MRC, PayExpo) and how to measure ROI from them.
  • You have worked with payments industry data before — whether that is transaction volume metrics, processing economics, or the terminology that appears in payments press and analyst coverage.
  • You understand what makes a payments company's digital presence credible to a technical B2B buyer, and how that differs from a consumer fintech brand.

Required Qualifications

  • Our ideal candidate has worked at a payments orchestrator, PSP, network, acquirer, PayFac, or a platform that serves payment companies as its primary function.
  • Strong data and analytics skills. You are comfortable with Semrush, google analytics, hubspot, and modeling things out in excel. You can build useful trackers.
  • SEO and AIO experience in a B2B context. You have owned keyword strategy, content performance tracking, technical SEO audits, and rank monitoring. You understand how search results pages are changing and have adapted your approach accordingly.

How we will deliver success together:

Carrier integrations are a critical growth lever for Shippo. As Senior Product Manager, Carrier Capabilities, you are responsible for product strategy, execution, and outcomes for Shippo’s carrier integrations. This is a highly technical, high‑impact role operating at the intersection of product, engineering, carrier partnerships, and operations.

You will define what it means for a carrier to be “well‑integrated” at Shippo, execute and improve reusable carrier capability models, and onboard, upgrade, and operate carriers reliably at scale. Execution & Delivery

Quality, Metrics & Insights

  • Build visibility into carrier health, coverage gaps, and capability maturity to inform roadmap and investment decisions.

Cross‑Functional Leadership

  • Influence without authority across multiple product and engineering teams to drive alignment on shared goals.
  • Be a simplifier. Your communication is a craft that lets you right-size the message for any audience.

Your shipping requirements

  • 4+ years of Product Management experience, with significant experience owning technical platforms or APIs.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and integration patterns.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross‑team initiatives with high ambiguity and high impact.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to influence senior technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Elation Health is deeply committed to helping independent primary care practices take better care of their patients. Elation Health is searching for a Support Subject Matter Expert in Elation Billing — someone who has already done real medical billing and revenue cycle management work, not someone learning it on the job. This is a hands-on, case-based role embedded directly in our support queue: you'll bring practitioner-level RCM judgment to the billing cases our Technical Support Specialists can't fully resolve through process or AI-assisted troubleshooting alone, and you'll help the rest of the team get sharper at spotting those cases in the first place.

This isn't a back-office consulting role. You'll be working live cases day to day alongside our support team, diagnosing whether an issue is a product bug, a payer-specific quirk, or a mismatch between how a practice actually operates and how they've configured their billing workflow — then resolving it with the kind of judgment that only comes from having sat inside a claims lifecycle before.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Elation Billing product line's embedded RCM expert, owning complex billing and revenue cycle cases that require practitioner-level judgment — claims lifecycle issues, CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, payer adjudication and denial patterns, A/R and collections workflows.
  • Act as the go-to resource for case swarms and escalations within Elation Billing whenever a Technical Support Specialist's investigation surfaces a billing nuance beyond scripted troubleshooting.
  • Diagnose a practice's underlying billing context — payment model (insurance-taking vs. DPC), staffing structure, and prior workflow choices — to distinguish genuine product issues from configuration or workflow mismatches, rather than treating every case as a symptom in isolation.
  • Partner with Product and Prod Dev, turning recurring billing edge cases, payer-specific patterns, and denial trends into structured feedback that can inform the roadmap.
  • Contribute to and maintain the team's billing-related knowledge base, SOPs, and macros, and help calibrate the AI Case Assistant's billing-related suggestions so resolutions compound across the team rather than living only in your own case history.
  • Help build the broader team's baseline RCM literacy — sharing real-world billing context so Specialists can better anticipate the issues different practice types are prone to.
  • Track and report on billing-case quality and resolution metrics within your scope, and flag systemic patterns rather than resolving the same root cause case-by-case indefinitely.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on medical billing / revenue cycle management experience — claims submission, payer follow-up, denial management, and A/R — brought in from outside a support organization, not built up through support tenure.

  • Self-directed and detail-oriented, with the judgment to know when a case needs to go beyond a scripted answer.

Ready to help shape how innovative medicines reach patients and healthcare providers across the healthcare ecosystem? As the Associate Director, Market Access Contracting, you will play a critical role in developing and managing market access agreements across Managed Care, Medi-care, Advanced Platforms, and Channel contracts. Partnering closely with pricing, account management, finance, legal, and market access leaders, you'll help drive contracting strategies that support patient access, business growth, and commercial success. This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic and analytically minded professional to influence key decisions, navigate complex market dynamics, and make a meaningful impact across one of the most critical areas of the business.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serving as the central point of contact for the pricing and channel strategy teams, account management, legal, Managed Markets Finance (MMF) operations, government pricing, and senior leadership on all contracting matters related to a designated account list or segment.
  • Working with pricing, channel strategy, and account management in the development of contract proposals and effective negotiation strategies, including working with customer accounts directly in negotiation of contractual documentation.
  • Collaborating with the pricing and channel strategy teams to develop and assess brand contracting strategies.
  • Serve as primary liaison to MMF to ensure accurate understanding and interpretation of contract changes. Provide general oversight to discount and rebate operations team and serve as an approver of various contract price determinations and payment types related to market access contracts (e.g., Managed Care and Medicare rebate payments, GPO, channel, and customer contract price and rebate payments).

  • Ensure all contracts are completed according to determined SLAs and SOPs
  • Preparing regular reports and dashboards for management, key internal stakeholders across market access and brand teams, and external stakeholders to supplement customer and account business and performance reviews. Reporting will include but not limited to formulary tracking, rate tracking, invoice tracking, growth and performance-based rebate tracking across customers and/or channel segments, and general reporting of market share using both claims, IQVIA, sales, and chargeback data.
  • Responsible for accurate and timely reporting of formulary changes in NEXUS across Managed Care and Medicare accounts.

  • Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience
