  • Advanced understanding of legal aspects of contracts and contract interpretation as well as potential pricing impacts. Ability to manage complex contracts and understand potential pricing impacts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex information and data sets in an understandable and compelling manner.
  • Excellent financial and analytical skills and acumen

Desirable Requirements:

  • Extensive knowledge of pharmaceutical and market access contracting and its market segments
  • Experience in all commercial, managed care, and channel environments (HMOs, IPAs, PBMs, GPOs, LTCs, and Specialty Pharmacies), and knowledge of the Medicare contracting marketplace.

This position is responsible for assisting with the coordination of the 340B Drug Pricing Program for all qualified entities throughout the WVU Medicine Health System. The primary focus of this position is to review operating and regulatory compliance procedures and controls to ensure proper application of laws and requirements are met for continued eligibility for the 340B Program. Such review includes ongoing internal audit functions, data analysis, and operation review. Independent audits and appraisals are designed to assist the leadership of WVUHS to meet the 340B Drug Pricing Program goals of regulatory compliance, program effectiveness and program excellence.

1. Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Management, or Hospital Administration

2. Nationally Certified Pharmacy Technician

3. Apexus Advanced 340B Operations Certificate

EXPERIENCE:

1. 340B Drug Pricing Program experience.

2. Experience in data analysis, audit process and reporting.

3. Hospital or retail pharmacy experience.

They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

2. Reviews and monitors utilization records and 340B purchasing accounts to ensure software or tools are working properly and accurately, performing audits or compliance assessments to validate processes.

3. Monitors monthly and annual reports on 340B Program participation which clearly documents utilization, savings, problem areas and exceptions or discrepancies.

4. Performs monthly compliance audits of contract pharmacies, hospital owned retail pharmacies, specialty pharmacies and hospital mixed use pharmacy to ensure that all 340B HRSA regulations are upheld.

5. Performs monthly compliance audits of patient eligibility, provider eligibility, and location eligibility.

6. Monitors purchasing records where 340B participation occurs, clearly documenting utilization, savings, problem areas and exceptions or discrepancies, to be shared with pharmacy leadership, Finance and Administration.

7. Maintains 340B Program software to ensure appropriate products are mapped to the appropriate charge code and in the correct ratio as well as maintain system when new charge codes are created.

8. Responsible for daily maintenance of the 340B Split Billing Software. Responsible for the testing and validation of the 340B Split Billing Software and it’s communication with pharmacy software.

9. Monitors purchases for contract compliance, 340B compliance, and accurate pricing.

10. Assists WVUHS covered entities with reporting, data requests and other inquiries as necessary.

14. Reviews product accumulation is split-billing software to ensure proper accumulations and identify negative trends.

15. Reviews ineligible claim data to ensure maximum benefit and identification of third-party administrator claim processing issues.

16. Responsible for single dose vial reporting and monthly input of single dose vial waste into split-billing software.

17. Responsible for updating any changes to charge code billing units from Epic into the split-billing software for accuracy and consistency.

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: About CookUnity:Food has lost its soul to modern convenience.
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Data Analyst, you will be an analytical partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and User Research. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions.

Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and close cross-functional partnership.

What You'll Do in 12 Months

  • Make the marketplace easier to discover and more relevant: Study how customers browse chefs, meals, cuisines, dietary options, and price points. Analyze the relationship between local assortment, variety, personalization, and ordering behavior. Help Product identify where better discovery or merchandising can improve repeat ordering and retention.
  • Improve the journey from first visit to lasting habit: Map the customer funnel from acquisition through first order, early repeat orders, and longer-term retention. Find friction in onboarding, menu exploration, checkout, and weekly ordering. Segment customers thoughtfully so teams can improve conversion and retention without hiding weak experiences behind averages.
  • Measure product bets with credible experiments: Partner with Product and Engineering to define hypotheses, primary metrics, guardrails, sample sizes, and holdouts for changes to the funnel, personalization, loyalty, and in-product interventions. Analyze heterogeneous effects and uncertainty, and recommend whether to launch, iterate, or stop. When a randomized test is impractical, use the strongest available observational approach and explain its limits.
  • Connect customer value to marketplace economics: Help teams evaluate how product changes affect order rate, churn, revenue per customer, discounts, chef engagement, and unit economics together. For new categories and ordering formats, define the measures that show whether customers find value and whether the model can scale.
  • Reduce the work and stress of ordering: Combine behavioral data with research and customer feedback to understand where subscriptions, delivery information, account management, or support journeys create friction. Measure whether self-service and product improvements solve the underlying problem, not just move contacts to another channel.
  • Build a trusted measurement foundation: Define and document product metrics, cohorts, event tracking, and dashboards. Work with Engineering and Data partners to validate instrumentation and maintain reliable behavioral data. Create compelling dashboards that let product teams explore results, spot meaningful patterns, and monitor outcomes after launch.
  • Shape a focused learning agenda: Work with Product, Design, and User Research to prioritize the most consequential unknowns, design analyses and tests, and tell a clear story about what the team learned. Share methods and review work with other analysts to raise the quality of product analytics across the team.

What Success Looks Like

  • Product teams use clear metrics and guardrails to make decisions about discovery, conversion, ordering, and retention.
  • Major launches are supported by credible tests or well-explained evidence, including their impact on different customer segments.
  • Insights lead to measurable improvements in customer experience and repeat ordering while accounting for marketplace and financial tradeoffs.
  • Stakeholders trust and regularly use self-service reporting, and core behavioral data is sufficiently complete to diagnose product performance.

Core Competences/Requirements

  • Approximately 5–7 years in product analytics or a closely related analytical role, with demonstrated ownership of complex analyses and influence on product decisions. Equivalent experience and evidence of impact are welcome.
  • Practical fluency with AI tools for accelerating analysis, coding, research synthesis, documentation, and repeatable workflows; able to verify outputs and handle company and customer data responsibly.
  • Strong SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large, complex behavioral datasets; ability to validate data and write clear, reusable analyses.
  • Practical command of product metrics, funnel and cohort analysis, segmentation, and marketplace or subscription dynamics.
  • Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including holdouts, guardrails, uncertainty, and tradeoffs; sound judgment about causal claims.
  • Ability to turn an ambiguous product problem into a focused learning plan, work independently, and communicate an actionable recommendation.
  • Clear data storytelling and constructive partnership with Product, Design, Engineering, User Research, and business teams.
  • Ability to build powerful, intuitive dashboards in any tool that answer important product questions, reveal actionable insights, and enable trustworthy self-service analysis.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-enabled product experiences through clear success metrics, experiments, user feedback, and appropriate quality and safety checks.
  • Curiosity about food, chefs, customer behavior, and the practical constraints of operating a local marketplace.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD.

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider.

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical.

🐣 Paid family leave.

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.excerpt: Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry.
jobs.description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Implementation team at Vividly plays a critical role in turning a customer's solution design into a successful, operational Vividly experience.

Our Implementation Managers are both hands-on platform configurators and end-to-end project managers. They take an approved solution design and translate it into Vividly configuration, customer workflows, data setup, training, testing, and ultimately go-live.

Implementation Managers serve as the primary point of contact throughout onboarding, coordinating across customers, Solution Architecture, Integrations, Managed Services, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to keep complex projects moving forward.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, understanding complex workflows, configuring software, managing multiple moving pieces, and creating an onboarding experience that gives customers confidence they made the right investment.

Who You Are

You are an energetic, curious, and highly accountable implementation professional who enjoys being in front of customers as much as you enjoy getting into the details of how a platform should be configured.

You're comfortable taking an approved solution design, understanding the business intent behind it, and turning it into something real. You can work through complex business workflows, translate requirements into accurate platform configuration, work confidently with customer data, and explain how the resulting experience will work for the people using it.

You're also a strong project manager. You can manage multiple implementations at once, keep customers and internal teams accountable, identify dependencies before they become blockers, and create momentum without sacrificing quality.

You don't need to design every solution from scratch, but you do need to understand the solution you're implementing. You ask questions when something doesn't make sense, recognize when customer requirements have materially changed, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and know when to bring Solution Architecture back into the conversation before changes create unnecessary complexity, scope creep, or rework.

Most importantly, you bring energy to the customer experience. You're engaged, passionate about helping customers succeed, comfortable leading a room, and genuinely enjoy seeing customers move from complicated processes to confidently operating in Vividly.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end implementation project for assigned customers, from post-Solution Alignment through configuration, training, UAT, go-live, and transition.
  • Serve as the primary project manager and day-to-day customer lead throughout onboarding, owning timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, customer actions, and overall project health.
  • Translate approved Solution Architecture designs into accurate, scalable Vividly platform configuration.
  • Configure customer workflows, master data, promotion structures, deduction-related settings, reporting requirements, user access, and other applicable platform components based on the approved solution.
  • Understand the business purpose behind the configuration, not simply the individual fields or settings being configured.
  • Prepare, transform, import, map, and validate customer datasets, including customer, product, pricing, revenue, and other applicable data.
  • Validate configured workflows against the approved solution design and expected customer experience before progressing into training, UAT, and go-live.
  • Lead customer implementation meetings with confidence, clear direction, and strong follow-through.
  • Hold customers and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed actions, decisions, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and decisions that could impact scope, timeline, or customer readiness and drive them toward resolution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional onboarding workstreams, including Integrations and Managed Services, while maintaining visibility into dependencies that impact the overall implementation.
  • Deliver initial platform and workflow training to establish customer operational readiness and prepare users to begin successfully working in Vividly.
  • Guide customers through UAT and confirm that configured workflows operate as intended before go-live.
  • Assess customer readiness across configuration, data, training, integrations, services dependencies, and outstanding customer actions.
  • Complete structured handoffs to Customer Success and Managed Services, ensuring important customer context, business outcomes, decisions, risks, and outstanding actions carry forward after implementation.
  • Troubleshoot configuration and data issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams when additional expertise is required.
  • Identify recurring implementation challenges and contribute to improving our playbooks, templates, automation, processes, and overall customer onboarding experience.

Solution Design & Change Management

Implementation Managers execute against an approved solution design while maintaining enough business and product context to recognize when that design may need to be revisited.

In this role, you will:

  • Use the approved Solution Architecture design as the source of truth for configuration and implementation execution.
  • Understand the business requirements, assumptions, decisions, and intended customer experience behind the solution you're implementing.
  • Recognize when newly discovered requirements or customer requests materially differ from the approved design.
  • Challenge assumptions when a requested change could introduce unnecessary complexity, downstream risk, or significant rework.
  • Distinguish between configuration decisions you can independently make and material solution changes that require Solution Architecture to re-engage.
  • Escalate material design changes, new requirements, scope changes, or unresolved solution questions before changing the approved design.
  • Document implementation decisions and ensure material changes are reflected in the appropriate solution and project documentation.
  • Help customers move toward scalable future-state workflows rather than automatically recreating legacy processes simply because that's how they've historically operated.

What You'll Bring

  • 3–5+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, implementation consulting, customer onboarding, or a similar customer-facing delivery role.
  • Demonstrated experience hands-on configuring a SaaS platform based on documented business requirements or solution designs.
  • Proven experience independently managing customer implementations from configuration through UAT, go-live, and handoff.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent customer projects with competing priorities, dependencies, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate approved requirements into accurate system configuration.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to recognize when a customer request represents a normal configuration decision versus a material change to an approved solution.

You will have several technologies or products that you are becoming responsible for. You will help diagnose and resolve operational issues in our systems.

You will continue to develop your Azure toolbelt with relative technology certifications and education and to inform the development of team members.

  • You hold a BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent, or a Bachelor’s in an unrelated field with at least 5 years of professional experience

  • You are familiar with the concepts of microservice architecture and how those concepts are implemented in Azure
  • You champion Infrastructure as Code mentality and can take the lead in transformation from manual “hands-on” in Azure to Infrastructure as Code
  • You have very strong scripting and automation skills – you believe you can automate just about everything
  • You know how to use AI tools to vet ideas, validate work, and help automate tasks
  • You strive to learn new technologies and look for ways to stay up to date in this rapidly changing industry
  • Hands-on experience with troubleshooting, securing, and improving manually configured Azure environments

  • Experience supporting application development teams who work in an iterative-based development environment using Agile/Scrum/Kanban

Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.  

Associate Corporate Counsel (Employment & Labor)

The Associate Corporate Counsel, Employment & Labor reports to the General Counsel and serves as a key legal partner to the company’s Human Resources team and operational leaders. This attorney handles and manages the company’s employment disputes – from agency charges and demand letters through litigation and arbitration – and provides practical, day-to-day advice on employment and labor matters across the company’s multi-state workforce. The role calls for sound judgment and decision-making, often with limited information and tight timeframes.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Report directly to the General Counsel and assist with the reporting to the CEO and Board of Directors as necessary on all material legal matters affecting the company.
  • Agency Charges: Directly manage and respond to charges and inquiries before the EEOC, the Texas Workforce Commission, and other federal, state, and local agencies, including drafting position statements, responding to information requests, and representing the company in mediation and conciliation.
  • Demand Letters & Pre-Suit Resolution: Evaluate and respond to attorney demand letters and pre-suit claims, develop resolution strategy, negotiate settlements, and draft settlement and release agreements.
  • Litigation & Arbitration Management: Manage employment lawsuits and arbitrations, including wage-and-hour class and collective actions, in partnership with outside counsel. Formulate strategy, review pleadings, discovery, and motions, monitor budgets, and make recommendations to outside counsel and the General Counsel.
  • Litigation Support: Draft and circulate legal holds; coordinate the preservation, collection, and production of documents, including electronic discovery with the company’s IT team; communicate with current and former employees who have relevant knowledge; prepare employees for depositions and attend as needed; and respond to subpoenas and non-party discovery.
  • Outside Counsel Management: Engage outside counsel as needed to assist with responsibilities. Negotiate engagement terms with outside counsel, review invoices to enforce the company’s billing guidelines, ensure matters are handled efficiently with the appropriate level of counsel experience necessary for the matter, and maintain case files and matter summaries for reporting to the General Counsel.
  • Terminations & Investigations: Advise Human Resources and property leadership on terminations, corrective action, and high-risk or escalated workplace investigations to ensure consistent, compliant, and fair outcomes.
  • Leave, Accommodations & Return-to-Work: Advise on leave programs, disability and other accommodation requests, and return-to-work issues under federal, state, and local law.
  • Policies, Handbook & Multi-State Compliance: Review and draft the employee handbook, HR policies, and employment-related agreements. Monitor developments in federal, state, and local employment and labor laws and help the company stay compliant across its multi-state footprint.
  • EPLI & Insurance Claims: Partner with the company’s insurance broker and carriers on employment practices liability claims, including claim notices, tenders, coverage questions, and coordination with carrier-appointed counsel.
  • Training & Business Partnership: Collaborate with Human Resources and management teams to develop training materials, and provide prompt, practical legal advice that supports sound operational decision-making.
  • Travel Requirement: This position may entail travel, estimated at 10% of work time annually for property visits or internal meetings.

Education & Experience

  • JD from an ABA-accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one state bar. Attorneys not licensed in Texas must be eligible to register as in-house counsel with the Texas Board of Law Examiners.
  • 3–5 years of employment and labor law experience at a law firm, in-house, or both, including handling agency charges and employment litigation.
  • Experience in property management, real estate, or another multi-site industry is preferred but not required.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound, practical recommendations quickly.
  • Direct, candid, and concise communication style, with the ability to explain legal issues in plain language to HR professionals and business leaders at all levels.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of matters, prioritize effectively, and meet multiple deadlines.
  • Highest ethical standards, a self-motivated and resourceful approach, and the ability to build credibility and trust with colleagues inside and outside the company.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); familiarity with HRIS and e-discovery platforms is a plus.

We design Spotify’s consumer experience end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints, from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Spotify's Core Experience (CoreX) team is shaping how listeners interact with Spotify through conversation, voice, and AI-powered experiences. We're building new ways for Premium subscribers to discover content, create playlists, control playback, and explore what they're listening to, using natural language.

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape the future of these experiences. You'll lead the design direction for our conversational agent while staying close to the craft, designing and prototyping experiences that make AI feel useful, intuitive, and trustworthy. Working with product, engineering, machine learning, and design partners, you'll help create experiences that bring listeners closer to the audio and creators they love.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the experience strategy for Spotify's conversational agent, partnering with product, engineering, and data teams to create a shared design direction across multiple teams.
  • Lead end-to-end product design for the core chat experience, from early exploration and prototyping through testing, refinement, and delivery.
  • Define how conversational interactions work across Spotify, including when the agent responds, asks questions, offers choices, or helps listeners take action.
  • Explore how conversation fits alongside familiar browsing and playback experiences across Home, Now Playing, and other key Spotify surfaces.
  • Design intuitive voice and text interactions that support different listening contexts, including hands-free experiences, headphones, connected devices, and in-car listening.
  • Create reusable interaction patterns and design guidance that help other teams bring conversational and AI-powered capabilities into their products.
  • Partner with research, data science, and conversation design teams to evaluate experiences, understand listener behavior, and improve the product through evidence and experimentation.
  • Build interactive prototypes to explore ideas, test assumptions, and make complex AI behaviors easier to understand and evaluate.
  • Support and mentor designers across the program, share knowledge, and help teams make thoughtful design decisions that balance user needs, technical possibilities, and business goals.

Who You Are

  • You have experience leading product design for complex digital products, shaping design strategy, and bringing multiple teams together around a shared direction.
  • You have worked on conversational, voice, or AI-powered experiences and understand how to design interactions that help people feel informed, confident, and in control.
  • You bring strong interaction and visual design skills, with the ability to create consistent experiences across mobile, voice, and connected devices.
  • You enjoy hands-on design and prototyping, using AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to explore ideas, learn quickly, and communicate how an experience should work.
  • You can turn complex or ambiguous challenges into clear design opportunities, using research, experimentation, and thoughtful judgment to guide decisions.
  • You communicate ideas clearly, welcome different perspectives, and build collaborative relationships with designers, engineers, product partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • You enjoy supporting other designers, sharing what you learn, and contributing to a team culture built on curiosity, creativity, and inclusion.

Where You'll Be

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the Europe region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the BST and CET time zone for collaboration.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role: Our Devoted Medical Transitions of Care (TOC) Advanced Practice Provider (APP) roles include both Nurse Practitioners (APRNs) and Physician Assistants (PAs) — candidates for both will be considered.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:
Our Devoted Medical Transitions of Care (TOC) Advanced Practice Provider (APP) roles include both Nurse Practitioners (APRNs) and Physician Assistants (PAs) — candidates for both will be considered. This is an opportunity for an experienced APP to help build the TOC Program. The TOC program provides virtual care during the 30-day window after a patient is discharged from a hospitalization. Our goal is to prevent readmissions by delivering exceptional, comprehensive, wrap-around care during this high-risk period. The team is highly interdisciplinary — care coordinators, nurse case managers, social workers, APPs, and physicians collaborating together.


This role demands two distinct skill sets in one provider. Roughly 70% of your time is spent on comprehensive initial post-discharge visits, and 30% on follow-up and acute/urgent symptom visits. That means you need the acute clinical judgment to recognize and manage a decompensating, medically complex patient in real time, and the longitudinal depth to build and adjust a whole-person, complex chronic-care plan over 30 days. You should be equally comfortable deciding whether a patient needs an immediate intervention today and managing the slower arc of their chronic disease across the continuum. You'll also help build the program itself — shaping team culture, fostering safe and open communication, contributing to quality-improvement work, and giving feedback on our homegrown EHR as we grow.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Perform comprehensive initial TOC visits. Conduct a thorough post-discharge assessment of the patient's medical conditions, medications, functional status, and psychosocial needs. Complete a full post-discharge medication reconciliation — including identifying duplicate, inappropriate, or contraindicated therapy and optimizing guideline-directed medical therapy. Place appropriate orders (prescriptions, labs, imaging, referrals, home health, DME), provide disease-specific education, and communicate clear contingency plans and red flags for worsening symptoms.
  • Perform acute / virtual urgent-care TOC visits. Independently assess, diagnose, and manage new or worsening symptoms in medically complex patients, determine the appropriate level of care, and escalate when needed — with a clear bias to action.
  • Manage the clinical trajectory across the 30-day window. Reinforce and adjust each patient's plan of care in response to their evolving clinical picture, their priorities, and the barriers they face — including chronic disease management, symptom management, and timely changes to the medical regimen.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary TOC rounds to discuss patients at highest risk of readmission, and collaborate closely with RN case managers, care coordinators, social work case managers, pharmacy, and patients' PCPs and specialists.
  • Enhance team culture by facilitating safe, open communication across roles and supporting clear patient escalations.
  • Assist with clinical education of the broader team, participate in quality-improvement projects and pilots, and provide feedback to improve our EHR.
  • Embrace a build environment. As our service needs evolve, this role may expand to support new clinical and organizational initiatives. We seek people who are adaptable, eager to learn, and comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic setting where change is constant.

Required skills and experience:

  • 5+ years of direct patient care managing primarily geriatric populations with multiple chronic, complex, comorbid conditions — across both acute and chronic presentations.
  • Demonstrated comfort across the continuum: acute management of chronic illness and longitudinal outpatient chronic-disease management, with a strong understanding of how the two connect.
  • Ability to work full-time, five-8 hour days/week (Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM; CST/MST/PST preferred).
  • RN and APRN licenses are active and in good standing or Physician Assistant licenses are active and in good standing. Role licensure and good standing is required in existing or future Devoted states. Able and willing to get licensed in required states within 90 days of hire.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience in internal medicine, urgent care, emergency room, hospital medicine, post-acute medicine, and/or geriatrics.
  • Experience performing visits over telehealth video platforms.
    Experience in managing post-transitions patients and being able to identify the need for immediate interventions.
  • Experience in managing acute/chronic disease exacerbations including CHF exacerbations, diabetic emergencies, COPD exacerbations and hypertensive emergencies.
  • Strong team player, with a desire to work in an interdisciplinary team to provide the best care to patients.

Salary range: $120,000-$150,000/year plus performance based bonus paid out quarterly or annually ($10K-$20K) for a total comp range of $130,000-$170,000/year.

Employer-sponsored health insurance and dental and vision plan with low or no premium

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.

About the Role

Abacus Insights is expanding what we do for health plans, and we’re looking for a Forward Deployed Data Engineer to help us do it. As we launch new and expanded service offerings, we’re putting multidisciplinary teams directly alongside our clients—pairing healthcare subject matter experts, AI and product engineers, and forward-deployed data engineers, each bringing a distinct and essential skill set—to solve their hardest data challenges and deliver value faster than ever. This is a chance to be part of that build from the start.

In this role, you will be the hands-on data engineering expert on client-facing work. You will go on-site with clients, dig into their environments and source systems, and design and build the data models, pipelines, and integrations that turn fragmented payer data into a governed, analytics-ready foundation—frequently on Snowflake, where many of our clients are building. You will often step into ambiguous situations—unfamiliar systems, incomplete documentation, competing priorities—and bring the structure, technical judgment, and healthcare fluency to move forward. You will work hand in hand with our core delivery teams, preserve Abacus data-modeling practices, and capture the patterns and lessons that help us scale these new offerings and reuse what we learn across engagements.

This role sits at the intersection of senior data engineering, client consulting, and payer data expertise.

Your day to day

  • Design and implement data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, and integrations that bring client payer data into governed, analytics-ready foundations, with a particular focus on Snowflake
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs, from ingestion and standardization through analytics-ready data products
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to client data, IT, and business stakeholders, including senior leaders, and work on-site with clients as engagements require
  • Lead discovery sessions and workshops, gather requirements, and bring structure to open-ended problems
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Work with core payer datasets—claims, eligibility, member, provider, encounter, and care management data—and advise clients on data quality, mapping, and integration approaches across commercial, government, and other lines of business
  • Navigate healthcare interoperability standards and exchange patterns, including FHIR, HL7, EDI, and APIs
  • Partner closely with the healthcare SME, AI/product engineer, and core delivery teams on every engagement
  • Preserve and apply Abacus data-modeling standards and best practices across client work
  • Capture reusable patterns, accelerators, and lessons learned, and contribute to the playbooks and practices that support our new and expanded service offerings as they grow

What you bring to the team

Technical Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, solution engineering, or a related technical role
  • Strong expertise in data modeling, ETL/ELT, integration, databases, data pipelines, and analytics solution design
  • Proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, cloud data services, APIs, and integration frameworks; hands-on Snowflake experience strongly preferred, as clients build their data foundations there

Healthcare Domain Expertise

  • Experience with healthcare payer, government, claims, eligibility, member, provider, encounter, and care management data
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards and exchange patterns, including FHIR, HL7, EDI, and APIs

Consulting and Client Engagement

  • Proven ability to work directly with external clients, senior stakeholders, and ambiguous requirements
  • Strong facilitation, requirements-gathering, communication, and structured problem-solving skills

Leadership and Personal Attributes

  • T-shaped professional with deep technical expertise, broad systems understanding, and sound business judgment
  • Self-starter with strong analytical instincts, pragmatic problem solving, and the ability to work on-site with clients as needed

What we’d like to see, but not required

  • Experience in a consulting, professional services, or other client-facing delivery environment
  • Snowflake or Databricks certifications
  • Experience with data governance, master data management, or data quality frameworks
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicaid, or Medicare data requirements

Compensation

Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.

What you’ll get in return

  • Unlimited paid time off – recharge when you need it
  • Work from anywhere – flexibility to fit your life
  • Comprehensive health coverage – multiple plan options to choose from
  • Equity for every employee – share in our success
  • Growth-focused environment – your development matters here
  • Home office setup allowance – one-time support to get you started
  • Monthly cell phone allowance – stay connected with ease

Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.

AI Use in Recruitment

We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks. We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.

jobs.description:
OEM Account Director

Location: Remote (U.S.) with ~50% travel to Detroit/Dearborn

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

The Role

We're hiring a OEM Account Director to own and grow our relationship with the largest Numa's OEM partners, including Ford, GM, and Stellantis, representing ~10,000 dealerships in the United States. This is a high-visibility, quota-carrying role that sits at the intersection of enterprise account management, partnership strategy, and program execution. You will be responsible for deepening the commercial relationship, driving dealer enrollment and adoption of Numa across the OEM's network, and turning a single program into a durable, expanding partnership. This position reports to the Head of Corporate & Business Development.

We're looking for someone who has managed complex enterprise accounts and/or has demonstrable skills to do so, and thrives on the relationship and organization skills side of the job: someone who is in it for the people, has real hustle, and uses AI as a force multiplier so more of their time goes toward face time with OEM partners instead of busywork. Automotive OEM experience is an absolute requirement.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the day to day relationship for Numa's OEM partner programs, running a proactive engagement cadence that monitors program health
  • Build genuine, trusted relationships across key levels of the OEM organization to protect and grow partnership
  • Facilitate executive-level alignment between Numa and OEM partners, ensuring shared priorities, strong relationships, and clear paths to partnership growth
  • Prepare and lead program reviews, translating dealership and product data into polished presentations that advance Numa's position with OEM stakeholders.
  • Assist in the preparation and coordination of responses to OEM RFPs, RFIs, and vendor evaluations
  • Spot opportunities and apply value selling principles to expand Numa's footprint within each OEM account, and negotiate outcomes that are mutually beneficial for the OEM and for Numa.
  • Partner with Numa's sales and customer success teams to convert OEM-level endorsement into dealership-level revenue and retention.
  • Track program health, open risks, and action items with a level of organization that keeps nothing from slipping through the cracks.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales or account management experience, including direct experience managing automotive OEMs (GM, Ford, Stellantis) or Tier 1 suppliers. This experience is required for consideration
  • Experience navigating large, matrixed organizations and building relationships from line level managers up to executive sponsors
  • An AI native way of working: you already use AI tools to move faster and get more done, and you can bring that mindset to a fast moving OEM account using AI to accelerate account prep, reporting and follow through
  • A genuine love of working with people; you're energized by frequent in person and virtual interaction, not drained by it
  • Unparalleled hustle: you're comfortable in a fast moving, high accountability environment and you don't wait to be told what's next
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to and negotiating with senior executives
  • Strong project management skills, with experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives (program rollouts, renewals, RFP responses) against firm deadlines
  • Proven forecasting and account-planning discipline, with hands-on CRM experience (HubSpot or similar)
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Willingness to travel to the Detroit area roughly 50% of the time for in person meetings, business reviews, and relationship building

Why Join Numa

  • We are just getting started - help us scale our OEM team!
  • We believe in everyone’s growth
  • Be part of an industry leader named the #1 fastest-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000

Compensation & Benefits

  • Target OTE: $200,000 - $260,000
  • Equity Package
  • Flexible PTO
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) plan

At Numa, you’ll have the chance to represent game-changing technology in an industry that’s ready for innovation. If you love being in the field, thrive on solving problems in real time, and want to make an impact at a high-growth company, we’d love to hear from you.

About Shippo

At Shippo, our vision is bold and clear: we are the shipping layer of the internet. Our mission is to make every merchant successful through excellent shipping, delivering world-class logistics technology and infrastructure. We’re building the backbone of global e-commerce — connecting merchants to carriers worldwide through a single API and intuitive dashboard.

As a remote-first and globally distributed team, we believe flexibility fuels trust, autonomy, and performance. Our diverse perspectives — across continents, cultures, and time zones — drive our innovation and enable us to build solutions used by businesses everywhere. We invest in modern, scalable technology so our teams can build, ship, and iterate with confidence.

Your impact starts here: every person at Shippo plays a direct role in shaping the infrastructure that powers global commerce and makes shipping simpler for businesses around the world.

How we will deliver success together:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our WebApp team. Our business is rapidly expanding and we’re developing the new intelligent web application capabilities with the best-in-class user experience for our customers. At the same time, the customer base grew significantly in both diversity and complexity. As a Sr Software Engineer, you will be working together with a group of highly talented engineers and partnering with product managers and designers to deliver features to meet our customers’ demands. Stay connected to customer impact and contribute to decisions that balance technical quality with user experience.

Shipping & handling responsibilities

  • System Design & Development: Build and maintain the full stack web application features including scalable, distributed microservices.
  • Technical Leadership: Own complex features from technical design to production deployment adhering to high-performance and reliability standards.
  • Engineering Excellence: Owning technical strategy to enhance and support core web application stack, ensuring performance and accuracy for high-throughput traffic.
  • Operational Health: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production incidents, and maintain high SLAs.
  • Collaboration & Mentorship: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Infrastructure, Designer, API Partners) and setting high engineering standards.
  • Infrastructure: Improve CI/CD pipelines, container-based software distribution (Docker, Kubernetes), and observability.

Your shipping requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in software development
  • Experience building and maintaining highly available, scalable web applications
  • Proficiency in programming language and frameworks commonly used in full-stack development on distributed systems. (e.g.,React, Python, Go, Kafka, SQL, NoSQL)
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, object-oriented programming, and design patterns.
  • Experience with AI assisted development workflow.
  • Can effectively communicate to stakeholders across different organizations within the company
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • BSc in a STEM field, with a preference for computer science and software engineering

Bonus

  • Experience with the shipping and logistics industry.
  • Experience with shipping AI powered customer facing features

Sail through the process:

Here at Shippo, we celebrate inclusivity and are committed to creating equal access to opportunities for people from all backgrounds, perspectives and geographies. These values define who we are and everything we do. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need assistance, or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please contact us at

Shippos in the wild:

Our people, much like the packages we help ship, are all over the world. This means, through our remote-first program, “Shippos Everywhere”, our roles can be based anywhere in the US with the exception of Delaware, Nevada, Ohio, Oregon, Hawaii, New Mexico and West Virginia and many roles can be based internationally.

For locations outside of the US and Ireland, the employment contracts are powered by Rippling.com.

jobs.title: Principal Executive Search Recruiter (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Principal Executive Search Recruiter | Global Executive Search & Talent Intelligence - Contract Opportunity


Micron is redefining how the world uses information to enrich life for all. As a global leader in memory and storage solutions, our technology is fundamental to the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, data centers, automotive systems, mobile devices, and the intelligent edge.

Behind every breakthrough is exceptional leadership.


As Micron continues to grow and strengthen its position in the semiconductor industry, we are expanding our internal Executive Search capability to identify, engage, and attract exceptional senior leaders and distinguished technical talent who will help shape our future.


We are seeking an accomplished Principal Executive Search Recruiter to join our Global Executive Search team in a contract This role is intended to provide a pathway to a regular full-time position for a successful incumbent, subject to demonstrated performance, continued business need, required approvals, and applicable employment processes.


This is an opportunity for a sophisticated, highly accomplished hands-on executive search professional who combines the research rigor, market intelligence, advisory capability, and candidate engagement skills of a top-tier retained search consultant with the ownership, agility, and organizational understanding of an experienced in-house executive recruiter.

You will personally lead complex senior-level searches while helping Micron build proactive leadership pipelines and a world-class internal executive search capability.


We are looking for someone equally comfortable developing a global market thesis, conducting original research, mapping organizations and talent ecosystems, approaching a difficult-to-access passive executive, advising senior leaders, assessing candidates, and personally driving a confidential search from initial strategy through successful close.


What You Will Do:


Lead Complex Executive Searches from Strategy Through Close

  • Personally lead end-to-end searches for senior leadership and distinguished technical talent across Director, Senior Director, Vice President, Corporate Vice President, Senior Vice President, Fellow, Senior Fellow, and other strategically important positions.
  • Partner closely with executive hiring leaders, People leaders, and HR partners to understand business strategy, organizational context, leadership challenges, and future capability requirements.
  • Translate those needs into sophisticated search strategies, success profiles, target-market hypotheses, candidate archetypes, and engagement plans.
  • Identify relevant industries, organizations, functions, geographies, leadership profiles, and adjacent talent markets.
  • Personally lead executive candidates throughout the search process, from initial identification and engagement through assessment, interviews, offer negotiation, closing, and transition.
  • Operate effectively across multiple complex and confidential assignments while maintaining exceptional quality, responsiveness, discretion, and candidate care.

Bring Exceptional Research, Sourcing & Talent Intelligence Capabilities

  • Conduct advanced executive research across the global semiconductor and technology ecosystem, including memory, storage, silicon, AI infrastructure, engineering, manufacturing, advanced packaging, equipment, materials, cloud, systems, and adjacent industries.
  • Build sophisticated company, organizational, and talent maps to identify both established executives and emerging leadership talent.
  • Look beyond titles and obvious competitors to understand a leader's actual scope, accomplishments, technical or functional depth, organizational influence, and trajectory.
  • Develop evidence-based market intelligence that helps hiring leaders understand talent availability, competitive dynamics, relevant talent adjacencies, and potential search challenges.
  • Create and maintain proactive pipelines for critical leadership and technical talent ahead of immediate hiring demand.
  • Capture market intelligence and organizational knowledge so that every completed search strengthens Micron's future ability to identify and attract exceptional talent.

Find and Engage the Talent Others Cannot

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies to identify executives and technical leaders who may not be readily identifiable through traditional recruiting methods.
  • Leverage professional networks, executive referrals, advanced Boolean search, original research, talent platforms, competitive intelligence, public information, and other approved resources.
  • Construct thoughtful search strategies across direct competitors, adjacent industries, alumni populations, emerging companies, customer and supplier ecosystems, and nontraditional talent pools.
  • Approach highly passive senior talent with personalized, credible outreach that demonstrates genuine understanding of their career and accomplishments.
  • Build relationships with executives who may not be ready to make a move today but could become important future candidates.
  • Maintain long-term relationships with exceptional talent, referrals, prospects, and future succession candidates.

Become a Trusted Talent Advisor to Senior Leaders:

  • Bring an informed perspective to executive hiring discussions rather than simply delivering a predetermined target list.
  • Advise senior leaders on talent markets, competitive dynamics, candidate availability, profile tradeoffs, and search feasibility.
  • Use research and market evidence to challenge assumptions constructively and recommend alternative strategies when appropriate.
  • Lead thoughtful calibration discussions that distinguish essential leadership capabilities from preferences.
  • Provide clear, concise, executive-ready search updates, market landscapes, candidate insights, and recommendations.
  • Communicate with credibility and confidence at senior levels while maintaining a highly responsive and service-oriented approach.
  • Exercise exceptional judgment and discretion when managing confidential searches, potential succession situations, organizational changes, compensation information, and sensitive candidate matters.

Assess Executive Talent with Depth and Rigor

  • Conduct substantive executive conversations that explore leadership accomplishments, business impact, transformation experience, organizational scale, functional or technical depth, enterprise influence, leadership approach, and career motivation.
  • Evaluate candidates based on demonstrated experience, relevant achievement, and alignment with the business outcomes required of the role.
  • Develop insightful candidate briefs that articulate relevant experience, differentiated strengths, potential concerns, open questions, and motivation.
  • Distinguish verified evidence, candidate-provided information, recruiter observations, and areas requiring further validation.
  • Partner with hiring leaders to support structured, consistent, job-relevant candidate assessment and decision-making.

Deliver an Exceptional Executive Candidate Experience

  • Create a highly personalized, discreet, responsive, and professional experience throughout the search process.
  • Serve as a trusted relationship owner and advisor for candidates.
  • Help candidates understand not only the opportunity, but Micron's strategy, technology, leadership environment, culture, and potential for impact.
  • Prepare candidates and hiring leaders for substantive, high-value conversations.
  • Maintain thoughtful communication and follow-through throughout what can be a lengthy executive decision process.
  • Navigate complex considerations involving compensation, equity, relocation, timing, career risk, and other factors that can influence an executive career decision.
  • Partner effectively with Executive Compensation, HR, Global Mobility, Legal, executive support teams, and other stakeholders to create a coordinated candidate experience.

Innovate Through AI & Technology

  • We are looking for an executive recruiter who is excited about how technology can make exceptional recruiters even better.
  • Leverage approved AI and talent intelligence capabilities to accelerate research, company mapping, talent discovery, profile synthesis, outreach development, market analysis, and search reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to use automation and AI to reduce administrative work and increase time spent on strategic research, candidate relationships, assessment, and advisory work.
  • Experiment thoughtfully with new research and sourcing methodologies while maintaining appropriate human judgment and accountability.
  • Maintain disciplined data quality, candidate documentation, and market intelligence.
  • Help build reusable research practices, search methodologies, talent maps, and knowledge that strengthen the entire Executive Search function.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant progressive experience in executive search, executive recruiting, talent intelligence, or senior-level talent acquisition.
  • A demonstrated track record of personally leading successful in-house executive searches at the Senior Director, Vice President, C-suite, Fellow/Senior Fellow, or comparable level.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in executive research, direct sourcing, market mapping, passive-candidate engagement, assessment, and closing.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting within semiconductors, hardware, advanced manufacturing, AI, cloud infrastructure, engineering, or another technically sophisticated global industry.
  • Ability to understand complex business and technical requirements and translate them into differentiated search strategies.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior executives and influencing hiring strategy through market intelligence and sound judgment.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive-level storytelling, candidate presentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Strong executive presence combined with curiosity, humility, urgency, and a highly responsive approach.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior passive candidates.
  • Experience managing highly sensitive and confidential executive searches with discretion.
  • Ability to succeed in a fast-moving, highly matrixed, global environment.
  • Advanced proficiency with executive sourcing platforms, professional networks, talent databases, research tools, ATS/CRM systems, and contemporary recruiting technology.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience combining in-house corporate executive search with retained executive search, executive search boutique, or another research-intensive search environment.
  • Direct executive search experience within semiconductors, memory, storage, silicon, engineering, manufacturing, advanced packaging, AI infrastructure, or adjacent technology sectors.
  • Experience recruiting both senior business executives and distinguished technical leaders.
  • Advanced expertise in talent mapping, organizational research, competitive intelligence, succession pipelines, and executive talent landscapes.
  • Experience supporting global and cross-border executive searches.
  • Experience navigating sophisticated executive compensation, equity, relocation, and offer considerations.
  • Demonstrated use of generative AI and talent intelligence technologies to improve the speed, reach, and quality of executive search.

Who Will Thrive in This Role ?

You are intellectually curious and want to understand the business behind the search, not simply the requirements listed in a job description.


You are an exceptional researcher, but research is only the beginning. You know how to turn intelligence into a search strategy, a name into a conversation, a conversation into a trusted relationship, and that relationship into a successful hire.


You know how to enter a market you may not already know, rapidly understand its ecosystem, identify the people who matter, and engage them credibly.

You can sit across the table from a senior executive as a trusted talent advisor and then personally go back into the market and do the difficult work required to find the right person.


You combine strategy with execution, sophistication with tenacity, analytics with intuition, and technology with the human connection that remains essential to executive recruiting.


Most importantly, you understand that executive search is not simply about filling a senior position. It is about identifying and attracting leaders capable of changing the trajectory of an organization.


Why Micron?

You will have the opportunity to recruit leaders whose decisions influence some of the world's most consequential technologies while partnering with senior leaders across a global semiconductor company.


You will also help build something enduring: a sophisticated internal Executive Search capability that gives Micron deeper access to global leadership talent, builds proprietary market intelligence, creates a differentiated candidate experience, and allows the company to identify and engage exceptional leaders earlier.


For an accomplished executive recruiter, this is a rare opportunity to combine executive search, market intelligence, advanced sourcing, technology, relationship building, and direct search execution while helping one of the world's leading semiconductor companies continue to scale.

As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits.

Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

To learn about your right to work click here.

To learn more about Micron, please visitmicron.com/careers

For US Sites Only: To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact Micron’s People Organization at or 1-800-336-8918 (select option #3)

Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.

Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences.
