jobs.excerpt: What is Contentstack? Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed.
jobs.description:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at .

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Sr. Customer Success Manager to join our growing Customer Success team. This is a senior-level individual contributor role responsible for managing a portfolio of our highest-value enterprise customers, representing a minimum of $5M in ARR across approximately 20–25 accounts. You’ll serve as the primary strategic partner throughout the customer lifecycle, helping customers realize, sustain, and grow their investment in Contentstack.

This is not a traditional relationship management role. You’ll navigate complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, build executive relationships, drive adoption, protect retention, and identify opportunities for expansion. You’ll develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business outcomes, digital transformation goals, workflows, and investment in Contentstack.

Contentstack is an AI-forward company, and we bring practical experience using AI tools and technologies to improve how we work, learn, solve problems, and drive impact. If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact with some of the world’s leading brands, we’d love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing:

  • Own account strategies across a $5M+ ARR portfolio of approximately 20–25 enterprise accounts, serving as the strategic partner throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Develop multi-year success plans aligned to customers’ digital transformation goals, adoption milestones, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, including VP Marketing/CMO, Head of Digital, and VP Engineering/CTO.
  • Identify and proactively address churn, contraction, competitive displacement, and executive disengagement risks, developing recovery strategies when needed.
  • Own and forecast retention targets using usage, adoption, health, and engagement indicators.
  • Lead Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) and customer workshops that demonstrate ROI and connect Contentstack to measurable business outcomes.
  • Own a defined expansion quota and identify, negotiate, and close upsell and volume-growth opportunities within your portfolio.
  • Advise customers on best practices for scaling their Contentstack implementation, evolving workflows, and expanding strategic adoption without owning the technical build.
  • Mentor and coach CSMs on strategic account management, executive engagement, commercial strategy, and risk management.
  • Bring customer insights to the organization and contribute to the evolution of the CS playbook, platform, processes, and customer experience.
  • Leverage AI and CS tooling to manage your portfolio efficiently, identify risks and opportunities, and improve customer outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, and other teams to drive customer outcomes and commercial growth.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You?

  • 8-12 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Enterprise SaaS sales, renewals, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; Customer Success, sales, or negotiation certifications are a plus.
  • Proven track record of owning and achieving a commercial number, including NRR, gross retention, renewals, and/or expansion.
  • Experience managing a complex enterprise book of business post-implementation.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience with renewals, expansion opportunities, negotiations, and forecasting.
  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and build trusted executive relationships.
  • Strong ability to translate customer data and insights into retention strategies, business reviews, and expansion opportunities.
  • Working knowledge of composable/MACH architecture, APIs, and integrations, with the ability to advise customers on scaling existing implementations.
  • Experience with CRM and Customer Success tools such as Salesforce, Gong, and WorkRamp.
  • Fluency with AI tools and technologies, including Claude, and demonstrated ability to use AI for portfolio management, analysis, productivity, and problem-solving.
  • Highly organized and data-driven, with a bias for action and strong attention to detail.
  • Collaborative, curious, and able to mentor and influence others without direct authority.
  • You are located in the Central Time Zone; Austin, TX, is a big plus.
  • You like occasional travel.
  • You value a collaborative, fun culture!

Salary for this role ranges between $115,000 - $135,000 based on skill set and experience

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work |We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it.

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Be Part Of A Dynamic Team

Join a global power technology organization focused on improving the reliability, performance, and uptime of connected equipment. This role supports a growing digital solutions organization responsible for expanding connected fleet capabilities and improving the operational experience for customers using remote monitoring and telematics technologies. The environment is highly cross-functional, bringing together Digital Solutions, Engineering, Product, Service, IT, Customer Success, and regional teams to solve connectivity challenges and improve how connected assets are monitored at scale.

What's In Store For You

  • Engagement: W2 only (no C2C/1099)
  • Remote opportunity supporting a global connected-fleet operation.
  • Long-term contract opportunity currently expected to continue through December 2027, with potential for extension.
  • Exposure to digital products, telematics, connected equipment, fleet analytics, and customer-success operations.
  • Opportunity to help establish scalable processes as the connected customer and engine population continues to expand.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Monitor fleet connectivity across customer accounts and identify telematics devices that are no longer communicating as expected.
  • Investigate connectivity failures and perform structured root-cause analysis across hardware, firmware, networks, device configuration, power, SIM connectivity, installation, and customer infrastructure.
  • Validate communication between telematics hardware, cloud environments, and customer networks.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Service, IT, Customer Success, and regional teams to investigate issues and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Analyze connectivity trends, recurring failures, and fleet health to identify systemic improvement opportunities.
  • Prioritize incidents based on customer impact, operational importance, and business priorities.
  • Track corrective actions through resolution and provide clear reporting on fleet communication health.
  • Develop executive-level summaries highlighting significant connectivity risks, recurring issues, and operational trends.
  • Support customer onboarding and operational readiness for new connected-fleet deployments.
  • Improve troubleshooting documentation, standardized processes, installation practices, and operational workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to automate connectivity monitoring, analysis, and reporting.
  • Support evolving Customer Success initiatives and cross-functional digital projects as the connected customer base grows.

Requirements

Do You Bring Proven Success In Connectivity Analysis And Technical Troubleshooting?

  • Experience supporting telematics, IoT, connected devices, fleet connectivity, networking, digital products, or similar technical environments is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and determine root causes across multiple potential failure points.
  • Experience analyzing operational data, device status, system reports, or connectivity trends to identify abnormalities and recurring problems.
  • Working understanding of how connected devices communicate through networks and cloud-based environments.
  • Ability to differentiate among hardware, software/firmware, network, configuration, installation, power, SIM, and customer-environment issues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues methodically rather than simply escalate them.
  • Comfortable coordinating resolution efforts across technical and nontechnical teams.
  • Strong reporting and communication skills, including the ability to summarize technical findings for business stakeholders and leadership.
  • Organized and proactive approach to tracking issues through resolution.
  • Experience supporting customer onboarding, Customer Success operations, process improvement, or technical operations is advantageous.
  • Exposure to automation, monitoring tools, reporting platforms, or connected-equipment analytics is a plus.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote / Watsonville, CA

Salary - 103K - 120K

Position Summary:

Based on compiled literature research and scientific writing from the research department, the Regulatory Claims Substantiation Specialist (RCSS) will review and propose revisions to claim substantiations. The RCSS will work both independently and collaboratively with members of the Regulatory, Research, Product Development (PD), Marketing, and Education teams, as needed. In this capacity, the RCSS will review and propose revisions to the scientific evidence and rationale required to support the nutrition and health-related claims associated with the ingredients of dietary supplement products. This work involves reviewing research output, preparing, revising, and maintaining technical documents.

Location Statement:

This is a remote position for those who live outside of 40 miles from Nordic Naturals headquarters in Watsonville, CA. Our culture is very important to us and for team members who live inside of the 40-mile radius, we expect them to be onsite occasionally to help support our collaborative community.

Reasonable Accommodations Statement:

To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential Functions:

  • Review of in-depth scientific evidence of the biological effects of ingredients used in Nordic Naturals products.
  • Partner with research & regulatory functions to ensure compliance to appropriate regulatory
  • Propose revisions to claims substantiations documents to better support a specific health claim within DSHEA and FDA/FTC guidelines.
  • Identify and propose revisions to high-risk claims and/or language within internal claims documents.
  • Develop expertise in the terminology, biochemistry, molecular biology, physiology, pharmacology and clinical outcomes associated with individual dietary ingredients and associated structure function claims.
  • Review, summarize and/or substantiate the mechanistic and clinical evidence supporting product claims
  • Ability to understand and articulate relevant information including molecular mechanisms, biochemical functions, pharmacokinetics, physiological effects, pharmacological and clinical evidence from a range of study types (e.g., observational, interventional, meta-analysis).
  • Communicates and collaborates with team members to plan, develop, and produce high-quality communication products in a dynamic environment.
  • Manages projects in a timely fashion and adheres to project schedules and deadlines.
  • Works simultaneously on multiple projects, independently setting work priorities to meet changing deadlines and scope-of-work definitions.
  • Performs substantive edits, correcting grammar, technical usage, content, and organizational problems
  • Adjusts processes to accommodate changes and resolve issues.
  • Collaborate with the PD Team to assess regulatory risk of formulas and improve existing formulas as necessary.
  • Support the regulatory department with review of marketing, product, and education content.

Key Contributions in First Year:

  • Achieve an understanding of current Nordic Naturals regulatory risk tolerance and cross functional alignment (marketing, legal, research, etc.) on substantiation standards.
  • Complete product claims substantiation review for the Nordic Naturals product portfolio.
  • Develop understanding of current product and regulatory data and contribute to the improvement of overall knowledge management practices for regulatory content.

Position Qualifications:

  • There are 2 essential requirements:
    • D., Master of Science, or a Bachelor of Science degree in biology, biochemistry, pharmacology, physiology, or other life sciences AND
    • At least three years of regulatory experience related to claims substantiation for finished products in the dietary supplement industry.
  • Must possess knowledge pertaining to the nutraceutical industry and must be well versed in a variety of ingredients, their usage, forms, activities and all other relevant characteristics.
  • Knowledge and applied experience of food or supplement regulations (including DSHEA, FD&C Act Section 21 CFR 101 and 111) is required.
  • Experience with reading and understanding all sections of scientific and/or clinical research studies.
  • Must be receptive to constructive criticism and accept disagreement in a professional manner.
  • Familiarity with statistics, clinical trials design, experimental design / hypothesis testing, and interpretation of laboratory and clinical research data.
  • Must be able to read and interpret documents such as standard operating procedures, and regulations.
  • Must be honest and demonstrate integrity. Scientific integrity and care for the well-being and trust of our customers is paramount.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, meet deadlines, be detail-oriented, perform and prioritize multiple simultaneous tasks. Organizational, and interpersonal skills are key.
  • Excellent fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Skilled in scientific writing, comprehension, and presentation of technical information to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Must be able to work cross functionally with many different departments and various skill levels.

Competency Statements

  • Positive - Ability to view all situations with a positive attitude.
  • Accountable – takes ownership for responsibilities, acknowledges and learns from mistakes
  • Innovative - Ability to look beyond the standard solutions and "think outside the box".
  • Independent – Must be self-motivated and able to manage obligations without direct supervision
  • Assertiveness - Ability to act in a self-confident manner to facilitate completion of a work assignment or to defend a position or idea.
  • Communication - Ability to communicate effectively with others using spoken and written word clearly and concisely.
  • Customer Oriented - Ability to take care of the customers’ needs while following company procedures.
  • Enthusiastic - Ability to bring energy to the performance of a task.
  • Self-Motivated - Ability to be internally inspired to perform a task to the best of one’s ability using his or her own drive or initiative.

  • Microsoft Office suite including Excel, Word, and PPT, adobe Acrobat

jobs.description:
Acquisition Analyst

Ionic Digital

Position Summary

Ionic Digital is seeking an Acquisition Analyst to support the identification, screening, tracking, and prioritization of site and asset acquisition opportunities. This role will be responsible for building and maintaining a high-quality database of acquisition targets, supporting initial financial screening, and helping prepare investment screening memorandums and presentations for internal decision-making.

This position is designed primarily as a data-driven, process-oriented acquisition support role with a growth path into deeper investment analysis and underwriting responsibilities over time. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, enjoys working with data and building structure around large pipelines of opportunities, and is interested in developing broader transaction and financial analysis skills.

This role may be a strong fit for candidates with experience in acquisition support, commercial real estate analysis, transaction coordination, pipeline management, or junior underwriting, including candidates coming from commercial real estate firms, brokerage, lending, banking, or related finance environments who are looking to apply those skills in the data center sector. This person will play a key role in helping Ionic Digital assess market opportunities, evaluate investment opportunities, and maintain visibility into acquisition activity across the pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and prioritize a database of acquisition targets, including relevant market, site, operating, and financial information.
  • Track acquisition opportunities across the pipeline, including status, key diligence items, priority level, next steps, and decision history.
  • Conduct initial financial screening of site and asset opportunities using established criteria, assumptions, and return thresholds.
  • Support the collection, organization, validation, and ongoing maintenance of data used in evaluating acquisition opportunities.
  • Assemble investment screening memorandums, summary materials, and presentations to support internal review and decision-making.
  • Assist with acquisition analysis and financial modeling by gathering inputs, updating assumptions, maintaining support files, and helping organize outputs for review.
  • Maintain comparable transaction and market reference information to support screening, benchmarking, and acquisition prioritization.
  • Partner with internal teams to gather market intelligence, site-level details, operating assumptions, and diligence inputs related to acquisition opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data collection, data entry, database structure, and workflow efficiency across the acquisition process.
  • Support leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with reporting and ad hoc analysis related to acquisition activity and pipeline visibility.

Role Scope

This role is not expected to independently lead complex acquisition underwriting
or build full investment models from scratch on day one. Instead, the role will focus on building the information foundation and screening discipline needed to evaluate opportunities efficiently, while developing the skills to take on more advanced financial analysis over time.

For the right candidate, this role offers a path to grow into:

  • deeper underwriting responsibilities
  • more advanced financial modeling
  • investment memo development
  • broader acquisition and capital allocation support

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and motivated by building process and structure around large sets of acquisition opportunities. They should be comfortable managing data, maintaining clean and actionable pipeline information, and helping the team quickly identify which opportunities merit further review.

At the same time, this role may also be a strong fit for a candidate with more finance-oriented training — for example, someone from a commercial real estate firm, commercial real estate lending team, banking analyst program, or junior
underwriting role — who wants to transition into evaluating and supporting
investments in data centers and digital infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Real Estate, Business, or a related field.
  • 1–4+ years of experience in acquisition support, real estate analysis, commercial banking, lending, FP&A, corporate development, transaction support, or a related analytical role.
  • Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail.
  • Experience working with datasets, trackers, databases, or pipeline reporting tools.
  • Foundational financial analysis skills, including the ability to support opportunity screening and interpret basic investment metrics.
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise, decision-oriented materials.
  • Demonstrated interest in data quality, process improvement, and workflow optimization.
  • Interest in developing more advanced acquisition, underwriting, and financial modeling capabilities over time.

Preferred Backgrounds

Candidates may come from a variety of relevant backgrounds, including:

  • commercial real estate acquisitions or asset analysis
  • real estate or infrastructure brokerage support
  • commercial real estate lending or credit analysis
  • banking analyst roles with exposure to real estate or asset-backed transactions
  • junior underwriting or transaction support roles
  • corporate development, strategic finance, or acquisition pipeline management roles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience maintaining acquisition trackers, CRM-style databases, or market intelligence tools.
  • Exposure to real estate, infrastructure, industrial, energy, or site-based
    investment opportunities.
  • Familiarity with comparable transaction analysis, market benchmarking, or early-stage underwriting.
  • Interest in data centers, digital infrastructure, power markets, or adjacent sectors.
  • Experience preparing investment committee, screening, or transaction summary materials.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a well-organized and decision-useful acquisition pipeline, improving visibility into active and evaluated opportunities, and helping the team screen and prioritize targets more effectively. Over time, the successful candidate should grow from a strong pipeline and screening analyst into a more investment-oriented resource with increasing responsibility in underwriting and acquisition analysis.

About the Role

Wolf Games is looking for a Senior Marketing Strategist to build our marketing function from the ground up. This is a foundational role responsible for creating the strategy, systems, and public presence that turn Wolf Games from a company with great products into a brand that players recognize and partners trust.

Working closely with the founders, you'll define how Wolf Games shows up to the world. You'll establish our brand positioning, build an owned player community, develop our marketing content and storytelling strategy, and create repeatable launch playbooks that support every game we release. You'll partner closely with Creative, Product, and Business Development to ensure our marketing efforts strengthen both player engagement and commercial partnerships.

Success in this role isn't measured by impressions or follower counts. It's measured by building an audience that returns to Wolf Games across titles, creating a brand that makes partnership conversations easier to win, and developing marketing systems that become more effective with every launch.

This is a true 0 → 1 opportunity. You'll begin as an individual contributor with significant ownership, helping establish the company's marketing foundation before growing a small team as the audience and business scale. If you're energized by building from scratch, moving quickly, and creating lasting competitive advantages through brand and community, you'll have an outsized impact on Wolf Games' future.

What You'll Do

  • Build Wolf Games' Marketing Function. Own the creation of Wolf Games' marketing strategy and operating model from the ground up. You'll establish the company's brand positioning, go-to-market approach, and marketing systems, creating the foundation for how Wolf communicates with players, partners, and the broader industry. You'll define priorities, build repeatable processes, and lay the groundwork for a marketing organization that scales alongside the business.
  • Grow an Owned Player Audience. Build and nurture Wolf Games' direct relationship with players. You'll develop our community strategy, launch and grow player spaces like Discord, and establish repeatable approaches for attracting, engaging, and retaining early players across multiple game launches. Your goal is to create an audience that follows Wolf Games—not just individual titles—and becomes an ongoing source of feedback, advocacy, and momentum.

Organisation Nonviolent Peaceforce (NP): Unarmed Civilian Protection (UCP) Academy

Reporting line: UCP Academy Manager

Duty station: Remote (home-based); no travel foreseen

Contract period: 1 November 2026 – 31 December 2026

Level of effort: 20 working days within the contract period

Maximum budget: CHF 8,000 (all-inclusive, equivalent to CHF 400 per working day)

1. Background

Nonviolent Peaceforce (NP) is an international civilian protection organisation that works alongside local communities to prevent violence and build sustainable peace through unarmed civilian protection (UCP). Building and accompanying local protection networks is one of the core methodologies of NP field operations worldwide.

NP’s UCP Academy is the organisation’s learning platform, designed to make UCP practice accessible to practitioners, communities, civil society organisations, policymakers and academics. NP is expanding the Academy’s course catalogue and seeks a consultant to design a training curriculum on building local protection networks, grounded in NP field practice and current UCP scholarship. The curriculum will subsequently be digitalised and hosted as an online course on the UCP Academy website. The consultant is responsible for producing a ‘digitalisation-ready’ curriculum, not for the technical build.

2. Objective

To develop a complete, practice-based and pedagogically sound training curriculum on building local protection networks, ready for digitalisation and delivery through the UCP Academy platform.

3. Scope of work

Under the direct supervision of the UCP Academy Manager, the consultant will:

  • Conduct a short inception review of existing NP internal guidance, training materials, field tools and relevant external literature on local protection networks and community-based protection.
  • Consult NP field teams (through remote interviews and/or focus group discussions across a representative sample of country programmes) to capture field-tested practice, tools, case examples and lessons learned and to validate the draft curriculum content.
  • Engage with academic partners, in particular the Creating Safer Space initiative at Aberystwyth University, to ensure the curriculum reflects current UCP research, terminology and evidence and to identify opportunities for reciprocal use of research outputs.
  • Design the curriculum architecture: learning pathway, modules and sessions, learning objectives, estimated learning time, sequencing and prerequisites.
  • Develop module content: session outlines, facilitator/narration scripts or content notes, case studies drawn from NP field experience, exercises and reflection prompts, and a suggested reading and resource list.
  • Design assessment and learner engagement elements: knowledge checks, end-of-module quizzes, a final assessment, and criteria for course completion or certification.
  • Present the draft curriculum in a validation session with the UCP Academy Manager and other relevant stakeholders, and integrate consolidated feedback into the final version.

4. Deliverables

  • Inception note: methodology, consultation plan, annotated curriculum outline.
  • Consultation report: key findings from NP field teams and academic partners.
  • Draft curriculum package with modules, content, exercises and assessments.
  • Validation session and consolidated feedback matrix.
  • Final curriculum package plus digitalisation guidance note and resource list.

All deliverables shall be submitted in English, in editable formats (Word and, where relevant, PowerPoint or Excel). All materials produced remain the intellectual property of Nonviolent Peaceforce.

5. Required qualifications and experience

  • Advanced university degree in peace and conflict studies, international relations, international humanitarian law, education or a related field.
  • Demonstrated, substantive knowledge of unarmed civilian protection, including protection networks, early warning and early response, and community-based protection, is a requirement. Prior work with NP or comparable UCP actors is a strong asset.
  • At least five years’ experience designing adult learning curricula, preferably for online or blended delivery.
  • Proven ability to translate field practice into accessible learning content, and experience working with both operational teams and academic partners.
  • Ability to work independently, remotely and across multiple time zones.

6. Reporting and working arrangements

The consultancy is fully remote. The consultant reports directly to the UCP Academy Manager, with a check-in at inception, weekly progress calls and written approval of each deliverable. The consultant uses their own equipment and software. NP facilitates introductions to field teams and academic partners and provides existing resources available. Case material drawn from field operations is handled under NP confidentiality and do-no-harm requirements: sensitive examples must be anonymised or cleared before use.

7. Budget and payment

The maximum available budget is CHF 8,000, inclusive of all fees, taxes and incidental costs, for a maximum of 20 working days. Payment is made in 2 instalmendts: 25% upon signing of contract and 75% upon completion (with written approval) of assignment. The consultant is responsible for any tax requirements in their country.

8. Application

  • We strongly encourage applicants to carefully review the job description before submitting their application and ensure they meet the essential requirements.
  • Candidates meeting the above requirements are requested to submit the following, through our website, detailing their experience and how they qualify for the role. Incomplete applications will not be considered:
    • CV.
    • Short technical proposal (maximum three pages) outlining approach and indicative module structure.
    • Relevant work sample and an all-inclusive daily rate.
  • The closing date for applications is Thursday, 8 October, 2026.
  • This is on a rolling basis. Candidates may be selected before the closing date apply early.
  • As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a technical assignment before participating in an interview.

SPECIAL NOTICE

Nonviolent Peaceforce is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability.

Nonviolent Peaceforce acknowledges the duty of care to safeguard and promote the welfare of employees, contractors, volunteers, interns, communities we work with, and other stakeholders and is committed to ensuring safeguarding practice reflects statutory responsibilities and government guidance and complies with best practices in the Humanitarian and Development sector.NP expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We prioritise ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us.

The post holder will undertake the appropriate level of training and is responsible for ensuring that they understand and work within the safeguarding policies of the organisation.

All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records and terrorism finance checks. NP also participates in the InterAgency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

NO FEE

We never ask for payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates via our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached for payment, this is likely to be fraudulent. Please check whether the role you are interested in is posted here on our website.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Chief of Staff who can operate as an extension of the CEO — someone equally comfortable in the weeds of litigation analysis, financial modeling, and investor decks as they are driving cross-functional execution.

You’ll serve as a strategic and operational right hand to the CEO of a fast-scaling AI startup that’s redefining how insurers and defense counsel respond to plaintiff AI tools in civil litigation. This role combines the analytical rigor of a litigator, the structure of an operator, and the communication finesse of a strategist.

What You’ll Do

1. Strategic & Executive Support

  • Own preparation of executive briefs, board decks, investor updates, and external communications — transforming raw input from the CEO into polished, high-impact materials.

  • Create and maintain financial models, forecasts, and scenario plans in collaboration with the CEO and finance advisors.

  • Develop and deliver presentation decks (PowerPoint, Google Slides) for investor meetings, client demos, and internal strategic reviews.

  • Translate complex legal/technical topics into clear, compelling narratives for multiple audiences (insurers, defense firms, investors).

2. Litigation Subject-Matter Contribution / Legal Ops Exposure

  • Leverage your litigation background to contribute meaningfully to product content — e.g., AI-generated Offer Packages, negotiation frameworks, and defensibility arguments.

  • Gain firsthand experience reviewing, editing, and validating LLM-generated case analyses to build a deep understanding of our workflows, quality standards, product dynamics and how Legal Ops functions.

  • Engage directly with clients (insurance carriers, defense counsel) early on to understand their expectations, feedback loops, and pain points.

3. Operational Execution

  • Drive cross-functional alignment between Product, Data, and Client Success — ensuring the CEO’s priorities translate into execution.

  • Track key milestones across fundraising, client pilots, and product sprints; maintain accountability and momentum.

  • Manage and refine company-wide processes (OKRs, leadership cadence, communication rhythms).

4. All-Purpose Leadership Extension

  • Step into the CEO’s shoes when needed — running meetings, making tactical decisions, or representing the company externally.

  • Handle special projects spanning finance, operations, legal, and partnerships.

  • Identify and fill execution gaps across the business — from investor research to client onboarding materials.

5. Organizational Infrastructure & Administrative Leadership

  • Build and oversee the foundational operations of the company — including recruiting, onboarding, insurance, and vendor administration.

  • Systematize and streamline the processes founders typically manage early on, creating structure that scales.

  • Coordinate with external partners (legal, accounting, insurance, HR) to ensure the company remains compliant and operationally sound.

Act as a leverage point for the CEO, taking ownership of essential administrative and people operations so leadership can stay focused on growth and product.

Qualifications

  • JD or equivalent litigation experience strongly preferred.

  • 5–10 years total professional experience (law + startup/ops/consulting).

  • Exceptional analytical, writing, and presentation skills.

  • Experience working directly with C-suite executives or founders.

  • Proficiency in creating presentations, spreadsheets and briefs.

  • Prior experience in AI, data-driven, or high-growth LegalTech startups a major plus.

Why This Role Matters

This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role — it’s a founder-adjacent position for someone who wants to help lead and scale an AI company tackling one of the most consequential shifts in litigation and insurance in decades. You’ll be the CEO’s closest strategic ally, shaping how technology reshapes legal negotiation and claims resolution.

jobs.excerpt: About The CompanyAt NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.
jobs.description:
About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

  • Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
  • You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
  • Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords
  • Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators
  • Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus
  • Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper
  • Experimental: You actively try new channels and formats, like AI search, new social formats, distribution plays
  • You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling
  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Here's what we care about:

🔑 High Ownership
We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 No Bullshit, No Ego
We're too small for politics, posturing or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ Flexibility
Exceptional work doesn't require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We're remote-first and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 Sometimes We Leave the House
We do make time for real-life moments, like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions, to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Hire for Spikes
We don't expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We're building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

🛠 Default to Rethink
We don't accept "that's just how it is." We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there's a better way. First Principles isn't a buzzword for us.

💅🏼 Give Yourself a Little Treat
We offer benefits via hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy: Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

🤓 Your Learning Curve is Our Investment
Everyone at NaroIQ gets €1,000 per year for courses, books, coaching, or whatever helps them grow.

Client Location: United States

The individual will interface with a wide variety of people from different internal organizational units, interface with organizational personnel and staff to ensure that the policy is understood by those required to implement, monitor, and enforce the policy. This role is designed for a professional with an engineering, computer science, software development, or related technical background who is interested in the business, governance, and assurance aspects of data security. Under the guidance of the Data Protection Office, the role will drive control auditing, assurance activities, governance, development, security logging, automation, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence to improve efficiency, consistency, and maturity of data protection processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with IT and Business group leaders to understand goals, programs, and plans. Evaluate and articulate program security requirements; identify potential security risk factors and business impact.
  • Conduct assessments of controls to ensure data protection controls are in place.
  • Leverage AI to analyze volumes of data across File Labeling, Application logs, and infrastructure datasets to automate control assurance.
  • Engage AbbVie Third Party Vendors to assess security posture, remediation requirements, and compensating controls as they apply to Business Applications.
  • Develop in-depth knowledge of AbbVie Information Security policies, processes, and procedures, as well as compliance processes and initiatives to provide subject matter expertise and guidance to other organizations (Commercial, R&D, Audit, Legal, Purchasing, etc.) within AbbVie in these matters.
  • Provide Information Security expertise and guidance to Business group leaders and IT Owners to ensure an appropriate balance between security risks and business enablement for identified business programs and initiatives.
  • Provide reporting to management on potential Data Privacy risks and planned remediation.
  • Act as point of contact regarding Information Security matters and AbbVie security policies for AbbVie Purchasing, Legal/Privacy and Quality.
  • Review current technology and information policies and practices for continued applicability with respect to AbbVie commercial and R&D business programs. Provide recommendations for improvements.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 5 years of experience; OR Master's Degree with 4 years of experience in Information Security, Data Privacy, or IT Compliance experience.
  • Familiarity with, and experience using, a variety of information security control frameworks, including, but not limited to: NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 2700X, PCI-DSS, SWIFT, Cloud Controls Matrix, HITRUST, NIST 800-171, CIS Controls, etc.
  • Familiarity with global and regional Data Privacy regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, and CCPA.
  • Experience aligning and testing information security controls and frameworks.
  • Experience writing policies and procedures.
  • Experience working in information security or data privacy in a large, global organization.
  • Strong project management, collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Adept at communicating concepts to diverse audiences with varying skill sets.

Department: Engineering

About Cardiff

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

Why This Role Matters

Cardiff's underwriting decisions are only as good as the data behind them. This role owns that layer: the integrations that pull credit and bank transaction data from providers like Experian and Plaid, and the Python services that deliver it to the systems driving risk decisions. We're pushing funding turnaround from 24 business hours toward minutes, and that only works if the data underneath is fast, reliable, and compliant. As we expand ML-based decisioning and LLM-based workflows, this layer sets the pace for everything built on top of it.

The Role

This is a Python backend engineering role focused on financial data integration. You'll build and maintain the FastAPI services that deliver financial and credit data to Cardiff's internal systems, along with the provider integrations and AWS pipelines that feed them. You'll work as an individual contributor on Cardiff's technology team, alongside the Lead AI Architect and engineers covering full-stack, UI, and operations, with access to our AI platform from day one and real ownership over how you get the work done. The role starts as an ongoing contract with a clear path to full-time; we begin with a contract so both sides can evaluate fit through real work, and your scope will grow as you show you can carry more.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Ship at least one production integration with a financial or credit data provider (Experian, Plaid, or a bank transaction source) end to end
  • Implement automated validation and quality checks across the pipelines you own, so failures surface before they reach downstream consumers
  • Ship or materially extend a FastAPI service that exposes provider data internally, with tests and documentation another engineer can pick up cold
  • Deliver a documented data model and schema mapping for at least one provider domain, built alongside our domain experts and analysts
  • Demonstrate one LLM-assisted extraction workflow on unstructured input (bank statements, credit memos), with output validation in place

By the end of your first year:

  • The financial data layer is Cardiff's system of record: accurate, current, and complete enough that underwriting, risk, and operations decide on it with confidence
  • Adding or replacing a data provider is a well-worn path rather than a project; the business can move on partnerships without waiting on engineering
  • Compliance is a property of how the systems are built, not a scramble ahead of each review

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and run the FastAPI services that expose financial and credit data to internal consumers: API design, auth, versioning, pagination, and clear error handling
  • Own the integration layer with external providers (Experian, Plaid, bank transaction sources): retries, backoff, rate limiting, credential handling, and graceful degradation when a provider slows down or goes dark
  • Build the pipelines that land provider data in Cardiff's systems, including Snowflake, using serverless ETL on AWS (Glue, Athena, Step Functions, S3 data lakes), supporting both batch and near-real-time ingestion
  • Do the data modeling and schema mapping that keeps disparate provider formats semantically consistent, working with our domain experts and analysts
  • Build integrations that meet Cardiff's security, privacy, and regulatory obligations, with Legal, Compliance, and Security owning final interpretation and sign-off
  • Apply LLM APIs for extraction and classification of unstructured documents where it earns its keep, with model outputs validated before they enter the pipeline
  • Make AI tooling part of how you build, and read what it produces before it ships
  • Maintain the unit tests, integration tests, and documentation for every component you own

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of Python backend engineering on data-intensive systems, with the emphasis on recent, demonstrable work
  • Production backend services built and operated in a modern Python framework (FastAPI preferred; Flask or Django fine), including API design, auth, testing, and async programming
  • Reliable third-party API integration (retries, idempotency, rate limits, partial failures, observability), ideally against financial APIs from credit bureaus, banks, or payment processors
  • Substantial hands-on Snowflake experience in production: loading, modeling, and large-scale querying
  • AWS data services for pipeline orchestration (Glue, Athena, S3, Step Functions, Lambda), including data lake layouts and partitioning that keep querying cost-efficient
  • Strong data modeling, schema alignment, and transformation instincts
  • A working grasp of API authentication, encryption, and the compliance requirements that come with regulated financial data
  • Proficiency in SQL and Pandas

Nice to have:

  • Credit decisioning, loan underwriting, or financial risk data experience
  • LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) applied to extraction, classification, or summarization, plus the applied-LLM toolkit: prompt design, evals, output validation, RAG and embeddings
  • AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Devin) as a primary mode of building
  • CI/CD pipelines

Who Does Well Here

You ship: a working v1 today beats a polished v1 next month. You sweat data correctness, because bad data that looks fine is the most expensive failure in a lending business. You treat AI tooling as a force multiplier, and you know when to trust the output and when to override it. You work independently and communicate proactively; when something is blocked, you say so the same day.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If You

  • Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes
  • Want detailed direction before you start
  • Would rather maintain systems than build them

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible PTO and observed holidays
  • Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup

How to Apply

After submitting your resume, email with:

  • A 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and walking us through your work
  • A link to your GitHub
  • A production project you've shipped, with a link we can see or try

Position Summary

The Business Integration Testing Senior Advisor provides strategic leadership and subject-matter expertise for user acceptance testing, business integration testing, test automation, renewal communications quality, and operational readiness within Individual Dental Operations. This role establishes comprehensive testing strategies, defines scope and objectives, and ensures business, vendor, and technology solutions meet established requirements and acceptance criteria.

The Senior Advisor leads complex testing initiatives across multiple platforms and external partners, identifies opportunities to expand automation, and guides the development and execution of automated testing solutions. The position serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders, Product Owners, technology teams, and vendor partners by evaluating testing risks, managing critical defects and dependencies, and providing recommendations that support informed readiness decisions.

The role also leads annual renewal communications testing and quality validation, including defect management and onsite print-vendor audits. Through extensive testing expertise, institutional knowledge, and cross-functional leadership, the Senior Advisor helps ensure Individual Dental solutions and communications are accurate, compliant, operationally ready, and positioned to deliver a positive customer experience.

Core Accountabilities and Responsibilities

Business Integration Testing Strategy and Leadership

  • Establish comprehensive user acceptance testing and business integration testing strategies, including testing scope, objectives, methodologies, timelines, resource requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Translate business requirements into end-to-end testing scenarios and test cases that validate critical business workflows, customer experiences, and operational outcomes.
  • Lead complex UAT, integration, regression, release, and operational readiness testing across internal systems, vendor solutions, and external partner platforms.
  • Provide strategic direction and guidance to testing resources, ensuring test cases are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with established requirements.
  • Lead test-effort estimation, workload prioritization, contingency planning, and impact analysis for major business initiatives.
  • Plan and coordinate test-data requirements and setup activities to ensure readiness before test execution begins.
  • Evaluate testing outcomes and provide recommendations to business leaders, Product Owners, technology teams, and vendor partners regarding solution quality and operational readiness.
  • Establish and promote consistent testing standards, practices, documentation, and controls across assigned initiatives.

Test Automation Strategy, Development, and Execution

  • Define the automation strategy for business integration testing, including identifying, evaluating, and prioritizing opportunities to automate rate, benefit, and other repeatable testing activities.
  • Assess automation opportunities based on business risk, testing volume, complexity, repeatability, anticipated benefits, and implementation effort.
  • Estimate the level of effort required to design, build, maintain, and execute automated testing solutions.
  • Lead the design and development of automated UAT scripts and tools that align with business requirements and established testing objectives.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of automation solutions, coordinating activities across business, technology, vendor, and testing resources.
  • Execute or oversee automated rate and benefit testing across multiple external partner platforms.
  • Validate automated testing results, investigate exceptions, and ensure identified issues are documented, prioritized, and resolved.
  • Maintain and enhance automation tools and scripts to support changing products, benefits, rates, business requirements, and technology platforms.
  • Use automation to increase testing capacity, consistency, accuracy, efficiency, and repeatability while reducing manual effort and operational risk.
  • Evaluate additional opportunities to apply automation, analytics, and emerging capabilities to improve testing effectiveness and operational readiness.

Renewal Communications Testing and Quality

  • Lead annual testing and quality-validation activities for Individual Dental renewal communications.
  • Develop the testing strategy, scenarios, quality criteria, and validation approach for renewal letters and related customer communications.
  • Coordinate testing activities across business, technology, operations, and print-vendor partners to confirm renewal communications meet established requirements.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and manage renewal communication defects through resolution.
  • Partner with print vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure defects are corrected accurately and within required timelines.
  • Conduct onsite audits at print-vendor locations to validate the accuracy and quality of renewal communications before mailing.
  • Communicate quality findings, risks, defects, and readiness recommendations to business leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend sustainable improvements to renewal communication processes, controls, and quality practices.

Defect, Risk, and Issue Management

  • Establish and oversee defect-management practices for assigned testing initiatives, including defect documentation, severity assessment, prioritization, ownership, resolution, retesting, and closure.
  • Analyze complex defects and testing results to identify root causes, dependencies, systemic issues, and potential business or customer impacts.
  • Partner with business, technology, and vendor teams to develop corrective actions and confirm that implemented solutions address identified requirements.
  • Identify testing risks and readiness concerns early and develop mitigation or contingency plans to protect implementation timelines and business outcomes.
  • Escalate material risks, unresolved defects, and readiness concerns with clear analysis, business impact, and recommended actions.
  • Monitor testing progress, defect trends, and resolution status and provide clear, executive-ready reporting to stakeholders and leadership.

Go-to-Market and Operational Readiness

  • Provide testing leadership for annual Go-to-Market and Open Enrollment readiness activities.
  • Partner with business, technology, operations, marketing, compliance, and vendor stakeholders to validate readiness across critical Individual Dental workflows.
  • Assess testing completion, unresolved defects, operational dependencies, and implementation risks to support readiness decisions.
  • Provide objective recommendations regarding whether solutions, processes, and customer communications are prepared for implementation.
  • Support successful implementation by ensuring testing outcomes, open risks, contingency plans, and ownership expectations are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Apply institutional knowledge and testing expertise to anticipate issues, identify cross-functional dependencies, and reduce operational disruption.

Strategic Partnership and Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as a senior subject-matter expert and trusted advisor for business integration testing, UAT, test automation, renewal communications quality, and operational readiness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business leaders, Product Owners, technology teams, vendors, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Provide guidance on complex business requirements, solution designs, testing approaches, quality risks, and implementation decisions.
  • Analyze testing processes and performance results to identify opportunities for increased productivity, reduced costs, stronger quality, and improved business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain testing strategies, standard operating procedures, process documentation, testing artifacts, and supporting communications.
  • Coach and guide testing resources on testing methodology, automation practices, defect management, documentation quality, and stakeholder communication.
  • Promote scalable and sustainable testing practices that strengthen operational effectiveness, solution quality, and the customer experience.

Qualifications/Knowledge


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Eight or more years of experience in healthcare operations, business integration testing, user acceptance testing, quality assurance, technology delivery, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Significant experience developing and leading UAT strategies for complex, cross-functional business initiatives.
  • Experience with Individual and Family Plans, Individual Dental, annual Go-to-Market, Open Enrollment, or renewal-related activities strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying testing automation opportunities and leading the design, development, implementation, and execution of automated testing solutions.
  • Experience with automated testing tools, scripting, data validation, and testing across multiple systems or external partner platforms preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of UAT, integration, regression, release, end-to-end, and automated testing practices.
  • Demonstrated experience leading testing resources and coordinating activities across business, technology, vendor, and offshore or distributed teams.
  • Experience developing test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, effort estimates, and contingency plans.
  • Strong knowledge of defect management, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, impact analysis, and corrective-action validation.
  • Experience testing and validating customer communications or other high-volume, customer-facing materials preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex initiatives, establish priorities, and deliver results against critical business timelines.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, sound judgment, and the ability to translate complex testing findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate risks, findings, and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with testing and work-management tools such as Jira, Rally, Application Lifecycle Management, Quality Center, or comparable platforms preferred.
  • Knowledge of automation technologies and programming or scripting languages such as Selenium, Java, Python, XML, SQL, or comparable technologies preferred.

About ShareGate

ShareGate is the leading Microsoft 365 migration and governance platform, trusted by over 100,000 IT pros for its unmatched simplicity.

It offers the simplest, most reliable, and most affordable way to move business data to Microsoft 365.

Whether migrating from Google Workspace, file shares, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, or tenant-to-tenant, ShareGate gets the job done, without surprises. From cloud transformation to M&A integration, it keeps things just damn simple.

ShareGate also helps organizations stay in control once their data is migrated. Its powerful governance features let users assess environments, uncover issues, and apply fixes on the spot, so everything stays clean, secure, and optimized. It lays the groundwork for safe Microsoft Copilot deployment within organizations.

ShareGate is developed by Workleap Technologies, a Montréal‑based software company.

Your role

Almost every company now runs on Microsoft 365, and almost nobody has it fully under control. Work has to be moved into it and around it, through mergers, acquisitions and reorganizations that touch millions of files and can't afford to lose a single one. And once it's there it sprawls faster than anyone can track, with people sharing things they shouldn't and no clear view of what's actually going on. ShareGate is what IT professionals use to do both jobs. Taking something this complex and this consequential and making it feel simple and trustworthy is what we're here to do.

Your impact:

  • Own a whole product area end-to-end, from framing the problem with your team to shipping the solution customers actually use, and monitoring for learnings after.
  • Design AI-first flows where the product does the real work for customers while they stay fully in control.
  • Turn genuinely complicated situations into something a busy person can understand at a glance and feel confident acting on.
  • Put bold bets in front of real customers early, measure what happens, and let the result change the plan, including when it proves you wrong.
  • Bring AI into your own way of working so you can go from a question to something real and testable in days, and put it in front of customers while it's still rough.
  • Raise the bar for everyone around you through critique, through the standards you hold, and by making your thinking clear enough that the team can carry a decision without you in the room.

Your team

You'll join our design team at ShareGate and partner with a product lead and an engineering lead on every project you own, from first idea to launch. We're hiring across two sides of the product right now: one focused on moving companies into and around Microsoft 365, one focused on keeping it secure and organized once they're there. Both are big, high-stakes problems, and we'll work out together which one fits you best.

We're builders. We care a lot about craft and taste, we expect people to own their work rather than wait to be handed it, and we'd rather take a big swing on what's genuinely best for customers than ship the safe version. AI is part of how we work every day; it helps us move faster and try more ideas, not think less. Work gets shared early and often, feedback is direct, and decisions get made quickly and revisited just as quickly when we learn something new.

The people we design for run IT at their companies. They're experts who get the call when something breaks. Our job is to earn their trust and make complex, high-stakes workflows feel simple.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years designing complex software for businesses, with shipped work you owned from the first question to the last detail;
  • A systems mind: you design the whole journey and think about what happens next, not one screen at a time;
  • The judgment to make design decisions that are hard to take back: what people see first, what they confirm, what they can reverse;
  • A weekly habit of talking to real customers, and the discipline to let what they actually do change your direction;
  • Design rationale you can defend out loud to designers, engineers, and executives alike: the problem, the options you turned down, the trade-off you made;
  • Real fluency using AI in your own workflow, with the judgment to know where it helps and where it gets in the way;
  • The drive to take your work the last mile yourself: refining and polishing in the real product and pushing those changes straight to production;
  • Comfort working without a clear brief: you name the assumption, pick a direction, and learn in the open;
  • Bonus: experience designing for IT, security, data or any audience where the user is an expert and a wrong move is expensive.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $125 000 - $160 000.This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale.Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

We build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

Job Description:

Own the opportunity as a Cloud Engineer Principal and help ensure the mission is never interrupted. At GDIT, we deliver clarity with our cloud solutions and provide meaningful work. Your work will be an important part of transforming our clients for the modern age and helping them face any obstacle.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Cloud Engineer Principal you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a Cloud Engineer Principal joining our dynamic team to work in a fast-paced environment with engineering, migration, and operations. We’re looking for a self-starter, to work both as part of the team and on individual assignments, in an environment of customer mission delivery, integrity, and communications.

We’re looking to fill this role with someone who currently has the cloud experience, certifications, and skills to execute in large environments, is flexible and enjoys tackling challenges, and desires to join a large team that is building and sustaining a large multi-tenant cloud platform/enterprise and migrating/expanding/automating the enterprise. If this sounds like you and you love to learn and grow with a team while delivering program milestones, then we’d love to hear from you!

HOW A CLOUD ENGINEER PRINCIPAL WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Designs, architects, deploys and maintains cloud solutions
  • Maintains the integrity and security of systems
  • Maintains all documentation
  • Supports and develops automation
  • Develop in languages such as Bash, PowerShell, Python
  • Maintains/enhances knowledge of related (AWS / Azure / GCP / OCI) cloud services
  • Monitors and tunes the cloud systems to achieve optimum performance levels
  • Work across teams and external customer groups to develop strategy, design solutions, and advise implementation teams during infrastructure buildouts
  • Deal with escalations. Make assessments, recommendations or provide solutions to resolve issues
  • Write and maintain standard operating procedures and work instructions, knowledge articles, etc.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

Education: Technical Training, Certification(s) or Degree, 5-8+ years of experience with cloud engineering and operations

Experience: Experience with Cloud Computing - AWS / Azure / GCP / OCI

Technical Skills: Linux, Windows Server

Skills and Abilities: Excellent communication skills with demonstrated experience delivering presentations to diverse audiences at various levels of an organization

Security Clearance Level: Must be able to pass a background check to obtain a position of Public Trust

Location: Remote

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career in software development at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your dedication to advancing innovation.

#GDITLA

To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available.
