Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

About Picus

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. Picus holds a 95% recommendation rate, 4.9 on G2, and 4.8 on Gartner Peer Insights, and is the #1 Leader on Frost Radar for Automated Security Validation.

About The Role

If you’re a results-driven person with an entrepreneurial mindset who takes the initiative and thrives in a dynamic environment, then this is a great opportunity to play a pivotal role in a fast-growing cybersecurity company. We are looking for a smart and driven leader to have a direct impact on the future of our business by helping to influence global adoption of our award-winning Picus Security Validation Platform.

Picus Security is looking for a seasoned, hardworking, and overachieving Customer Success Architect (CSA) with proven experience and a passion for executing value-driven security solutions. You will be responsible for onboarding new customers, expanding our platform capabilities, and retaining our Enterprise customer base. The CSA will create customer value and contribute to the overall sales team and business success. This position requires that the candidate be an industry subject matter expert with business acumen.

The role will align with the Regional Sales VP, Technical Director, Product Management, as well as supporting roles in Channel, Marketing, and Customer Success. The CSA will work within our Customer Value Office and collaborate within the Sales organization to define solutions for Enterprise Customers while aligning with Partners to accelerate revenue and strategic growth initiatives. The position requires a seasoned Customer Success profile with a proven track record of revenue growth and team collaboration.

What You'll Do

  • Refine and scale core customer success processes such as onboarding, adoption planning, platform expansion, health monitoring, and quarterly business reviews,
  • Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to drive product adoption, demonstrate value realization, and identify expansion opportunities,
  • Lead customer advocacy initiatives including case studies, reference calls, and participation in customer advisory boards,
  • Represent Picus customer success stories and best practices at events, panels, and webinars,
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Support teams to ensure seamless customer experience and resolution of escalations,
  • Provide customer-driven feedback on product enhancements and feature requests,
  • Willing to travel within the US for on-site customer meetings, training sessions, and key industry events.

What You Have

  • BS degree or combination of education and pre-sales/customer success experience in Security, Cloud, and Network Systems,
  • At least five years of experience working within a Sales Engineering or Customer Success role,
  • Demonstrated success building executive relationships and driving strategic account planning,
  • Broad technology experience including risk visibility and prioritization, cloud architecture, networking, security, and IT transformation,
  • Understand the architecture/design of solutions built on-prem and cloud,
  • Experience managing complex customer lifecycles from onboarding through renewal and expansion,
  • Demonstrated ability to be consultative, proactive, and outcome-focused.

Working at Picus

Fascinating work - a chance to shape and lead an exciting, fast-growing cyber security segment. Security Validation is a concept that helps organizations evaluate their security posture in a continuous, automated, and repeatable way. This approach allows for the identification of imminent threats, provides recommended actions, and produces valuable metrics about cyber-risk levels.
Unlimited opportunity! We are growing. At Picus, you'll be provided with as much responsibility as you can handle - new career development opportunities constantly arise given our rate of growth.
Global exposure - Get a lot of experience working not only in a fast-growing startup but also interact with customers all around the world.
Be part of a global remote team who is taking on Exposure Validation and a growing market segment.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant — Lab Results & Patient Coordination

Position Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with 1-hour unpaid lunch break
Work Days: Monday to Friday
Salary: $5 - $6 hourly depending on experience
Workplace: Remote
Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines or Latin America

About the Client & Role

Our client is a well-established primary care medical practice with three locations on Long Island, New York. The practice has 10 providers, approximately 40 staff members, and serves a high patient volume across its locations.

They are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant — Lab Results & Patient Coordination to support lab and imaging results follow-up, EHR documentation, patient communication, scheduling, and clinical administrative coordination.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong Medical Assistant background, clinical understanding, excellent communication skills, and confidence speaking directly with patients. The VA will communicate provider-reviewed lab or imaging results and instructions to patients, coordinate follow-up appointments, assist with testing or referral instructions, and document all patient interactions in the EHR.

This is not a clinical interpretation role. Providers will review results and document clinical direction in the patient chart. The VA must be able to understand the provider’s documented instructions, communicate them accurately to patients, and recognize when a patient needs an appointment or direct provider follow-up.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Lab & Imaging Results Follow-Up

  • Review provider-documented instructions related to lab and imaging results.
  • Contact patients to communicate provider-reviewed results and instructions clearly and professionally.
  • Help patients understand next administrative steps based on the provider’s documented direction.
  • Recognize when the patient should be scheduled for an appointment or directed back to the provider.
  • Avoid independently diagnosing, interpreting results, recommending treatment, or giving medical advice.

Patient Communication & Scheduling

  • Speak directly with patients regarding provider instructions, follow-up needs, testing, referrals, and appointment coordination.
  • Communicate clearly and patiently, especially with elderly patients.
  • Schedule follow-up appointments when requested by the provider.
  • Assist with coordinating additional testing, referrals, repeat labs, imaging, or other follow-up needs based on provider direction.
  • Maintain professional, calm, and accurate communication by phone.

EHR Documentation & Clinical Administrative Support

  • Document patient interactions accurately in AdvancedMD.
  • Update patient charts with communication notes, scheduling updates, follow-up actions, and related administrative details.
  • Ensure documentation is clear, complete, and aligned with the provider’s instructions.
  • Maintain confidentiality and follow healthcare documentation standards.
  • Support clinical administrative workflows as assigned.

Escalation & Provider Coordination

  • Identify when patient questions or concerns require provider review.
  • Escalate clinical questions, unclear instructions, patient concerns, or situations outside administrative scope.
  • Coordinate with providers and internal team members to ensure patient follow-up is completed properly.
  • Support a smooth workflow between provider review, patient communication, scheduling, and documentation.

Tools You’ll Use

  • AdvancedMD
  • Ooma phone system
  • Email and phone communication tools
  • EHR documentation workflows
  • Internal practice communication systems

Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • Medical Assistant Experience Required | Primary Care Experience A Plus: Medical Assistant Experience is Required. Candidates must have strong Medical Assistant experience or similar clinical administrative experience in a medical practice setting. Primary Care experience is only a plus.
  • Lab or Imaging Results Follow-Up Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable communicating provider-reviewed lab or imaging results and instructions to patients, without independently interpreting clinical results or providing medical advice.
  • Patient Communication Experience: Required. Candidates must be confident speaking directly with patients by phone and able to communicate clearly, patiently, and professionally.
  • EHR Documentation Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable documenting patient interactions, follow-up actions, and provider instructions accurately in an EHR.
  • AdvancedMD Experience: Preferred but not required. Experience with AdvancedMD is highly valuable, but candidates with strong EHR/EMR experience may also be considered.
  • Scheduling & Patient Coordination Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable scheduling follow-up appointments, coordinating testing or referral instructions, and tracking patient follow-up needs.
  • Spanish-English Bilingual Communication: Preferred but not required. Spanish-English bilingual ability is a plus, but not required.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.title: Information Security Compliance Intern
jobs.excerpt: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.
jobs.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

The Audit Experience function manages Sprinto’s relationship with its audit partner ecosystem. This role offers a structured pathway to building genuine subject matter expertise in GRC and audit — not just theoretical familiarity, but the kind of depth that comes from working directly alongside an SME on real programs. The intern will engage hands-on with compliance frameworks like SOC 2 and ISO 27001, audit partner lifecycle management, and the product-led GRC environment that Sprinto operates in.

This role is designed for someone who wants to develop into a domain expert in GRC and audit — you’ll build deep working knowledge of how audit programs function, how compliance controls are evaluated, and how information and cybersecurity requirements translate into real audit expectations. Day-to-day program support provides the applied context that accelerates this learning, grounding abstract frameworks in live, operational decisions.

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Audit Partner Enablement Operations - Track and drive audit partners through the onboarding and enablement lifecycle. Maintain internal trackers, coordinate across teams to unblock dependencies, and flag partners stalling at any stage.
  • Auditor Directory Maintenance - Keep the auditor directory accurate and current — verify accreditation status against relevant accreditation bodies, update partner profiles, and ensure listing information remains factually accurate.
  • Evidence Mapping Support - Assist the SME in mapping audit evidence requirements to platform capabilities. This includes preparing reference data, identifying gaps, and documenting findings that feed into product improvement workflows.
  • Audit Partner Vetting - Run the verification process for new audit partner candidates.
  • Query Management - Serve as the first responder for routine auditor and internal team queries. Escalate non-routine matters to the SME.
  • AI-Assisted Workflow Building - Build and iterate on AI agents to handle routine Audit Experience tasks — including audit partner queries, periodic auditor directory reviews, and evidence mapping lookups. Working with GenAI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, you’ll design prompts, test agentic workflows, and help establish repeatable automation patterns that reduce manual effort over time.
  • Ad Hoc Audit Experience Support - Assist the SME with other Audit Experience initiatives as they arise — including research, documentation, process improvement, and cross-functional coordination.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • Completed a graduation or master’s degree in GRC, Information Security, Risk Management, Computer Science, or a related field — candidates with an academic background directly in GRC or audit are strongly preferred

  • Prior exposure to audits — whether through academic projects, internships, or professional experience — is a strong plus; candidates who have worked in or adjacent to audit functions are particularly encouraged to apply

  • Genuine interest in exploring information and cybersecurity — you’re curious about how audit and compliance frameworks connect to real-world security posture, not just ticking boxes

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and data — a lot of the learning here happens through doing, not just observing

  • Strong attention to detail — verification and mapping reviews are precision work

  • Good written communication — you’ll be documenting processes and responding to audit partner queries

  • Comfortable using GenAI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any equivalent platform; prior experience building agents or automating workflows with AI is a strong plus, but a genuine appetite to learn and experiment is what matters most

  • Self-directed — the SME will provide guidance and review, but you’re expected to own the operational cadence independently

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

jobs.title: Senior PLM Systems Engineer, Cost Engineering
jobs.excerpt: Role SummarySenior Systems Engineer will play a pivotal role in the Rivian Cost Engineering organization.
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Senior Systems Engineer will play a pivotal role in the Rivian Cost Engineering organization. The role will be responsible for building end to end automation to accurately analyze the costs associated with components across Rivian vehicles. Your expertise in CAD Design, System Design, Data Analysis and Cost Estimation will be crucial in ensuring the Cost Engineering team keeps pace with fast moving Engineering and Procurement organizations.

Resumen del puesto:

Como ingeniero/a de sistemas sénior, desempeñará un papel fundamental en la organización Cost Engineering de Rivian. Este rol tendrá la responsabilidad de desarrollar una automatización integral que permita analizar con precisión los costos asociados a los componentes de todos los vehículos Rivian. Su experiencia en el diseño CAD y de sistemas, el análisis de datos y la estimación de costos será fundamental para garantizar que el equipo de Cost Engineering pueda seguir el ritmo de las organizaciones Engineering y Procurement, en constante evolución.

Responsibilities

Cost Engineering

  • Integrate PLM (3D Experience/CATIA) with Cost Estimating tools using APIs and file system automation to ensure CAD data flows seamlessly to reduce non-value add work of moving data from one place to another.
  • Analyze accuracy and structure of CAD and BOM data and fix any issues before building Cost Estimates.
  • Utilize information ranging from written assumptions, sample parts, CAD models and engineering drawings.
  • Create initial Cost Estimate of multiple vehicle commodities especially mechanical components – Stampings, Injection Molding, High Pressure Die Casting, Extrusion, Forging, Machining, etc.
  • Gather details and compile data to estimate all production costs considering raw materials, labor, and tooling for estimations or should cost models.
  • Work with the PLM team to identify and address repeated issues that are resulting in inefficiencies to optimize the process.
  • Work with Cost Engineering Lead of Cost Estimating Software and 3rd party Software vendors to address any issues on the Cost Estimating Software side that are resulting in delays or errors.
  • Continuously analyze data using Databricks to highlight trends to Cost Engineers and Managers for future cost model development and target costs.

Project Management

  • Assume ownership of projects; plan milestones and identify potential risks to ensure timely delivery of cost models within agreed completion dates.
  • Proactively manage task completion and regularly update cross-functional teams on project status, timing, resource allocation, challenges, and the likelihood of on-time, high-quality delivery.

Responsabilidades:

Cost Engineering

  • Integrar PLM (3D Experience/CATIA) con herramientas de estimación de costos usando las API y la automatización del sistema de archivos para garantizar que los datos CAD se transmitan de forma fluida y así reducir el trabajo de trasladar los datos de un lugar a otro, que no aporta valor agregado.
  • Analizar la precisión y estructura de los datos de CAD y BOM y corregir cualquier problema antes de elaborar las estimaciones de costos.
  • Aprovechar información diversa: hipótesis escritas, piezas de muestra, modelos de CAD y planos de ingeniería.
  • Elaborar una estimación de costos inicial de diversos insumos de automoción, especialmente componentes mecánicos: estampación, moldeo por inyección, fundición a presión, extrusión, forja, mecanizado, etc.
  • Recopilar detalles y reunir datos para estimar todos los costos de producción, tomando en cuenta las materias primas, la mano de obra y las herramientas a la hora de realizar estimaciones o modelos de costos (should-cost).
  • Colaborar con el equipo de PLM para identificar y abordar los problemas recurrentes que generen ineficiencias, con el objetivo de optimizar el proceso.
  • Colaborar con el responsable de Cost Engineering sobre el software de estimación de costos y con proveedores de software de terceros, a fin de abordar cualquier problema con el software de estimación de costos que esté provocando demoras o errores.
  • Analizar continuamente los datos usando Databricks para señalar las tendencias a los ingenieros y responsables de costos de cara al futuro desarrollo de modelos y objetivos de costos.

Gestión de proyectos

  • Asumir la responsabilidad de los proyectos; planear hitos e identificar riesgos potenciales para garantizar la entrega puntual de los modelos de costos dentro de las fechas de finalización acordadas.
  • Gestionar de forma proactiva la finalización de tareas e informar periódicamente a equipos multifuncionales sobre el estado de los proyectos, los plazos, la dotación de recursos, los desafíos y la probabilidad de una entrega a tiempo y de alta calidad.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or Finance.
  • Minimum of 3 years of automotive or manufacturing related experience at an OEM or Tier 1 Manufacturer.
  • Proficiency in navigating CAD models in CATIA or similar software.
  • Ability to interpret and understand design and manufacturing drawings.
  • Capability to independently create a Bill of Materials (BoM) for a given commodity or design and allocate costs.
  • Proficiency in Data Analysis (Databricks) and APIs to independently investigate, quantify, and pull data for root-cause analysis.
  • Entrepreneurial, ambitious, independent, detail-oriented, structured thinker, goal-oriented, flexible, and resilient—exhibiting the qualities of a start-up personality.
  • Collaborative team member, ensuring effective communication among colleagues, and providing regular contributions to meetings and briefings.
  • Proficiency in strategic thinking and possessing detail-oriented work habits.

Desired

  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering Management or similar.
  • Proficiency in CATIA, or similar CAD based design programs.
  • Proficiency in aPriori or similar digital cost modeling tools

Calificaciones:

Obligatorias

  • Licenciatura en Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería de Manufactura, Ingeniería Industrial, Cadena de Suministro, Administración de Empresas o Finanzas.
  • Un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia relacionada con la automoción o la manufactura en un fabricante de equipo original (OEM) o fabricante de nivel 1.
  • Dominio en el manejo de modelos CAD en CATIA o software similar.
  • Capacidad para interpretar y comprender planos de diseño y manufactura.
  • Capacidad para crear de forma independiente una lista de materiales (BoM) para un producto o diseño determinado y asignar costos.
  • Dominio del análisis de datos (Databricks) y las API para investigar, cuantificar y extraer datos de forma independiente para el análisis de la causa raíz.
  • Persona con espíritu emprendedor, ambiciosa, independiente, meticulosa, con pensamiento estructurado, orientada a objetivos, flexible y resiliente; las cualidades propias de un perfil emprendedor.
  • Miembro colaborador del equipo, que garantiza una comunicación eficaz entre sus colegas y contribuye regularmente a las reuniones y sesiones informativas.
  • Competencia en pensamiento estratégico y hábitos de trabajo orientados al detalle.

Deseadas

  • Maestría (o superior) en Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería de Manufactura, Gestión de Ingeniería o similar.
  • Dominio de CATIA o programas de diseño similares basados en CAD.
  • Dominio de aPriori o herramientas similares de modelización digital de costos.

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is 592,100 MXN - 740,138 MXN annually. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. There is no fixed deadline for this application; applications are accepted on an ongoing basis until the role is filled or the opening is no longer needed. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including major & minor medical, life insurance, and food vouchers to eligible employees. jobs.description:
Location Designation: Fully Remote

Role Overview:

The Life Insurance Concierge serves as a trusted guide for survivors navigating the loss of a loved one and the life insurance claims process. The role is designed to simplify the customer’s experience during one of life's most difficult moments by providing compassionate guidance and connecting survivors with the support and resources they need. In partnership with the Life Specialist and other internal business partners, the Life Insurance Concierge delivers personalized support to help survivors through each stage of the journey.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the Life Specialist, employers, and other internal business partners to deliver coordinated and personalized support for survivors navigating the loss of a loved one and the life insurance claims process.
  • Independently assess survivor circumstances and needs, applying knowledge of life insurance claims, benefits, available resources, and internal processes to determine appropriate support and guide survivors through complex or sensitive situations.
  • Guide survivors through the claims process by explaining next steps, assisting with claim submission, obtaining required documentation, coordinating with internal business partners, and maintaining a caring connection throughout the journey.
  • Evaluate information from survivors, employers, claims partners, and other relevant sources to identify barriers, determine appropriate courses of action, and resolve a broad range of survivor-support issues.
  • Foster trusted relationships through phone and email communication by assessing survivor needs, reducing barriers, and connecting survivors with the most appropriate resources and support.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions and claim-related activities while utilizing multiple systems to ensure continuity, consistency, and an exceptional customer experience.
  • Coordinate customer-specific support services and optional remembrance offerings, as applicable.
  • Use survivor feedback, case experience, operational data, and knowledge of best practices to recommend improvements to processes, resources, and services that enhance the survivor experience.
  • Identify and resolve a broad range of survivor experience and claims-navigation issues, using judgment to develop solutions when standard approaches do not fully address the survivor's circumstances.

What You’ll Bring:

Required:

  • Minimum of five years of relevant professional experience in life insurance, benefits, claims, healthcare, case management, customer advocacy, or a related discipline requiring independent judgment and management of complex or sensitive customer situations.
  • Experience supporting customers through complex, sensitive, or high-touch interactions.
  • Working knowledge of life insurance and associated products/benefits, claims processes, or comparable benefits/claims disciplines, with the ability to apply that knowledge to complex customer circumstances.

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is a pioneer in its approach to mental health treatment. In addition to providing superior Clinical care from the nation’s most talented and passionate clinicians, Charlie Health offers unparallelled and effective holistic treatment via our groundbreaking Integrative care including Contemplative, Creative Arts, and Experiential Programming. We firmly believe that thriving, sustainable health is the result of treating the whole person - mind, body, and spirit - and our vIOP deeply embodies this philosophy. As such, we advocate for and provide inclusive, accessible, diverse, cosmopolitan healing approaches that transcend the conventional Western psychological model. Charlie Health’s synergistic Clinical + Integrative treatment model affords cutting edge mental health care that proudly serves our amazing clients.

Charlie Health is excited to expand its Contemplative Programming Department. Aligned with the growing bodies of research that evidence positive psychological transformation as a result of contemplative interventions and practices rooted in wisdom traditions, our Contemplative Practitioners support our clients in developing mindful awareness, cultivating wisdom, discovering purpose, living compassionately, and practicing self-inquiry. Some of our current therapeutic modalities include Yoga Therapy, Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction, Mindful Self Compassion, Breathwork, Philosophical Consultation, Transpersonal Psychology, Spiritual Coaching, Meditation, and Chaplaincy. Some of the modalities we are eager to include are Contemplative Psychotherapy, Contemplative Arts, Dreamwork, Depth Psychology and many more.

Charlie Health is hiring a few exceptional Contemplative Practitioners to provide remote, telehealth services to our clients. We’re eager to work with forward-thinking mental health and substance use professionals to enhance our programming and provide the best possible care to our clients.

This is a contract / 1099 position that allows you the flexibility to schedule sessions and work wherever you are most comfortable. We request that our facilitators are able to dedicate at minimum 9 permanent group hours per week to facilitate group sessions and build valuable connections with our clients.

People know Charlie Health for our warm and empathetic team. While each individual facilitator has their own interests, expertise, and style, we require all team members to be well versed in a variety of therapeutic modalities. Our clients are struggling to cope with underlying mental health issues and benefit from facilitators that are sophisticated and relational. Successful candidates are committed to bettering the mental health of their clients, and are adept at self-care, ensuring they are prepared to give their best every day to address the rural mental health crisis.

Summary:

Our partner organization is an independent and non-profit research organisation that -

  • Analyses issues at the frontier of addressing climate change, managing the energy transition, and limiting environmental threats in India and globally;
  • Informs policymakers, stakeholders and the public about key policy and governance levers, and their implications; and
  • Accelerates the transition to an environmentally and socially sustainable future by enabling strategic action for systemic change.
Work Description:

The role of a Fellow is to identify, develop and implement new areas of research and engagement. This includes identifying areas of national strategic importance around India's energy transition, developing a potentially impactful research and policy engagement strategy, identifying potential sources of funding, working with a team to execute the vision, and building networks with peer research organisations, governments and the media in the process.

This is a leadership position within the organization and will require a reasonable amount of time devoted to organisation building, including to coordination meetings and managing key organisational functions. It is a young and exciting organisation, and these are crucial years in its development this position is expected to play a role in that process with institutional commitments ramping up slowly over time.

The candidate must have research experience and interests related to India's energy transition. While they are flexible to candidates specific research interests within this broad field, the candidate should be able to engage
with and carry forward their existing work on governance of energy transitions, metrics and indicators of progress, energy transition and climate change, just transitions for fossil-dependent regions, sub-national electricity transitions and the changing political economy of energy.

The Fellow is expected to develop an independent policy research agenda while collaborating with other team members.
The role demands a level of comfort in publishing peer-reviewed work in top journals, writing policy briefs that speak to live issues, and writing public-facing pieces such as op-eds.

Work Culture:

Our partner organization operates through collaborative decision-making and with key institutional decisions taken collectively. Potentially successful candidates should therefore be comfortable working in such an environment. This includes playing an active role in furthering their team culture goals, encouraging the prospects of their talented younger colleagues, and being open to (and indeed encouraging) feedback from colleagues. They have structured this organisation to ensure independent research and privilege rigorous research and high-quality outputs that drive discourse on India's policy landscape. They also care deeply about equity, both in the workplace and in their research outputs. A successful candidate will likely have the same core emphases.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop new areas of work and continue to develop existing areas of work in the manner described above with a view to enable India's energy transition.
  • Build relationships with partners in governments, the media and peer organisations in India and globally.
  • Be able to manage a team and assist colleagues in their career development.
  • Develop a pipeline of high impact and high quality academic and policy work in tandem.
  • Engage in team building and manage key organizational functions.
Qualifications and Work Experience:
  • Applicants must have a Ph.D. in a relevant social science discipline or applied sciences with demonstrable policy engagement and public impact. MA/MS candidates will be considered if the candidate brings a history of impact or high-quality work in the policy space and have considerable policy experience.
  • A minimum of three to five years of post-doctoral work experience is essential.
  • Demonstrated interest in energy transition policy and/or research is desirable.
  • At least two publications in high-impact peer-reviewed journals are highly desirable.
  • Experience in mentoring younger colleagues and advancing their careers is desirable.
  • Other evidence of being able to write and think creatively.
  • History of working in or encouraging a flat organisational structure is preferable.
  • Evidence of working with or enjoying a highly interdisciplinary environments is preferable.

About Lydian Energy

Lydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America.  Lydian owns 14 assets in development, construction or under operation, consisting of both solar and storage, which reached or are expected to reach FNTP from 2024-2028.

Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital (“EEC”), a leading private equity fund manager with more than $1.5B in assets under management, that is exclusively focused on north American middle market renewables investing.  Lydian’s relationship with EEC provides several critical advantages, including access to (i) a specialized team of value-add investor-operators with decades of renewables development, construction, and transaction experience and (ii) committed discretionary equity capital, strong relationships with debt and tax equity investors, and deep experience structuring tax equity and project financings.

Lydian has built a team of seasoned, passionate energy infrastructure professionals with deep expertise in project development, construction, financing, and M&A. This is an opportunity to join a fully capitalized development platform that is running at full capacity, but still at an early-enough stage for you to have a real impact on company culture and commercial outcomes.

Job Scope

The Contracts Manager supports the successful execution of Lydian’s utility-scale solar, BESS, and related infrastructure projects by administering contracts, monitoring compliance, maintaining complete contract records, and coordinating commercial documentation from award through project closeout. The role works closely with Project Managers, Accounting, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, contractors, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure contractual requirements, payment support documentation, notices, and closeout obligations are managed accurately and on time.

The successful candidate will bring strong construction contract administration experience, excellent organization and written communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment.

Responsibilities

Contract Administration and Compliance

  • Administer and supervise contract monitoring, contract administration, and compliance activities for assigned projects.
  • Review and track contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, amendments, change orders, notices, commitments, and other commercial documents.
  • Interpret applicable policies, procedures, and contract provisions, and provide direction to staff regarding relevant requirements.
  • Develop and prepare regular reports on contract status, compliance, deliverables, risks, and outstanding actions.
  • Determine priorities, goals, and objectives for assigned contract administration functions.
  • Assist in resolving contract payment disputes and confer with contractors and internal departments regarding payments, required backup, and compliance.
  • Develop, recommend, and coordinate implementation of new or improved procedures for assigned contract administration functions.
  • Maintain contract compliance tracking and reporting, including key dates, deliverables, insurance, notices, permits, and closeout requirements.

Document Management & Project Coordination

  • Develop and maintain an organized electronic file management system for all contract-related documents.
  • Coordinate the flow of construction documents, including contracts, change orders, owner correspondence, contractor, vendor and subcontractor liens or lien waivers, and insurance certificates.
  • Draft correspondence, notices, transmittals, and other contract-related communications.
  • Process and submit subcontracts to subcontractors and track execution through completion.
  • Track and coordinate City, Town, county, and other applicable permit documentation with project teams and external stakeholders.
  • Complete and submit contractor prequalification packages and bid packets.
  • Work closely with the Accounting Department and Project Managers to support invoice reviews, payment processing, and complete project records.
  • Maintain accurate and organized electronic files in accordance with Lydian’s document control and record-retention expectations.

Project Closeout

  • Coordinate contract and administrative closeout for completed projects and work packages.
  • Collect, review, and organize final lien waivers, warranties, as-built documentation, operations and maintenance manuals, insurance records, permits, and other required turnover documentation.
  • Confirm completion of contractual closeout requirements and maintain complete final project records.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Five or more years of experience in construction contract administration, contract management, project controls, or a related project delivery function.
  • Demonstrated experience as a Construction Contract Administrator, Contracts Specialist, Contracts Manager, or similar role
  • Working knowledge of construction contracts, subcontracts, change orders, payment documentation, lien waivers, insurance certificates, and project closeout processes.
  • Experience supporting multiple concurrent construction or infrastructure projects.

Education & Technical Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Construction Management, Engineering, Finance, Legal Studies, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel; working knowledge of Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and electronic document management systems preferred.
  • Ability to develop clear trackers, reports, correspondence, and organized project records.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting utility-scale solar, BESS, power generation, transmission, or other energy infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with engineering, procurement, and construction contracts, equipment supply agreements, and construction services agreements.
  • Experience with contract management, project management, or document control platforms.

Travel

Equal Employment Opportunity

jobs.description:
About us:

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested over $2 billion in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than 100 countries and over 5 million borrowers.

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full-time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

Kiva's values:

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

Internship Program

Since its founding, volunteerism has been an integral part of Kiva's foundation and success. As a Kiva Intern, you will contribute your passion, drive, ideas, and expertise to expanding our reach and impact while taking on immediate and significant responsibilities within your team. In addition to learning on the job, you'll partake in a variety of educational, social, and professional development workshops and events that will accelerate your professional growth while learning about Kiva and the non-profit, technology, and microfinance sectors.

Through this volunteer internship, we’re hoping to provide a high-caliber learning experience. With the completion of our internship program, you will take away many in-demand job skills. Additionally, all Kiva interns will gain exposure to foundational microfinance concepts and ongoing professional development tailored to your career goals. This position will also put you in contact with a wide array of employees around the world, giving you a jump start on networking opportunities.

This Kiva internship is a 6-month, part-time (24- 32 hours per week), United States-based, remote volunteer position.

Placement Process

Kiva places interns within most departments of the organization. During recruitment, we evaluate your application and interests to match you to a specific team that will leverage your talents while providing you with an opportunity to develop and grow.

Although Kiva Interns range in age and experience, a common theme among our participants is a "can do" attitude as well as a desire and willingness to dive in and get their hands dirty.

Role overview:

Joining Kiva's Design Team, you'll be reporting to our Principal Product Designer. Our Product Design team has worked on experiences for some of the biggest brands in the world, including Apple, Google, HBO, and Mastercard. Your work at Kiva will enable people across the world to do good and help each other. This role requires a high level of collaboration with our Product Management and Engineering teams. We're looking for curious, thoughtful, collaborative people who want to live their values.

We're looking for a Product Design Intern with a focus on UX design, strong UX writing, and a knack for systems thinking. Each day will be super collaborative: you'll work with an international team of Kivans, designing features for millions of users, running studies with our Principal Researcher, and contributing to Kiva's design system.

At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately, we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Partner with our Principal Researcher on at least one research project, helping conduct user interviews, usability tests, and surveys, and turning what you learn into insights that shape product decisions
  • Join a cross-functional team of engineers and a product manager to design and ship at least one feature tested live on Kiva.org, from early flows and wireframes through launch
  • Build interactive prototypes in Figma to explore ideas, test with users, and communicate designs to your team
  • Contribute to Kiva's design system by defining and shipping at least one new component or primitive alongside the system's design and engineering leads
  • Share your work in weekly design critiques with the team, giving and receiving feedback and explaining your decisions to designers and non-designers alike

Preferred qualifications:

  • At least 21 years of age or older by January 12, 2027
  • Able to commit to the full 6-month term
  • Strong UX writing skills: you can write clear, concise, brand-aligned copy
  • Systems thinking: you can spot patterns and design reusable components
  • Visual and interaction design: you can create polished, intuitive interfaces with a strong eye for detail
  • Comfortable working on macOS
  • Proficiency with standard design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud
  • AI design tools: you can use tools like Figma Make, Claude, and ChatGPT to explore and prototype ideas
  • Able to keep track of projects from handoff to completion
  • Proactive, able to meet deadlines, and able to explain design decisions to non-designers
  • Exceptional communicator with a knack for articulating design rationale
  • Thrives in an iterative process that involves listening, adapting, moving fast, talking with users, incorporating feedback, and constantly collaborating

What we offer:

  • Professional development and skills workshops
  • Access to Kiva’s network of Kiva Fellowship and Internship Alumni
  • Optional participation in Kiva’s Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and social activities such as happy hours and coffee chats
  • References are gladly given for successful participants

Kiva's Internship is a part-time volunteer position, however, to help offset some expenses, Kiva will provide a modest stipend of $800 a month (before taxes) to its volunteers. Please note that the stipend is considered taxable income, and we expect interns to do their own research as to how this may affect their personal/tax implications.

The weekly time commitment for a Kiva Internship is 24 - 32 hours per week, from January 12, 2027 - June 30, 2027. Please make sure you have the availability to commit for the entire internship period before submitting an application.

A diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is an integral part of Kiva's culture. We actively welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a great place to work. Join us and help us achieve our mission!

We will only accept applications directly from candidates. Kiva will not be responsible for any recruiting agency fees, absent a formal agreement.

  • Confident communicator who works effectively with both clients and workforce teams.
  • Solutions-oriented and proactive.
  • Fast responder with excellent operational discipline.

Required Experience & Skills

    • Operations
    • Staffing coordination
    • Workforce management
    • Scheduling
    • Dispatch
    • Live operations environments

    • High-growth startups

Why Join Us?

    • Workforce Operations Lead
    • Marketplace Operations Manager
    • Client Operations Manager

Interview Process

  3. Client Interview

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your operations or workforce coordination experience, explain how you’ve managed scheduling, staffing, attendance, or live operational issues, and share examples of how you’ve handled high-pressure situations while maintaining excellent service. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the operations interview and client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

jobs.excerpt: Position Title:This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations.
jobs.description:
Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.
  • Front-room participation in internal audits. Back-room participation in external audits.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all essential functions.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED AND/OR PREFERRED:

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline, preferably in regulatory, engineering, or biological science plus 3 or more years of relevant experience; in lieu of degree, 5 or more years of relevant experience may suffice.
  • RAC certification(s) a plus

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Technical Competencies

  • Computer Skills - Skilled with computers, takes advantage of new technology, learns new tools quickly, uses technology to enhance job performance
  • Budget - Uses resources efficiently, strives to reduce cost
  • Innovation - Creative, offers new ideas, amenable to change, risk taker
  • Job Knowledge - Understands facets of job, aware of duties and responsibilities, keeps job knowledge current. Strong understanding of other functional items including product development, design controls and risk management. Strong understanding of medical terminology, regulations, and guidelines related to medical devices and quality systems including FDA’s Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), MDD 93/42/EEC, MDR 2017/745, and ISO 13485.
  • Organization Skills - Information organized and accessible, maintains efficient workspace, manages time well
  • Product Expertise - Knows product features, understands marketplace, shares expertise with others
  • Professional Development - Seeks to identify one’s self-improvement opportunities at work and takes appropriate action to address
  • Project Management - Monitors status of projects, thoroughly deals with project details, holds project owners accountable, delivers clear, accurate depiction of status
  • Quality - Strives to eliminate errors, accurate work is a priority, seeks opportunities to improve product/services
  • Technical Skills - Maintains understanding of technical processes/equipment, uses technology to increase performance/productivity

Behavioral & Basic Skill Competencies

  • Adaptability - Adapts to change, open to new ideas and responsibilities
  • Communication – Communicates proficiently (written and verbal), delivers presentations, has good listening skills
  • Conflict Management - Good listener, committed to finding solution to problems, works well with difficult people
  • Customer Focus - Working cooperatively with internal and external customers in a manner that demonstrates a clear commitment to their needs and success
  • Decision Making - Able to reach decisions, takes thoughtful approach when considering options, seeks input from others, makes difficult decisions
  • Dependability - Meets deadlines, works independently, accountable, maintains focus, punctual, good attendance record
  • Details – High attention to detail
  • Ethics - Honest, accountable, maintains confidentiality
  • Initiative - Takes action, seeks new opportunities, strives to see projects to completion
  • Interpersonal Skills - Builds strong relationships, is flexible/adaptable, works well with others, solicits feedback
  • Problem Solving/Critical Thinking - Strives to understands contributing factors, works to resolve complex situations
  • Productivity - Manages workload, works efficiently, meets goals and objectives
  • Results Driven - Defines appropriate goals, works toward achieving goals, articulates vision and steps for achievement.
  • Results/Productivity - Working in a productive, dependable, and efficient manner to produce high quality results in accordance with deadlines and other expectations.
  • Self-Development - Looks for opportunities to increase knowledge, works to increase responsibility, strives to achieve personal goals
  • Sense of Urgency - Meets deadlines, establishes appropriate priority, gets the job done in a timely manner, able to work under pressure
  • Strategic Thought - Works to establish and articulate visions, shows creativity when defining solutions
  • Teamwork - Demonstrating high levels of teamwork and ability to work cross-functionally

This position requires the use of personal protective equipment during various tasks/activities including but not limited to scrubs, gloves, masks, safety glasses, and safety shoes.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Open to Australian Candidates only.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Open to Australian Candidates only. You must have full right to work in Australia with no visa requirements

Kyckr is a B2B API platform that gives regulated businesses access to legally authoritative company data from 300+ corporate registries across 120 countries. Our customers are banks, fintechs, and compliance teams who rely on Kyckr to power their Know Your Business (KYB) and AML workflows. Data is sourced in real time from official government registries and delivered through a normalised, machine-readable API.

We were recently named a Category Leader for KYC Data Solutions by Chartis Research. After a year of record growth, we are investing in our engineering team to accelerate delivery of our next-generation Registry Hub architecture.

We are a small, focused engineering team distributed across Australia, Ireland, the UK, and the Philippines. We operate on Azure, run a large .NET monorepo alongside a newer microservices architecture, and are actively adopting AI-assisted development tooling — including Claude Code and GitHub Copilot — as a core part of how we build software.

The Role

We are looking for a Development Team Lead to lead a small team of four developers while remaining a hands-on senior engineer. This is a player-coach role: we anticipate roughly an 80/20 split between writing code and leading the team. You will spend the majority of your time building software, and the rest growing your engineers, unblocking delivery, and raising the technical bar.

You will be one of our most senior technical contributors — setting the standard for code quality, design, and AI-assisted ways of working — at the same time as owning the line management and career development of your team. You will report directly to the CTO and work closely with them on technical direction, delivery, and team growth.

Two areas matter especially for this role. First, agentic AI for coding: we are not experimenting at the edges — Claude Code and agentic development and QA workflows are central to how we build, and we want a leader who can drive that adoption from the front. Second, product integrations: a large part of our value is connecting reliably to corporate registries and third-party data sources worldwide, and to our customers’ systems, so deep, practical integration experience is important.

The right person is an excellent engineer who genuinely enjoys developing people, communicates clearly in a distributed team, and is energised by working in a domain where data quality has real regulatory consequences.

What You’ll Be Doing

Hands-On Engineering (the majority of your time)

Spend most of your time writing clean, testable, production code in .NET (C#) and SQL Server across our monorepo and newer Registry Hub services — leading by example, not from the sidelines.

Take on the most complex and ambiguous technical work, and set the standard for design, code quality, and testing across the team.

Own significant features and services end-to-end, from design through delivery and operation.

Lead architecture and design discussions, making pragmatic, well-reasoned decisions and clearly communicating the trade-offs.

Agentic AI for Coding

Drive the team’s use of Claude Code and agentic development and QA workflows — for code generation, refactoring, test writing, code review, automated regression checking, and code analysis.

Define and continuously improve the prompt engineering practices, agent configurations, and guardrails that let the team build faster without compromising quality.

Evaluate and introduce new AI tooling as the landscape evolves, and help the wider engineering organisation adopt what works.

Establish how we measure the impact of AI-assisted development on velocity and quality, and use that to guide adoption.

Product Integrations

Lead the design and delivery of integrations with third-party registry APIs and data sources, handling the complexity of varied data formats and reliability characteristics across 120 countries.

Own the patterns for resilient, observable, and maintainable integrations — retries, error handling, rate limiting, and monitoring.

Work with product and customer-facing teams to deliver integrations into customers’ systems and workflows that solve real compliance problems.

Team Leadership & People Management

Line-manage a team of four developers, including regular one-to-ones, performance management, and active career development and growth planning.

Mentor and coach engineers, giving and receiving constructive feedback through code review and day-to-day collaboration.

Own your team’s delivery — planning, prioritisation, and removing blockers — in partnership with product and the CTO.

Foster a pragmatic, high-trust, high-ownership engineering culture and help recruit and onboard new engineers as the team grows.

Delivery, Quality & Collaboration

Champion strong engineering practices: meaningful tests, safe and repeatable deployments through our Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and continuous improvement.

Work asynchronously with a distributed team across three time zones, using Microsoft Teams, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and Jira.

Document technical decisions, architecture, and runbooks clearly — good written communication matters in a remote team.

Collaborate with product, compliance, and customer success to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet real-world needs.


Requirements

We are looking for 7–10 years of hands-on software development experience, including time spent leading or mentoring other engineers. You don’t need to have held a formal “Team Lead” title before, but you should be ready to combine deep, current technical contribution with real responsibility for a team. You don’t need to have worked in FinTech or RegTech specifically, but you should be comfortable building production services where reliability and security matter.

Essential

7–10 years of professional software development experience, with strong, current hands-on skills in .NET / C#.

Solid experience with SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, and relational data modelling.

Proven experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party systems and data sources.

Demonstrable experience leading, mentoring, or line-managing engineers — and a genuine interest in developing people and their careers.

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar), and enthusiasm for making it central to how a team works.

Strong system design and architecture judgement, with the ability to make and clearly explain pragmatic trade-offs.

Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills across a distributed system.

Strong written and verbal communication for a remote, distributed team.

Comfortable balancing hands-on delivery with leadership responsibilities (an 80/20 coding-to-leadership split).

Nice to Have

Experience configuring or operating agentic AI workflows for development or QA at a team level.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure Functions, App Services, Service Bus, Blob Storage, Key Vault, APIM).

Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Azure DevOps, YAML pipelines, automated deployments).

Experience with message-driven and event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, queues).

Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and Kubernetes.

Front-end experience with React or other modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.

Experience working in a regulated industry (FinTech, HealthTech, GovTech, or similar).


Benefits

Our engineering team is distributed across Australia, Ireland, the UK, and the Philippines. We work asynchronously by default, using Microsoft Teams, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and Jira to coordinate. The CTO is UK-based, and you will have a regular, collaborative working relationship with them.

We are a pragmatic team. We prefer well-considered decisions over process for its own sake. We document our architecture in Confluence, use Miro for diagrams, and write diagrams inline where appropriate. We are actively improving our engineering practices — including metrics, better CI/CD, and more consistent Infrastructure-as-Code — and every engineer contributes to that effort.

We use Claude Code as our AI coding assistant and are building out agentic workflows for development and QA. We take a practical, incremental approach to AI adoption — this is not theoretical experimentation. It is how we are choosing to build software, and we want a leader who is excited to take that further.

What We Offer

A genuine player-coach role — stay deeply technical while leading and growing a team.

Remote-first working with flexibility over your schedule.

Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Direct access to technical leadership and real influence over how the platform and team evolve.

A small, experienced team with low bureaucracy and high trust.

A genuinely interesting platform: real-time data from 120 countries, complex legacy systems being modernised, and a clear architectural direction.

AI-first development culture — you will lead the team in using cutting-edge AI tooling as a core part of how we build, not as a side project.

Finance teams still spend most of their week on manual work: reading invoices and receipts, matching transactions, checking spend against policy, chasing approvals, and closing the books across several countries and currencies. AI can now do much of that work reliably, and Jeeves is building it into the core of our platform. That only matters if it works in production, with real money, for real customers.

As an AI Engineer at Jeeves, you will own whole workflows from end to end, not individual features. For example, you might own everything that happens between an invoice arriving and a payment going out: document extraction, matching, policy checks, approval routing, posting to the customer's ERP, and the evaluation and monitoring that tell us it's working. You'll decide how to build it, ship it, measure it, and keep improving it. You'll work closely with Product, Backend Engineering, and our customers' finance teams, but you won't wait for someone to hand you a spec.

This is a senior, hands-on role for people who are AI-native in how they work. You use coding agents and AI tools every day to move faster, and you know where they fall short. It isn't a research role, and it isn't a role for someone who wants a narrow, well-defined ticket queue.

Location: This role is remote or hybrid based out of São Paulo, Brazil, and is a full-time remote position where it is also possible to come into our office at complexo JK Iguatemi on a flexible schedule.

What You'll Do:

    Own AI Workflows End to End

  • Take a finance workflow (for example invoice-to-payment, expense review, or transaction reconciliation) and own it from problem definition through production and ongoing improvement

  • Design agentic and LLM-based systems that combine extraction, retrieval, reasoning, and tool use to complete multi-step work, with clear human-in-the-loop points for high-value financial decisions

  • Write the design docs, make the build-vs-buy and model choices, and set the success metrics for each workflow you own

  • Talk directly with customers and internal finance users to understand where the workflow breaks today and what "done" looks like

    • Build Reliable AI in Production

  • Build production-grade LLM pipelines: prompt and context design, structured outputs, validation, fallbacks, and confidence scoring

  • Design retrieval and RAG components (chunking, embeddings, vector search, re-ranking) where a workflow needs grounding in customer documents or policies

  • Integrate AI services cleanly with Jeeves's backend: clear API contracts, retries, graceful degradation, and per-customer data isolation

  • Manage cost and latency across models, choosing the right model for each step

    • Measure, Monitor, and Improve

  • Build evaluation sets and automated evals for every workflow you own, and use them to catch regressions when prompts, models, or data change

  • Instrument AI components with logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerts so you know when quality drops before a customer does

  • Keep an audit trail of AI decisions that meets the standards of a regulated financial product

    • Raise the Bar for AI Engineering at Jeeves

  • Set patterns, shared tooling, and practices that other engineers can build on

  • Show the wider team how to use coding agents and AI tools well in day-to-day engineering

  • Review peers' AI system designs and share what you learn openly

Minimum Requirements:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building and operating LLM or AI-powered systems in production

  • A track record of owning a large system or workflow end to end, from scoping and design through launch and iteration, with limited direction

  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered applications with APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar, including structured outputs, error handling, and evaluation

  • Experience designing agentic or multi-step AI workflows (tool use, orchestration, human review steps), or RAG systems with vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, or Weaviate

  • Strong proficiency in Python, plus solid backend fundamentals: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar relational databases, async patterns, and a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

  • Uses AI coding agents and tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex) as a regular part of how they build, and can explain where they help and where they don't

  • Experience with observability for AI systems: logging, tracing, dashboards, and quality monitoring

  • Professional fluency in English, written and spoken

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry where AI decisions must be accurate and auditable

  • Experience automating finance or back-office workflows such as accounts payable, expense management, reconciliation, or document processing

  • Has led a project or small group of engineers technically, even without formal management responsibility

  • Startup or scale-up experience building systems from scratch

  • Spanish or Portuguese fluency

  • Open-source contributions, technical writing, or talks on applied AI
